jobs.title: Director, Rare Disease Product Marketing & Sales Enablement
jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are seeking a Director of Product Marketing & Sales Enablement to shape how Zenith genomics is positioned, explained, and adopted in the rare disease market.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing & Sales Enablement to shape how Zenith genomics is positioned, explained, and adopted in the rare disease market. Rare disease diagnostics is a market where the standard playbook doesn't apply: the ordering audience is specialized, the diagnostic odyssey is long, and every clinician interaction has to count.

This leader owns the work that turns strategy into field results: how our value is told, what the sales team carries into the room, how well the field is trained, and how quickly a new account moves from first conversation to routine ordering. You will partner closely with the marketing leader who owns clinical community engagement (KOLs, conferences, and speaker programs), and with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and corporate Commercial Operations, to ensure a single, integrated go-to-market plan.

The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset, and is equally comfortable in a messaging workshop, a field ride-along, and a funnel dashboard. As the business scales, this role is expected to grow into a team.

Key Responsibilities

Product Marketing & Messaging

  • Positioning & Messaging: Own product positioning and the core messaging framework for Zenith, translating complex genomic science into clear value propositions for clinicians, genetic counselors, and health systems.
  • Collateral & Content: Lead development of sales and customer-facing assets (brochures, leave-behinds, clinical summaries, sell sheets, digital content), including the claims library and MLR / compliance review workflow.
  • Competitive Intelligence: Maintain a current view of the rare disease genomics landscape and equip the field with differentiated, evidence-based positioning.
  • Evidence Integration: Work with Medical and Clinical teams to convert new publications, real-world data, and utilization insights into messaging and field tools.
  • Launch Support: Own the product marketing workstream of the Zenith launch plan, including launch messaging, asset readiness, and field communications.

Sales Enablement & Customer Adoption

  • Field Enablement: Design and run onboarding, training, and ongoing education for the sales team on the science, the competitive landscape, and the value story; equip reps to be credible with geneticists and specialists.
  • Customer Adoption Journey: Map and continuously improve the path from first call to routine ordering, including implementation, EMR integration touchpoints, and utilization resources, to shorten time to adoption.
  • Sales Interface: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner to Sales leadership; run regular field feedback loops and translate what reps and customers are telling us into messaging, tools, and priorities.
  • Market Access Pull-Through: Partner with Market Access and Reimbursement to convert coverage and payer developments into field-ready tools and messaging.

Commercial Insights & Targeting

  • Segmentation & Targeting: Partner with Sales and corporate analytics to define customer segments and account prioritization using clinical, claims, and market data; inform target lists and field focus.
  • Performance Tracking: Define the KPIs that track funnel health, ordering behavior, and adoption for the BU, and use insights to adjust messaging, enablement, and resource focus.
  • Sales Operations Liaison: Represent the Rare Disease BU's needs to corporate Commercial Operations (CRM, reporting, forecasting, and ordering workflow) and ensure the field has clean data and low-friction processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Integrated Planning: Partner with the clinical community marketing lead (KOL, conferences, speaker programs) so that field events, thought-leader engagement, and product messaging operate as one plan.
  • Matrix Collaboration: Serve as the commercial connective tissue across Sales, Medical Affairs, Product, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, and Legal.
  • Budget & Vendor Stewardship: Manage assigned budget and agency / vendor partners with a focus on measurable ROI.
  • Team Growth: Build the business case and hire for additional capacity (for example, sales training, content, or analytics) as the business scales.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Marketing; MBA, MPH, or advanced scientific degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of commercial experience in diagnostics, genomics, or life sciences, including product marketing, sales enablement, commercial strategy, or sales operations.
  • Demonstrated success supporting or leading product launches in a complex clinical diagnostics or specialty setting.
  • Experience in genomics, rare disease, or precision diagnostics strongly preferred.
  • Experience partnering directly with a field sales organization, including training, tools, and CRM / analytics.
  • Experience managing or developing a team is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Messaging Craft: Ability to learn and distill complex clinical and genomic data into compelling, compliant narratives for HCPs and field teams.
  • Analytical Rigor: Comfortable interpreting segmentation, funnel, and commercial performance data to drive decisions.
  • Operational Excellence: Track record of building scalable commercial processes, enablement programs, and cross-functional workflows.
  • Reimbursement & Access Savvy: Working understanding of diagnostic reimbursement, LDT considerations, and payer dynamics.
  • Strategic Agility: Comfort operating in white space where market data is limited and the playbook is still being written.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Influences without authority, and builds strong partnerships with clinical and scientific experts.

Why This Role Matters

In rare disease, every day matters. The clarity with which we explain Zenith's value, and the speed at which a new account adopts it, directly affect how quickly a family reaches a diagnosis. You will build the messaging, field readiness, and adoption path that make that possible.

The "Rare" Candidate Profile

What We Are Looking For

Mindset

Builder who sees a small, specialized market as an opportunity to get the details right.

Field Credibility

Earns trust with sales teams by delivering tools and training that reps actually use.

Communication

Sophisticated enough for a PhD; practical enough for a sales rep on their first day.

Collaboration

Pairs with deep clinical and community expertise to create one integrated plan.

Leadership

A mentor who builds resilient, mission-driven teams.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$186,600—$233,300 USD

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$186,600—$233,300 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. AgentSee, our agentic AI platform, works alongside travel agents. It reads traveler requests, handles bookings and changes, and takes on routine servicing tasks, so agents can manage more trips while improving service quality.

We work with the largest travel agencies and fortune 500 companies, supporting over $15B in annual booking volume for more than 11,000 customers in over 60 countries.

If you want to solve real problems with a focused team in a fast-moving market, Oversee is the place to build, grow, and make an impact.

Why join us?

We're looking for our first dedicated Account Executive in EMEA. You'll have the opportunity to step into a pivotal role where your impact is felt immediately. As an Account Executive, you won’t just be chasing numbers - you’ll be building meaningful partnerships, expanding our channel base, and shaping the growth of our business.   • Experience selling B2B SaaS solutions to enterprise customers;
  • Experience building a territory, launching a new market, or operating as an early commercial hire is highly desirable;
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment;
  • Strong executive presence and experience selling to senior decision-makers;
  • Curious about AI, technology, and the future of business travel, with the ability to learn new products quickly and communicate their value to customers.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

The opportunity

MastarRec is a retained executive search firm focused on senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory and Cybersecurity leadership. We are expanding our U.S. client-development capability and are looking for an experienced, commercially credible professional who already understands how to build senior-level relationships and originate executive-search business.

This is not a high-volume recruiter role and it is not a salaried employee vacancy. It is designed as an independent business-to-business contractor relationship for someone who can create and develop their own U.S. client opportunities, while using MastarRec's brand, executive-search capability and agreed commercial resources to convert suitable opportunities into retained assignments.

What you will do
  • Develop your own relationships with U.S. CEOs, CROs, CCOs, CISOs and other senior decision-makers in Financial Services, FinTech and related regulated markets.
  • Identify genuine business, regulatory, growth, succession, risk and leadership pressures that may create a need for senior executive capability.
  • Originate qualified client opportunities and introduce them to MastarRec for retained executive-search discussions.
  • Lead or participate in commercial conversations where appropriate, with Tariq Masood, Founder & CEO, available for founder-to-executive and closing conversations.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity and relationship records using agreed MastarRec processes.
  • Protect the MastarRec brand through professional, relationship-led business development; no indiscriminate candidate or client spam.

What this opportunity is not
  • It is not a fixed-hours call-center role.
  • It is not an employee position with a guaranteed salary, employee benefits or prescribed daily working schedule.
  • It is not primarily a candidate-sourcing desk.
  • It is not an invitation to mass-message prospects or represent unverified vacancies.

Requirements

Who we want to speak with
  • Experienced executive-search, recruitment, staffing, retained-search or professional-services business developers with U.S. market credibility.
  • Professionals comfortable speaking directly with C-suite and senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory or Cybersecurity leaders.
  • People who can independently decide how, when and where to develop their market and who are comfortable being accountable for commercial results.
  • Professionals with an existing network in U.S. Financial Services, FinTech, banking, payments, insurance, asset/wealth management, cybersecurity or adjacent regulated sectors.
  • Individuals who value consultative conversations and long-term relationships over transactional vacancy chasing.
90-day pilot success measures
  • Qualified senior decision-maker conversations.
  • Client discovery meetings with genuine leadership or succession issues.

·Retained-search opportunities created.

  • Retained proposals issued and assignments won.
  • Collected search revenue from contractor-originated business.
  • Quality of client relationships and commercial intelligence, not raw dial or message volume.
How to apply
Please send a concise introduction explaining your U.S. market background, the sectors and senior decision-makers you know best, and examples of executive-search, recruitment or professional-services business you have personally originated. We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate relationship-led business development rather than high-volume outreach.

Company:MastarRec Limited |

Founder & CEO:Tariq Masood


Benefits

Commercial model

The proposed pilot is performance-based. The final commission schedule will be stated in the written contractor agreement. Our intended starting model is a substantial share of MastarRec's net collected search fees on qualifying new client business personally originated by the contractor. Commission becomes payable only after the relevant client payment has been received and cleared by MastarRec, subject to the agreement's account-ownership, refund, replacement, tax and clawback provisions.

For discussion, Commission is 22% of qualifying net search fees actually collected by MastarRec from new client business personally originated by the contractor. The final structure may vary according to the scope of the contractor's role, whether MastarRec provides delivery support, and applicable legal/tax requirements.

Independent contractor basis

The successful professional will be expected to operate as an independent businessperson, subject to the final written agreement and applicable federal and state law. The contractor will ordinarily control the manner, means, timing and location of their work; remain responsible for their own ordinary business expenses, taxes and insurance; and, subject to confidentiality, conflict and account-protection obligations, remain free to provide services to other clients. MastarRec will define required commercial outcomes, brand/confidentiality standards and client-account protections rather than prescribing day-to-day working methods.

Important notice

This specification describes MastarRec's intended commercial model and is not a legal determination of worker status. Worker classification depends on the actual facts and circumstances and may differ under federal, state and local law. MastarRec will complete appropriate legal/tax review before engagement. No candidate should rely on the title, commission method or written agreement alone as determining independent-contractor status.

The Foundation for California Community Colleges (FCCC) is recruiting experts to join the inaugural C2C Forward Fellows Program to work directly within the Office of Cradle-to-Career in advancing the work of bridging gaps in state-wide data. The Office of Cradle-to-Career Data (C2C) is a neutral source of trusted information that links siloed data across the state to answer questions on what happens to students once they enter and leave our school system and beyond.

C2C Forward is a fiscally sponsored program of the Foundation of California Community Colleges. As C2C Forward Fellows, leaders and experts from across sectors can contribute their knowledge, experience, and innovation to support Cradle-to-Career Data System’s growth and long-term success.


Fellows will gain hands-on experience creating and maintaining a P20W data system while applying their expertise in domains such as TK-12 education, post-secondary education, workforce outcomes, economics, user center design, data visualization, data file preparation, and more. Fellows will be placed at C2C as an integral member of the Data Programs or Data Infrastructure team to advance the work of C2C’s annual workplan, embracing cross-sector collaboration, and gaining insight into underlying governmental structures and partnerships. As a fellow, you will gain a depth of experience and a wealth of knowledge that can be applied at institutions and beyond to advance research that will better serve Californians in the future.

C2C is required by statute to produce data insights such as dashboards, data reports, query builders via CSV files, a research request process via secure data enclave, and query builders. With the aptitude and bandwidth of the fellows, C2C will be able to produce more useful and necessary tools at a more rapid speed while enhancing the data system infrastructure with up-to-date best practices and most current privacy and security features.

In addition to the projects assigned to fellows, fellows will engage in a work culture that values equity, collaboration, transparency, accountability, and curiosity. C2C staff and leadership take pride in implementing values in the day-to-day work and expanding the team with individuals who also share these same values. Fellows will be empowered to take initiative and responsibility for their work in a safe, fun, and intellectually stimulating environment.

  • You relish demonstrating the value of a cloud-first approach to data tools and the benefits of applying software engineering approaches to data work and are eager to hands-on engage with project work to ensure that value is communicated

Title: Research / Senior Research Manager, Farmer Insights and Field Research (Weather Initiative)

Location: India (remote). Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India

Position: Full-time

Application deadline: October 25, 2026 (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)

About the Role:

Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a dynamic, creative, and self-motivated Research / Senior Research Manager to join a high-performing team in India working on our weather initiative - a high-profile, fast-growing area of PxD's work with significant potential for impact and visibility.

In this role, you will help design, test, evaluate, and scale evidence-based weather solutions for smallholder farmers, working closely with researchers, government partners, and cross-functional teams. We're looking for a proactive self-starter with strong research management skills, excellent stakeholder engagement abilities, and a passion for generating actionable evidence to improve program outcomes.

While anchored in research and iterative learning, the role will work fluidly across programmatic, service delivery, and research functions — ensuring insights are embedded into program implementation, operational decision-making, and government-facing engagements.

This is a role for someone as comfortable running a farmer focus group as they are writing up what it means for message design, and who can hold together a fieldwork effort spanning several states and use cases at once.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the design and implementation of farmer visits across multiple states, structured around the specific forecast use cases relevant to farmer decision making and forecast message design
  • Plan and run qualitative research with farmers, including interviews, co-design sessions, and message testing, to surface what farmers need to act on a forecast and how they respond to different message formats
  • Synthesize insights from the field into clear, usable findings, and iterate directly with the relevant use case teams so those findings shape message and service design in near real time
  • Share synthesized insights with relevant teams on a regular cadence, not just at the end of a research cycle
  • Develop generalizable protocols, discussion guides, and field materials so that fieldwork can be replicated across states and use cases without being redesigned each time
  • Coordinate across the different weather forecast use case teams to ensure fieldwork priorities reflect what each team actually needs to learn next
  • Provide guidance to Associate and Manager level staff supporting the fieldwork
  • Contribute to internal and external communications on findings, including briefs and presentations
  • Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management on farmer-facing forecast design

What You'll Bring

  • Degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, anthropology, or a closely related field
  • Experience designing and leading qualitative field research with rural or agricultural communities, ideally including message testing or user research methods
  • Demonstrated ability to manage fieldwork logistics across multiple locations or teams at once
  • Strong synthesis skills: the ability to turn open-ended qualitative material into clear, generalizable findings that a program or research team can act on
  • Experience developing research protocols or materials meant to be reused across contexts
  • Comfort working closely with quantitative researchers and technical teams, even without being one yourself
  • Strong writing and oral communication skills in English
  • Willingness to travel frequently to field sites across states

About Precision Development (PxD):

PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.

Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

How to Apply:

To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. The position will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the application deadline of October 25, 2026, 5pm IST.

In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.description:

Public Partnerships LLC supports individuals with disabilities or chronic illnesses and aging adults, to remain in their homes and communities and “self” direct their own long-term home care. Our role as the nation’s largest and most experienced Financial Management Service provider is to assist those eligible Medicaid recipients to choose and pay for their own support workers and services within their state-approved personalized budget.  We are appointed by states and managed healthcare organizations to better serve more of their residents and members requiring long-term care and ensure the efficient use of taxpayer funded services. Our culture attracts and rewards people who are results-oriented and strive to exceed customer expectations. We desire motivated candidates who are excited to join our fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and who want to make a difference in helping transform the lives of the consumers we serve. (learn more at www.pplfirst.com).


Job Summary:


The thesis of the engagement consultant career track is that you’re not just building an analytics ecosystem, your expertise is also in being a key part of solution ideation and business impact enablement. As the Principal Analytics Engagement Consultant you write and publish PPL’s analytics standards for data modeling, the semantic layer, metric definitions, statistical method, documentation, and reproducibility, and those standards bind every team producing analytics. You co-author the enterprise analytics strategy with the VP of Analytics and hold the technical roadmap for the semantic and governance layer. You also hold the entire team to a high standard of execution on systems level thinking and solutioning.


When a deliverable, a figure, or a claim is not supported by the evidence, you can stop it, and you are expected to. You are the deciding technical voice on leveling and hiring for the Analytics Engagement Consultant team.


You lead PPL’s most consequential engagements: the ones with cross-functional executive sponsorship, regulatory exposure, or material P&L impact. You choose which of these you take on and you own the outcome. You work with PPL Data Architects to ensure the semantic layer, the canonical data models, and the metric definitions meet the minimum quality and rigor expected of the regulatory environment in which PPL operates.

You sit with the executive team as a peer. You shape which questions get asked, you reframe the ones that are wrong, and when the evidence disagrees with the room, you use your influence to help change the decision. You defend methodology under regulatory and audit scrutiny, and over time you make PPL known in the Medicaid market as a partner with deep integrity and analytical rigor.


You are the quality gate for every analytics team member below you. You review and approve their work, and you develop promising talent toward Principal-level judgment: which method, how much rigor, when to push back, when to stop. You own the evolution of the function’s methodology, tooling standards, and operating model with the VP. You set the culture of the craft, which at PPL means intellectual honesty, partnership with the business, and the willingness to raise your hand when the data does not support an assertion.


You stay in the code. When the hardest model needs building, you build it, and your production dbt, SQL, and Python work is the reference implementation others learn from.

Key Competencies

Enterprise Analytics & Methodology Leadership

  • 12+ years of progressive analytics, data science, analytics engineering, or consulting experience, including 5+ years at the Staff, Principal, or equivalent level.
  • Production ownership of a dbt projects other teams depend on, at enterprise scale.
  • Proven authority in defining analytical methodologies, establishing organizational standards, and serving as the final reviewer for high-impact analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver rigorous analytical work that withstands executive, regulatory, and audit-level scrutiny.

Advanced Data Engineering & Contact Center Analytics

  • Deep hands-on expertise with contact-center platforms and data, including contact-level modeling, workforce management, routing, multi-channel structures, and Erlang calculations.
  • Enterprise-scale ownership of production dbt environments and data models relied upon by multiple teams.
  • Advanced SQL expertise with working knowledge of Databricks, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and orchestration tools; Python experience is beneficial.

Executive Influence & Analytics Craft Leadership

  • Proven ability to translate complex analysis into compelling, evidence-based narratives that influence executive and enterprise-level decisions.
  • Demonstrated confidence challenging assumptions and presenting findings that may be unexpected or contrary to prevailing perspectives.
  • Strong track record of developing analytics professionals through mentorship, code review, technical guidance, and cross-functional leadership.

Requirements


Experience:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in analytics, data science, analytics engineering, or management consulting, including 5+ years at a Staff, Principal, or equivalent level.
  • Analytical work that shaped enterprise decisions and stood up to regulatory, audit, or executive scrutiny, with specific examples you can walk through.
  • Authority over methodology at an organizational level: you have defined standards, enforced them across teams you did not manage, and served as final reviewer on high-stakes analysis.
  • Hands-on depth in contact-center data (Genesys, Five9, NICE, Amazon Connect, or similar): contact-level data modeling, workforce management, routing and multi-channel structure, Erlang calculations.
  • Production ownership of a dbt projects other teams depend on, at enterprise scale.
  • Senior-level SQL (Python is nice to have), fluency with Databricks and Azure DevOps or equivalent orchestration and CI/CD using dbt.
  • A record of changing executive decisions through evidence and narrative, including when it was unwelcome, and of developing other analytics professionals through mentorship, code review, and craft leadership.
  • Delivery of solutions that demonstrate strong system-driven strategic thinking

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree required, master's degree preferred in computer science or information technology.

We strongly prefer healthcare, Medicaid, or another regulated industry experience, particularly claims, eligibility, payroll, finance, or program integrity. Consulting partner-track experience (MBB, Big Four advanced analytics) or principal-level analytics work at a mature technology company is a strong differentiator. A standout candidate has experience standing up or substantially evolving a semantic or governance layer at enterprise scale.

Compensation: $162,500 - $214,000

jobs.excerpt: About PeregrinePeregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes.
jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will serve as our full-time technical continuity across three production data products for a federal agency. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements.

Your first project

Your first project builds critical components, integrates partner work, owns data quality, and leaves the products understandable and supportable after cutover. You will deliver:

  • Reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines across a legacy system, the current system of record, and multi-format contractor submissions, with traceable source-to-target mappings.
  • Data Vault 2.0 and Gold tier models that support the required analytics and can be queried independently by agency analysts.
  • Documented deduplication, reconciliation, and data quality controls, including the evidence required for acceptance.
  • Integrated semantic models, Microsoft Power BI support, performance optimization, and production-ready code.
  • Technical review of partner work before it enters the Peregrine acceptance process.
  • Complete data dictionaries, pipeline specifications, runbooks, and knowledge transfer materials.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, including at least three years with Azure Databricks or a comparable lakehouse platform
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Advanced Structured Query Language (SQL) and Python or PySpark, Delta Lake, extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT), orchestration, schema design, data quality, and performance tuning
  • Hands-on experience with Data Vault 2.0, dimensional modeling, semantic models, and production analytics
  • Working familiarity with Unity Catalog, source control, automated deployment, environment promotion, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI and CD)
  • Ability to support Microsoft Power BI datasets and dashboards and to collaborate with machine learning engineers on feature pipelines and model deployment
  • Strong technical writing and the discipline to maintain diagrams, mappings, specifications, and runbooks as the build changes
  • United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms
  • The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements

Preferred

  • Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL-5) or higher
  • Databricks Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer, or a relevant cloud certification
  • ServiceNow data, federal audit data, government financial data, or controlled federal environments
  • Experience moving solutions between Azure environments using infrastructure as code and Databricks Asset Bundles

Who you are

You build critical components, integrate partner work, own data quality, and make sure the products stay understandable and supportable after cutover. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Hands-on and exacting. You prefer working code and reconciled data to architecture theater.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions with evidence and changing course when the data proves the design wrong.
  • Able to teach, document, and review without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Reliable in a partner-heavy team and willing to own the seams between work packages.
  • Curious about audit and planning questions, not only platform mechanics.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $155,000 to $175,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

  • Be Customer Obsessed: We start with our customers and work backward to deliver exceptional value.

If this sounds like a place where you’d thrive, keep reading—your next opportunity might be here.

Summary:

  • Job Title: Lead, Tax Resolution Specialist III
  • Job Status: Full-time
  • Location: 100% remote
  • Compensation: Hourly (Non-Exempt)
  • Position Type: Direct Hire, note, this is not a contract role
  • Pay Range: $27.00 - $32.00 per hour
  • Shift: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM ET, Monday - Friday

Do you love using your communication skills to solve problems? Do you enjoy digging into payroll tax issues and helping others do their best work? Then the Lead, Tax Resolution Specialist III position at Patriot Software may be a great fit for you. This role is for someone who takes initiative, leads by example, and is passionate about both customer service and team member growth. You'll spend most of your day resolving payroll tax notices for our customers while also helping lead and develop our Tax Resolution and Tax Settings teams.

What You’ll Be Doing:

This position supports the Tax Department in delivering accurate, compliant payroll tax services to Full Service customers while assisting the Tax Manager with the daily leadership and development of the Tax Resolution and Tax Settings teams. About 70% of this role is hands-on tax resolution work, and about 30% is team leadership.

Tax Resolution Specialist lll (70%)

  • Work the tax notice queue, researching each notice's root cause and communicating clear, accurate resolutions to customers.
  • Respond to inbound customer calls and emails about payroll tax issues.
  • Serve as a resource to the Tax Department and other departments on complex tax questions and customer interactions.
  • Become an expert in Patriot's internal payroll tax software and help the team use it effectively.
  • Use your payroll and tax knowledge to help the team support, improve, and build an innovative online payroll tax engine.

Team Lead (30%)

  • Lead by example for both the Tax Resolution Specialist and Tax Settings Specialist teams, setting the standard for output, quality, and customer care.
  • Take escalated customer calls and guide them to a professional, timely resolution.
  • Perform quality checks, including monitoring customer calls and reviewing work, and give team members constructive feedback that helps them improve.
  • Review team members' weekly check-ins, where they reflect on how their week went, what's going well, what's challenging, and what they need, and flag where additional support is needed.
  • Partner with the Tax Manager on team performance and productivity, identifying knowledge gaps and determining the right coaching, training, or support.
  • Support ongoing training and development in payroll tax knowledge, customer service, and overall performance.
  • Make sure work flows smoothly between the Tax Resolution and Tax Settings teams.

Building Our Tax Settings Function

Our Tax Settings team, which proactively reaches out to customers to correct tax account information, is new and still taking shape. You will partner with the Tax Manager to build this area from the ground up: defining what good looks like, how output is measured, and how we know we're making a difference for our customers.

Please note this is a sample of what you’ll be doing. This job requires you to be able to adapt to change quickly in order to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Your duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What You’ll Need:

  • 3+ years of experience working in payroll or payroll tax, responding to customer inquiries and tax notices.
  • 1+ years of experience handling customer escalations.
  • 2+ years of experience in a leadership role within a customer support setting.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax procedures, including calculations, deposits, and filings in all 50 states.
  • A self-starter who takes initiative and can build processes where none exist yet.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to learn technical subjects and new software quickly.
  • Excellent time management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance individual output with leadership responsibilities throughout the day.
  • The ability to think conceptually, along with a high attention to detail.

Telehealth Nurse Practitioner

Join a remote, member-facing clinical team helping patients safely navigate the first critical days after discharge. In this full-time telehealth role, you’ll conduct Transitional Care Management visits within 14 days of discharge, complete comprehensive clinical assessments, reconcile medications, identify red flags, and coordinate care that helps reduce avoidable readmissions. This is a strong fit for a licensed Nurse Practitioner who is comfortable working independently on video, documenting same-day, and supporting members across multiple states.

Opportunity

This is a full-time, exempt Telehealth Transitional Care Nurse Practitioner role focused on post-discharge care. You’ll work remotely with members and caregivers through virtual visits, helping close care gaps, support safe recovery, and escalate urgent clinical concerns when needed.

Role details:

  • Employment type: Full-time, exempt
  • Work model: Remote / telehealth
  • Schedule: Core hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday
  • Weekend coverage: Rotating weekend coverage required for urgent or emergent needs, which may include a Saturday visit when clinically necessary
  • Start: ASAP
  • Compensation: $135,000 salary

What You Will Own

Transitional Care Management Visits

  • Conduct telehealth TCM visits within the required post-discharge window.
  • Perform comprehensive clinical assessments for recently discharged members.
  • Complete medication reconciliation and identify potential safety, adherence, or care-continuity concerns.
  • Support members and caregivers through video visit connection steps, basic troubleshooting, and maintaining a private, HIPAA-compliant encounter environment.

Clinical Escalation and Care Coordination

  • Identify acute clinical needs and escalate urgent findings according to clinical protocols.
  • Serve as a first-line clinical escalation resource for care coordinators and support staff regarding member status, red-flag symptoms, or scheduling issues with clinical implications.
  • Coordinate with care team members who interface with PCPs, specialists, and discharge planning teams to help close care gaps and reduce readmission risk.
  • Adjust daily visit sequencing as needed based on member cancellations, discharge timing, and care priorities.

Documentation, Quality, and Compliance

  • Document all encounters completely and accurately.
  • Submit charts no later than the date of service to support timely coding, quality reporting, and claims submission.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, state licensure, and payer-specific documentation requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing clinical training, chart audit feedback sessions, and quality improvement initiatives.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Active, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner licensure in at least three of the following states: OH, CA, NY, IN, KY, PA, LA, MI, TN, MO.
  • Active national board certification through AANP or ANCC as an FNP, AGNP, or equivalent adult/geriatric-focused certification.
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience.
  • Comfort delivering care through video visits and communicating clearly with members and caregivers in a remote setting.
  • Ability to work a dependable weekday schedule with rotating weekend coverage for urgent or emergent clinical needs.
  • Strong comfort using EMR documentation platforms, video-visit software, and desktop or mobile point-of-care technology.
  • Ability to complete accurate same-day documentation for all encounters.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior telemedicine or telehealth experience.
  • Transitional Care Management or post-discharge care experience.
  • Experience working with Medicare Advantage populations.
  • Familiarity with HEDIS, STAR measures, and value-based care documentation standards.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, discharge-driven scheduling environment.

Remote Work and Technology Requirements

  • Dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant workspace free from background noise and visual distractions during scheduled video visits.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection sufficient for stable, uninterrupted video visits.
  • Personal computer and webcam setup that can support secure video visits and required clinical documentation tools.
  • Ability to remain seated, attentive, and engaged on camera for consecutive video visits throughout the scheduled shift.

Equal Opportunity

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This job description reflects the general nature of the role and is not an exhaustive list of duties.

Compensation

The expected total compensation range is USD 135,000 Yearly.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

Salary: $135,000 / year

This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, develops processes with clarity, works cross-functionally by default, and is energized by building client relationships. You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.

This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined playbook. It requires a leader who can move between executive strategy and hands-on execution when it counts, drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority, and bring clarity and momentum to complex, evolving client engagements spanning martech platform configuration to web and email engineering. Client Delivery and Technical Strategy

Cross-Functional Process and Growth

  • Build scalable delivery frameworks, scoping standards, and technical governance models that reduce variability and protect margin across platform and email work

What You Bring

Leadership and Delivery

  • 10 or more years in marketing technology, solution architecture, software engineering, or digital consulting, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role (Director or equivalent)
  • Proven track record leading delivery across multiple complex engagements simultaneously in a consulting or agency environment
  • Highly comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where process must be built alongside execution
  • Strong cross-functional influencer who drives alignment without relying on formal authority
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to lead client conversations at the VP and C-Suite level

Technical Expertise

  • Strong background in email development, including HTML/CSS email engineering, responsive design, rendering across clients and devices, ESP integrations, and templating frameworks
  • Broad understanding of enterprise data architecture, identity resolution, and customer 360 strategy
  • Experience integrating martech platforms with data warehouses, CRMs, CMS platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with AI and ML enablement across marketing and data platforms

About SH/FT

SH/FT is a client services business that focuses on implementing and activating technology and data to make sales and marketing work. Our people bring combined experience across technology, data and analytics, business strategy, and campaign operations to accelerate our clients' businesses. We keep pace with change in modern marketing and technology in order to create effective, scalable, and future-proof solutions for clients that span both the Fortune 500 and emerging industry leaders. Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Programmer with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine deep ABAP expertise — including core ABAP, ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and OData — with a strong understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Fiori integration, and clean-core principles that minimize technical debt and ease future upgrades.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop custom ABAP programs, enhancements, BAPIs, BADIs, user exits, and interfaces within SAP S/4HANA environments, following clean-core and modification-free principles wherever possible.
  • Build performant CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP code that leverages code pushdown and takes full advantage of S/4HANA’s in-memory architecture.
  • Develop and consume OData services and RESTful APIs to support Fiori applications and integrations with non-SAP systems.
  • Implement SAP Gateway services, including service registration, modeling, and lifecycle management.
  • Design and develop classical and interactive ALV reports, smart forms, Adobe forms, and modern Fiori-aligned output channels.
  • Build and maintain integration interfaces using IDocs, RFC, BAPI, Web Services, and the SAP API Hub.
  • Perform technical analysis of business requirements in collaboration with functional consultants, and translate them into well-documented technical designs.
  • Conduct thorough unit testing, support functional and integration testing, and resolve defects raised during UAT and post-go-live hypercare.
  • Lead performance tuning of ABAP code, SQL queries, and database access patterns, including the use of SAT, ST05, and HANA-specific diagnostic tools.
  • Support S/4HANA upgrades, system conversions, and code remediation activities, including SCMON / UPL analysis and clean-core readiness assessments.
  • Implement security best practices in custom developments, including authority checks, secure data handling, and compliance with internal SAP governance.
  • Document technical specifications, code reviews, and operational procedures in line with enterprise SAP standards.
  • Mentor junior ABAP developers and act as a technical reference within the SAP team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional ABAP development experience, with significant time on S/4HANA.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP.
  • Solid experience building OData services and integrating with Fiori applications.
  • Hands-on experience with enhancement frameworks (BADIs, user exits, implicit/explicit enhancements).
  • Strong experience with integration technologies (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, Web Services).
  • Solid understanding of SAP module data structures, including FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP, depending on the project area.
  • Experience with performance tuning tools (SAT, ST05) and HANA diagnostic tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, and SAP transport management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with S/4HANA system conversions or greenfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP BTP, ABAP RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), or steampunk.
  • Hands-on experience with Fiori/UI5 development.
  • Familiarity with SAP CPI / Integration Suite.
  • SAP-certified ABAP developer credentials.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend + Frontend)
jobs.excerpt: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era.  Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it.
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself.
  • Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling.
  • Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way.
  • Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e).
  • Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development: agent instructions, skills, and the test feedback loops that make agents effective across the codebase.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years building software at a product company: you've owned meaningful parts of a real production system.
  • Strong Java: REST APIs, database interactions, async processing.
  • TypeScript and a modern frontend framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud).
  • Frontend fundamentals: complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design.
  • Solid SQL in a backend context: schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Architectural judgment: you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack.
  • DevOps fluency: containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • An eye for design: you can spot a misaligned pixel.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

jobs.title: Sr Director Analyst - Physical AI Safety & Security
jobs.excerpt: This is an individual contributor role, based remotely in North America DescriptionWhen you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a team that values curiosity, expert insights, bold ideas, and intellectual courage, while driving partnerships with global organizations to make the right decisions on their key initiatives.
jobs.description:
This is an individual contributor role, based remotely in North America

Description

When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a team that values curiosity, expert insights, bold ideas, and intellectual courage, while driving partnerships with global organizations to make the right decisions on their key initiatives. Through constant learning, discovery, innovation, and collaboration, you’ll not only help clients accomplish their mission-critical priorities but also grow your career and the scope of your impact across industries. If you’re always looking for what’s next in business and technology, Gartner is looking for you.


Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for world-leading organizations. A Senior Director Analyst is a leader at Gartner and within their area of emerging technology research, making them a trusted source of guidance and advice for clients. As the subject matter expert, a Senior Director Analyst produces innovative, pragmatic and provocative written content, and is a decision-maker and leader of cross-team and cross-practice initiatives. They also engage with clients directly through virtual and in-person interactions, meetings, conferences and industry events. The Senior Director Analyst will challenge clients to reframe their thinking across key initiatives, interpret contextual realities and propose new ways to obtain data to solve complex problems and improve client performance.

What you will do:

  • Lead research initiatives on emerging AI safety and security topics with a focus on the convergence of artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, robotics and other physical AI solutions that interact with and transform the physical world
  • Develop and execute comprehensive research agendas covering AI safety and security for the physical AI ecosystem, including AI-driven autonomous systems, agentic systems, sensor technologies, robotics, and AI-hardware integration
  • Serve as a primary authority on physical AI safety and security technologies and related market dynamics, to deliver insights that inform strategic decisions, investment priorities, and physical AI-related product/service recommendations.
  • Identify AI-related emerging trends, breakthrough technologies, and potential disruptions before they become mainstream
  • Lead primary research initiatives including expert interviews, technical assessments, case study development, and both qualitative and quantitative analysis of emerging market technologies and trends
  • Analyze the competitive landscape across emerging physical AI business use cases and applications, tracking key players from startups to established companies
  • Assess AI technology readiness levels, commercialization pathways, and adoption barriers across different sectors
  • Evaluate geopolitical dimensions of physical AI development, including international competition, export controls, and regulatory frameworks
  • Author authoritative research papers and briefings on physical AI trends, opportunities, and implications
  • Present research findings to diverse audiences including C-level executives, product leaders, investors, and technical communities
  • Support and help build Gartner’s reputation as the global authority on AI
  • Cultivate relationships with researchers, entrepreneurs, investors, and industry practitioners in the physical AI ecosystem
  • Synthesize perspectives from technical experts, end users, and specialists in and facilitate dialogue between stakeholders with different perspectives on physical AI safety and security

What you will need:

  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • Deep understanding of emerging AI enabled software development tools and Agent technologies, markets, costs, and providers
  • Recent experience in bringing AI-driven solutions to market
  • A strong focus on detail and ability to understand the requirements of complex systems that call for an all-new approach to cybersecurity
  • Critical thinking, curiosity, and self-motivation to discover and make sense of early emerging technology signals
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical, and presentation skills
  • Executive presence with the ability to engage C-level provider and end-user clients and respond effectively to questions to quickly build rapport
  • Relentless drive to understand emerging technologies and their implications, comfortable operating at the frontier of knowledge where answers are uncertain
  • Strong foundational understanding of AI risk management

Preferred:

  • Understanding of the rapidly emerging field of physical AI
  • Experience working across multiple industry sectors such as defense, logistics, real estate (facilities management), and/or manufacturing
  • Strong understanding of human resource management and a vision for how agents (both physical and digital) may augment/replace human capabilities in the future
  • Prior experience managing research projects or complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives that call for a high level of attention to detail on safety and security
  • Hands-on experience developing, deploying, or operating AI-driven solutions
  • Experience with emerging areas such as agentic AI, world models, reasoning models, robotics, or autonomous weapons policy
  • Publications in large enterprise reports, periodicals, or industry publications.
  • Multilingual capabilities


Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire an Account Executive, Large Enterprise to the Sales & Success team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Success team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like PwC, Publicis Groupe, and Bank of Ireland. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Prospect, develop and close sales opportunities with a focus on acquisition and new logos in the large enterprise segment.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals (prospecting and meetings completed) to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota retirement.
  • Establish deep relationships within your book of business through multi-threading, achieving both executive or VP level and end user engagement.

What you’ll bring

Sprout Social is looking for a highly driven and tech-savvy Account Executive with strong business acumen to join our expanding Large Enterprise sales team. Ideally, you will be equally driven by a customer-centric mentality as well as a desire to find and close new business.

These are the minimum qualifications that our hiring team is looking for in this role:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in B2B sales
  • Proven success selling/cross-selling to large enterprise organizations (5,000+ global employees)
  • Ability to manage a large number of prospective accounts and identify problems, opportunities and consultatively provide solutions for each of them

Additionally, these are the preferred qualifications that would indicate a particularly strong candidate:

  • Experience building relationships, presenting and selling to senior level decision makers across multiple functions
  • SaaS experience preferred
  • Experience working with internal partners and cross-functional stakeholders to increase deal momentum and exceed both prospects and customers expectations

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Partner with Enterprise Leadership to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.
  • Meet with current members of the Enterprise Sales team individually to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gather learnings to implement into your role.
  • Shadow Account Executives on calls live or through Gong to learn sales strategies and positioning.
  • Dive right into our platform to learn about what makes our platform unique, how our solution impacts business objectives and why customers love our solutions.
  • Learn Sprout’s go-to-market messaging, key differentiators, develop and personalize segment-specific value propositions.
  • Learn the relevant customer stories and case studies to justify your value propositions with real ROI examples from the field.
  • Complete a demo and written certification to ensure comprehension.
  • Learn Sprout’s existing customer sales process by shadowing your peers.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Meet with all your existing customers within the book of business and begin the process of building relationships with key strategic stakeholders.
  • Identifying the top 20-25% of new logo opportunities within your book of business to create focus and execution in your weekly prospecting activities.
  • Understand the language of all your customers and where we can expand our offerings by expansion into new business units or increasing utilization of our platform with existing customers.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota attainment after ramp.
  • Co-build account & territory plans with your BDR &, Solutions Engineers teammates.
  • Regularly meet with your BDR to define a relationship that ensures seamless communication and coordination on all net new business generation and expansion opportunities.
  • Conduct active research leveraging all available tools and data sources to understand your customers’ brand, culture, KPIs, partners, and success metrics so you can add value throughout your interactions and become a trusted advisor.
  • Gain a solid understanding of your customer’s internal transitions and mitigate the risk of customer churn.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Have built solid relationships at the C-Level with existing customers within your “book of business".
  • Have built strong internal relationships with your peers, customer success, professional services, solutions engineering, our legal partners and others who will take part in your deal cycles. You will have a deep understanding of each team’s partnership expectations and service level agreement..
  • Have built 4X your monthly quota target of net new logo pipeline.
  • Become a Sprout Social and social media expert to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to help our customers realize their full potential and accomplish their goals.
  • Consistently achieve your monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Mentor and develop your BDR to become best in class at their respective functions and further advance their skill sets and career trajectory.
  • Step up as a peer leader to share best practices across the organization and help others grow from your experiences.
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly activity, pipeline and new business metrics.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Private Health: 100% premium coverage for you and your eligible dependents through AXA Health, including benefits for dental and vision.
  • Pension Scheme: We contribute 4% to your NEST pension (on top of your 5% contribution).
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave, plus all public/bank holidays and additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days.
  • Paid Parental Leave: We support all growing families with 26 weeks of full pay for birthing parents and 16 weeks of full pay for non-birthing parents.
  • Family & Care Support: Access to subsidized child/eldercare through Care.com.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including free coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): An annual $700 USD fund to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Career Development: Full access to our internal Grow@Sprout program for career pathing, plus learning platforms and mentorship.
  • Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible organizations.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

About Global University Systems (GUS)

Global University Systems (GUS) is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.

About the Role

Role Purpose

Seeking an experienced, highly analytical and commercially aware Nigeria Compliance Officer to strengthen the quality and compliance of student recruitment from Nigeria.

The role will be responsible for identifying and mitigating visa and recruitment risks across the Nigerian student pipeline, analysing refusal trends, reviewing applicant profiles and supporting the business and partner universities in improving visa outcomes, student quality and conversion.

This is not a visa application processing role. It is a strategic market compliance role focused on risk identification, analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
