About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a leader in infrastructure system software for AI. We offer an optimised operating system, orchestration, and management to service providers, SaaS companies, and the enterprise. Virtuozzo provides mainframe-like performance, reliability, and security while dramatically lowering overall cost and complexity. We combine deep engineering expertise with a relentless focus on performance, scalability, and innovation.

The Opportunity

Virtuozzo is looking for a Territory Manager to support new-business growth across the Benelux and Nordic regions.

Reporting to the Vice President of Sales EMEA, you will help build a strong pipeline of service-provider opportunities while developing productive relationships with distributors, MSPs, CSPs, hosting companies, resellers, and other technology partners.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone in the early or middle stages of their technology sales career who is ready to take on greater territory ownership. You do not need to arrive with an established network across the entire region. However, you should be proactive, commercially minded, comfortable opening new conversations, and motivated to develop your knowledge of cloud infrastructure.

Virtuozzo follows a partner-first sales model. You will engage directly with prospects while working with the appropriate partners to progress and close opportunities. You will receive support from senior Sales, Technical, Product, and Marketing colleagues throughout the sales cycle.

Your Responsibilities

Territory Development and New Business

  • Contribute to the regional go-to-market plan for the Benelux and Nordic markets.
  • Research and identify target accounts, partners, and new-business opportunities.
  • Build a pipeline of prospective MSP, CSP, hosting, and service-provider customers.
  • Conduct structured outbound prospecting and follow up on leads generated through partners, marketing activities, and events.
  • Qualify opportunities by understanding the prospect’s business needs, infrastructure environment, decision process, and commercial potential.
  • Coordinate opportunities through discovery, technical validation, commercial discussions, and partner-led closure.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and provide clear updates on deal progress, risks, and next steps.
  • Work towards agreed pipeline, new-logo, and revenue objectives.

Channel Development and Execution

  • Build and maintain relationships with distributors, MSPs, CSPs, resellers, hosting providers, and technology partners.
  • Help identify gaps in regional partner coverage and support the recruitment or activation of suitable partners.
  • Work with partners on joint account planning, prospecting, campaigns, and co-selling activities.
  • Help partners understand Virtuozzo’s value proposition and identify suitable customer opportunities.
  • Maintain alignment between Virtuozzo, the prospect, and the transacting partner throughout the sales process.
  • Follow Virtuozzo’s partner-first sales model while remaining accountable for progressing assigned opportunities.

Customer and Prospect Engagement

  • Engage with business owners, infrastructure leaders, technical teams, and other customer stakeholders.
  • Understand each prospect’s business model, infrastructure challenges, growth priorities, and purchasing requirements.
  • Introduce Virtuozzo’s capabilities across virtualisation, hyperconverged infrastructure, storage, and cloud orchestration.
  • Support conversations around infrastructure efficiency, scalability, total cost of ownership, and commercial value.
  • Coordinate demonstrations, workshops, trials, and proof-of-concept activities with Virtuozzo’s technical teams.
  • Bring senior commercial and technical colleagues into opportunities when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent communication with prospects and partners throughout the sales process.

Market Development and Regional Visibility

  • Help increase Virtuozzo’s visibility within the Benelux and Nordic service-provider communities.
  • Support regional partner campaigns, demand-generation activities, and events.
  • Represent Virtuozzo at relevant industry events, partner meetings, and channel forums.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and emerging customer requirements.
  • Share relevant regional feedback with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams.

The Experience You Bring

  • Approximately two to five years of experience in B2B technology sales, business development, channel sales, account management, or a related commercial role.
  • Experience generating new-business conversations and developing a sales pipeline.
  • Exposure to software, cloud services, IT infrastructure, managed services, hosting, telecommunications, or another technical B2B environment.
  • Some experience working with distributors, resellers, MSPs, CSPs, or other channel partners would be an advantage.
  • An interest in developing knowledge of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, storage, Kubernetes, and related technologies.
  • Confidence communicating with both commercial and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organisation, follow-up, and opportunity-management skills.
  • The ability to learn a technical product portfolio and communicate its business value clearly.
  • A proactive and persistent approach to prospecting and relationship development.
  • The ability to work independently within a remote, international organisation while asking for support when needed.
  • Availability to travel for important customer, partner, and industry meetings.

The Profile That Will Succeed

You are commercially curious, proactive, and motivated to build a career in cloud infrastructure sales. You may already have experience as a Business Development Manager, Account Executive, Channel Account Manager, or junior Territory Manager and are now looking for broader ownership.

You enjoy opening new conversations, developing relationships, and turning early interest into qualified opportunities. You are comfortable working with partners and understand that successful channel selling requires consistency, trust, and clear communication.

You do not need to be a cloud infrastructure expert from day one, but you should be interested in the technology and willing to learn. You take responsibility for your work, follow through on commitments, and know when to involve senior commercial or technical colleagues to move an opportunity forward.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to build your commercial career in cloud and infrastructure technology.
  • Real responsibility for developing opportunities across the Benelux and Nordic markets.
  • Support and guidance from experienced Sales, Technical, Product, and Marketing colleagues.
  • A collaborative environment where ideas and market feedback are valued.
  • Remote and flexible working arrangements.
  • Share-option eligibility, subject to the applicable plan terms and approvals.
  • Referral bonuses, recognition programmes, and other engagement opportunities.

jobs.title: Capacity Planner (L6) - Studio Infrastructure
jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Open Connect Infrastructure Capacity Planning team plays a central role in ensuring that our members and internal customers consistently enjoy a seamless experience, achieved through the timely deployment and ongoing management of Netflix’s owned infrastructure capacity. Our team is dedicated to the development of long-range capacity forecasts that are forward-looking, adaptable to rapidly evolving product needs, and focused on efficiency. We collaborate closely with a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders to understand their current and future infrastructure requirements and make strategic recommendations around product implementation and design. Some of our team’s core responsibilities include:

  • Development of Long-Range Infrastructure Capacity Strategies:Create forward-looking strategies that inform long-term financial planning, network design, and near-term deployment and implementation decisions.

  • Effective Infrastructure Allocation: Convert demand forecasts across multiple products into clear, actionable capacity plans and strategic recommendations to drive investment decisions. Balance infrastructure availability across product types.

  • Data-Driven Analyses for Platform Optimization and Scalability: Conduct ongoing, data-driven analyses focused on optimizing efficiency, spend, and architectural direction while ensuring long-term platform scalability and resiliency.

  • Risk Assessment & Management: Identification of potential risks related to capacity shortages or excesses and development of mitigation strategies.

  • Infrastructure Performance Monitoring: Continuous tracking of infrastructure performance and utilization to identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies.

What You'll Do

The Open Connect Capacity Planning team is a centralized group positioned at the intersection of business strategy and implementation. Our mission is to strategically recommend, build, and maintain the right type and quantity of capacity in the right locations and at the right times to ensure high-quality service, efficiency, scalability, and resilience for Netflix and our ISP partners. The primary objectives include developing and executing infra capacity plans, providing technical expertise to leaders, analyzing data to inform capacity decisions, and driving long-term capacity roadmap planning. You will be partnering with stunning colleagues within Product & Technology Engineering organization to assess strategic initiatives, develop actionable insights, and drive operational analytics to inform short term and long term infrastructure strategy for Open connect. This is an individual contributor role that is expected to work with limited supervision on strategic thinking, problem solving, and running cross-functional stakeholder relationships and initiatives. Some of your primary responsibilities include:

  • Translate demand signals(including bandwidth, storage, and network capacity requirements)into actionable capacity forecasts, both short-term and long-term, to inform infrastructure investment and scaling strategies.

  • Conduct what-if analysis and hypothesis testingto assess capacity impacts and trade-offsdriven by specific demand signals and product requirements; present outcomes, insights, risks, and potential mitigations, and define key metrics to support strategic investment and prioritization decisions for leadership, finance, and Engineering & Architecture teams.

  • Orchestrate the timely implementation and allocationof infrastructure augments in coordination with deployment and operational teams.

  • Collaborate cross-functionallywith product managers, Product, Finance & Strategy, TPMs, Engineers, and the Partnerships team to support scaling strategies for new product launches, especially those related to Studio Infrastructure.

  • Develop requirements for modeling and automation tools, continuously evaluating and enhancing workflows, processes, and tools to minimize time spent on modeling and maximize focus on delivering impactful insights, storytelling, and business outcomes.

  • Manage risks and help prioritize competing effortsamong stakeholder and implementation teams by evaluating trade-offs, providing objective recommendations, and constructively pushing back when necessary, including asking whether the potential benefits justify the required effort and spend, to ensure informed decision-making that aligns with organizational goals and business priorities.

Who will be successful in this role?

  • A deeply analytical individual who leverages quantitative methods, statistical tools, and massive datasets to guide capacity choices, utilizing scenario-based and hypothesis-driven models while maintaining objective skepticism in ambiguous situations.

  • A forward-looking planner capable of modeling long-range requirements (5+ years) to ensure platform scalability and create proactive solutions for shared infrastructure across multiple products.

  • Someone who bridges a strong analytical background with sharp product intuition, clarity of thought, and strong communication skills to articulate and deliver on a long-term capacity vision.

  • An action-oriented professional who works effectively and independently in dynamic environments to coordinate cross-functional efforts and drive initiatives forward rapidly.

  • A cross-functional team player who thrives in collaborative settings, partnering smoothly with diverse specialists including engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business groups.

  • An excellent communicator who can distill complex concepts for varied audiences, switch contexts effortlessly, and align competing product initiatives to achieve optimal outcomes.

  • A mindset that prioritizes rapid, iterative delivery over delayed perfection while maintaining high accountability for the final quality of the output.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • At least 5 years of experience in infrastructure capacity planning for data centers or cloud platforms

  • 10+ years of hands-on data analysis and visualization expertise with deep proficiency in SQL (knowledge of Python is a plus)

  • Strong familiarity with or active curiosity about the telecommunications, internet ecosystems, and studio infrastructure

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Proficiency in AI tools

  • A degree in Management Information Systems, Management Consulting, Statistics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

We know great candidates come from a range of backgrounds and paths, so if you don't check every box above but bring strong, relevant experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Join This Team

  • The opportunity to have impact.Consequently, we’re looking for someone with capacity planning experience who is strategic and also likes rolling up their sleeves.

  • Responsibility. Netflix offers true transparency and autonomy. Ourcultureis unique and is key to how we innovate.

  • Learning. You will be creating customer experiences and business models that have never been done before. You will have the opportunity to work with stunning colleagues who value collaboration and from whom you can learn.

  • A work environment where you can grow your career.Many of our top execs started out as individual contributors.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $374,000.00 - $636,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Why AnywhereWorks?

At AnywhereWorks, our mission is simple: Help the world work Anywhere.

We believe where you live shouldn’t limit where you can work. By helping businesses and their teams work from anywhere, we can commute less, pollute less and create more inclusive employment opportunities across more communities.

We’re a global team with big ambitions, and we’re always looking for people who want to learn, grow and make an impact.

And that’s where you come in.

About You.

Do you love turning a great conversation into an opportunity?

Are you confident getting to know businesses, understanding what they really need and showing them how the right service can make a difference?

We’re looking for a Sales Account Executive to join our team across our AnywhereWorks brands.

You’ll play an important part in growing our business, connecting with prospective clients, converting opportunities into sales and building strong relationships from the very first conversation.

You’ll also work closely with our Client Account Managers and wider teams to make sure new clients have a seamless journey from prospect to partner.

What You’ll Be Doing.

  • Connecting with prospective clients to understand their business, challenges and needs.

  • Turning leads into new business and working towards monthly revenue goals.

What You’ll Bring.

Great sales isn’t just about talking – it’s about listening, understanding and building trust.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • 2+ years’ experience in a sales-focused role.

  • Strong active listening skills and the ability to understand what a customer really needs.

  • Confidence building rapport with prospective clients.

  • A positive, ambitious and proactive attitude.

Even Better If You Have...

jobs.excerpt: Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc).
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

This is a remote position.

Job Title
CRM And Key Account Manager
About us
flydocs is an asset management solution provider with the aviation industry’s most comprehensive solution for creating value out of aircraft maintenance data. We offer the tools and expertise that allow all industry stakeholders to drive sustainable innovation to help build the future of the commercial aviation asset lifecycle. Recognised as a global leader in digital records management, we were founded in 2007 and are 100% owned by Lufthansa Technik.
Purpose of the Role
The CRM & Account Manager is responsible for managing, developing, and growing assigned customer accounts across Digital Techops Ecosystem. The role combines strategic account management, operational customer engagement, and commercial ownership to strengthen customer relationships, drive adoption, and create long-term business value.
Team Structure
This role sits within the CRM & Account Management team and works closely with Product Management, R&D, Customer Services, and other teams across the LHT digital ecosystem. The CRM & Account Manager acts as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and connects customer requirements with internal capabilities, ensuring alignment from strategy through execution and commercial growth.
Work Arrangement
You can work from anywhere in EMEA, preferred our existing office locations. While we embrace remote flexibility, we also value human connection, around 25% of your time will involve in-person collaboration, such as workshops, planning sessions, or customer meetings at coworking spaces or regional offices.
Who You Will WorkWith
You will collaborate closely with:
  • Assigned airline and aviation customers and their key stakeholders.
  • Product Management and Product teams across AMOS, Aviatar, and flydocs.
  • R&D / Development teams to address customer requirements and escalations.
  • Customer Services and support teams to ensure effective customer delivery.
  • Commercial and business teams to identify and close growth opportunities.
  • Internal stakeholders across the broader Lufthansa Technik digital ecosystem.
  • Marketing and communication teams for customer communications, surveys, events, and engagement activities.
How You Will Contribute
  • Develop and maintain strategic account plans covering stakeholder mapping, customer risks and opportunities, product interdependencies, and long-term growth objectives.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with assigned customers and act as a consultative strategic partner.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact, ensuring customer needs are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Gather, understand, and communicate customer needs, expectations, feedback, and industry trends, acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Ecosystem.
  • Conduct regular customer reviews and meetings to monitor satisfaction, product adoption, engagement, and areas for improvement.
  • Monitor overall customer health, identify risks early, and coordinate appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Coordinate with Product Management, R&D, Development, and Customer Services to manage escalations and ensure customer commitments are delivered.
  • Keep customers informed about product updates, new features, roadmap developments, and relevant capabilities across AMOS, Aviatar, and flydocs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer adoption and propose tailored solutions based on customer requirements.
  • Maintain accurate customer information, stakeholder records, interactions, and account activities within CRM systems.
  • Lead customer communications such as surveys, mailings, events, and other engagement initiatives.
  • Own commercial discussions for assigned existing accounts and drive opportunities through to closure.
  • Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the LHT digital ecosystem.
  • Build and manage a 3-12 month pipeline of account expansion opportunities.
  • Support customers in planning and prioritising investments, including guidance on applicable charges and budget preparation.
  • Identify and develop strategic reference customers in collaboration with relevant internal teams.
  • Stay informed about aircraft maintenance, aviation industry developments, emerging technologies, and evolving customer needs to proactively strengthen account relationships.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of account management practices and customer experience.
We’d Be Really Happy If You Have:
Must-Have Skills and Experience:
  • Previous experience in aircraft maintenance activities, with a strong understanding of aviation business processes and related software solutions.
  • Proven experience across strategic account management, operational customer support, and commercial ownership.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, willingness to adapt and active listening.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience:
  • Experience managing relationships with airline, MRO, aviation technology, or other enterprise customers.
  • Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance processes and aviation industry requirements.
  • Knowledge of digital techops ecosystem including flydocs, AMOS and aviator products is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify customer needs and translate them into practical solutions and business opportunities.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in upselling, cross-selling, pipeline management, and account growth.
  • University degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM/business collaboration tools such as Zoho, HubSpot, and Confluence.
  • A proactive, flexible, and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Polish Bilingual Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Polish Bilingual Experts to contribute to an impactful language and AI training project for a valued customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to audio clips in Polish and evaluate the nativeness and fluency of the speaker or model output.
  2. Assess pronunciation, intonation, and linguistic authenticity according to established guidelines.
  3. Document your assessments with clear, concise written feedback in English, noting key linguistic factors.
  4. Provide detailed justifications for each evaluation to ensure clarity and consistency in results.
  5. Collaborate with project coordinators to clarify requirements or address ambiguities in language content.
  6. Contribute insights to help improve AI model performance in Polish language understanding and generation.
  7. Ensure timely and accurate completion of assigned audio review tasks, maintaining high standards of quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Native-level proficiency in Polish, with strong command of both spoken and written language.
  2. Minimum B2 level proficiency in English, especially for written and verbal communication.
  3. Background in voice specialization, linguistics, phonetics, music/audio engineering, or related fields is prefered.
  4. Experience with audio analysis, transcription, or linguistic assessment is highly valued.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to articulate nuanced language differences.
  6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and accuracy.
  7. Familiarity with media, communications, or teaching is considered an asset.

About Integrate

Integrate is a B2B demand orchestration platform that helps enterprise marketing teams capture, validate, and activate leads across every channel — turning fragmented demand generation into a unified, measurable pipeline.

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will manage the operational foundation of CaliberMind, Integrate's B2B marketing analytics and revenue-attribution platform: the infrastructure as code, the deployment pipelines, the production access model, the local development experience, and the cloud spend. CaliberMind runs on Google Cloud — GKE, BigQuery, and Dataproc — across roughly 50 services, and your job is to make operating it repeatable. You will report to the Head of Dev & SecOps and work alongside both the CaliberMind engineering team and Integrate's platform group, partnering with IT on authentication and access for corporate systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage infrastructure as code for a Google Cloud estate — plan-on-pull-request, policy checks, consistent provider versions, and reconciled state — moving applies out of local environments and into automation.
  • Migrate deployment pipelines from Google Cloud Build to GitHub Actions, and build the quality and security gates that make a green build meaningful: automated tests, linting, dependency scanning, and container image scanning.
  • Establish immutable artifact promotion, deployment approvals, and reliable rollback across environments.
  • Manage the access model for production systems, including cloud IAM and service accounts, Kubernetes RBAC, database and warehouse access, and the platform's roles, entitlements, and single sign-on; coordinate with IT on authentication for corporate systems.
  • Establish a dependency and platform upgrade cadence across a multi-language estate (Node/TypeScript, Python, and Scala/Spark), including automated dependency updates and managed database migrations.
  • Partner with engineering and finance on cloud cost management, including committed-use discounts, data warehouse capacity planning, and project sprawl.
  • Extend the Docker Compose local development environment so that it includes its own databases, seed data, and production-parity dependencies, enabling engineers to be productive on their first day.
  • Improve observability and monitoring, contribute to on-call practice as the team grows, and support the SOC 2 program from the engineering side.
  • Document infrastructure, runbooks, and operational processes so that operational knowledge is shared across the team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, directly managing production systems
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform in a team setting, including modules, remote state, and disciplined plan and apply workflows managed through an automation platform (Terrakube, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, Spacelift, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and Helm, including deploying, debugging, and upgrading production workloads
  • Experience with a major cloud provider; Google Cloud preferred, though strong AWS or Azure experience is transferable
  • Demonstrated experience authoring CI/CD pipelines; GitHub Actions preferred, with Cloud Build, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or Jenkins also applicable
  • Proficiency with Docker and Docker Compose, including multi-service local development environments
  • Comfort working in a Linux shell and in at least one scripting language, such as Python, Bash, or TypeScript
  • Experience with AI-assisted development, including working with coding agents and integrating AI code review or agent-driven automation into CI pipelines, preferred
  • Familiarity with secrets management such as Secret Manager, Vault, SOPS, or KMS-encrypted configuration, preferred
  • Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, SAML SSO, or OAuth 2.0/OIDC, preferred
  • Exposure to BigQuery, Dataproc, or other data platform infrastructure, preferred
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization, including committed-use discounts, reservations, and rightsizing, preferred
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 or a compliance program such as Vanta or Drata, preferred
  • Strong written communication and a habit of documenting what you build
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Atkinson Aeronautics & Technology DBA Ataero is Hiring!

Position: US Army Field Service Representative (FSR)

2 positions

Full Time – Contract

Remote in CONUS; ON-SITE OCONUS – Supporting US Army Program
Travel: Up to 60% OCONUS & CONUS - AOR for Travel - ARCENT

Who We Are

Founded in 2007, Atkinson Aeronautics & Technology is a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that is ISO compliant. We offer a broad range of technical services and aviation operations and specialize in ITAR-compliant technology services, course development, training, simulation sales and services, and technical support to Department of Defense customers.

Position Summary

Atkinson Aeronautics & Technology is seeking an experienced Army Field Service Representative (FSR) to support an Electronic Warfare (EW) pod Research and Development (R&D) program supporting activities in CONUS and OCONUS. Ideal candidate is located in West Coast.

The FSR will serve as an Electronic Warfare (EW) and Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) subject matter expert supporting the development, integration, testing, fielding, training, and operational employment of an advanced EW pod capability.

This position will work closely with U.S. Army operational personnel, Government program representatives, engineers, developers, test organizations, and other stakeholders to provide operational feedback and ensure the capability meets Army mission requirements.

A primary responsibility of the position will be providing hands-on technical and operational training on the EW pod to Army personnel at CONUS and OCONUS locations. The FSR will also support R&D, system demonstrations, operational assessments, exercises, testing, troubleshooting, and field-support activities.

The position is primarily remote when not traveling and requires extensive travel throughout the United States and overseas (ARCENT AOR)

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as an EW/EMSO Field Service Representative and Subject Matter Expert supporting an advanced Army EW pod R&D program.
  • Provide operational and technical expertise regarding Electronic Warfare (EW), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), and electromagnetic spectrum-dependent operations.
  • Support the development, integration, testing, evaluation, fielding, and operational employment of the EW pod.
  • Provide hands-on operator and technical training on the EW pod to U.S. Army personnel at CONUS and OCONUS locations.
  • Develop, update, and deliver training materials, operator instruction, technical presentations, demonstrations, and other training products.
  • Support system demonstrations, test events, operational assessments, Army exercises, fielding activities, and other program events.
  • Provide feedback to engineers and developers based on operational experience, Army user requirements, system performance, and lessons learned from field activities.
  • Serve as a liaison between Army operators, Government program personnel, engineers, developers, test personnel, and other program stakeholders.
  • Assist users with system setup, operation, configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and employment of the EW pod.
  • Support troubleshooting of hardware, software, integration, communications, and operational issues associated with the system.
  • Evaluate system performance during testing, exercises, demonstrations, and operational use and document observations and recommendations.
  • Assist with the development and refinement of tactics, techniques, procedures, training concepts, and operational employment recommendations associated with the EW capability.
  • Collect and communicate operator feedback, technical discrepancies, system performance information, and lessons learned to Government and engineering teams.
  • Support system upgrades, modifications, configuration changes, software updates, and technical refresh activities.
  • Provide field-level technical assistance to Army units operating or evaluating the system.
  • Develop and maintain field reports, trip reports, training documentation, technical documentation, status reports, and other program deliverables.
  • Maintain professional relationships with Army customers, Government representatives, operational units, engineering teams, and other program stakeholders.
  • Perform additional EW, EMSO, R&D, training, and field-support duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of Electronic Warfare (EW) and/or Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) experience within a U.S. military or DoD environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Electronic Warfare principles, EMSO, electromagnetic spectrum operations, and operational employment of EW capabilities.
  • Experience operating, supporting, maintaining, integrating, testing, or training personnel on EW systems, electronic attack/electronic support capabilities, sensors, pods, or other spectrum-dependent military systems.
  • Experience providing technical or operational training to military personnel.
  • Ability to translate complex EW and technical concepts into effective operator-level instruction.
  • Experience supporting military exercises, test events, demonstrations, fielding events, or operational missions.
  • Ability to work directly with military operators, Government personnel, engineers, developers, and program leadership.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in field environments and at geographically dispersed locations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Ability and willingness to perform extensive CONUS and OCONUS travel.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance.
  • Ability to obtain required Government, installation, network, and system access credentials.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior U.S. Army experience in Electronic Warfare, EMSO, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), aviation EW, spectrum management, or a related operational specialty.
  • Previous experience as a Field Service Representative (FSR), EW Instructor, EW Subject Matter Expert, or Technical Representative.
  • Experience supporting airborne or podded Electronic Warfare systems.
  • Experience with EW system Research, Development, Test and Evaluation (RDT&E).
  • Experience supporting developmental testing, operational testing, system integration, or capability demonstrations.
  • Experience supporting Army EW organizations, operational units, acquisition programs, or test organizations.
  • Experience developing or refining Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) for EW or EMSO capabilities.
  • Experience conducting New Equipment Training (NET), operator training, or train-the-trainer instruction.
  • Experience providing technical or operational support in deployed or austere OCONUS environments.
  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret (TS) clearance, if required by the program.

Work Location

Remote – Supporting US Army - FSR Westcoast

The employee will primarily work remotely when not supporting testing, training, integration, exercises, demonstrations, or field activities. Travel to Point Mugu, Army installations, test ranges, training locations, operational sites, and other Government facilities will be required based on mission requirements in CONUS. Extensive travel to OCONUS - ARCENT AOR

Travel Required

Extensive – Up to 60%

Travel is a significant component of this position and will include EW pod training, R&D and test events, system demonstrations, exercises, fielding, and operational support at U.S. and overseas locations.

Candidates must be able and willing to travel for extended periods when required by the program.

Benefits We Have to Offer

  • 401K Retirement Plan – including up to a 6% dollar-for-dollar match
  • PTO (Paid Time Off)
  • All Federal Paid Holidays
  • Tuition Assistance and professional training
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Competitive salary based on experience and technical qualifications

We're building a real-time facility navigation and asset-tracking platform for industrial and logistics sites - GPS/BLE-based positioning, live forklift and asset overlays, zone/dwell analytics, and a driver-facing mobile app, backed by a distributed-systems (actor-model) backend.


The Role

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer with a strong frontend focus to join the development of a real-time, data-driven platform.

Most of your work will focus on the React Native driver app, Mapbox GL JS features and the web-based admin portal, while also contributing to C#/.NET backend services when needed.

You'll work on interactive, real-time experiences involving live location, sensor and asset data, with a strong focus on performance and usability.

Responsibilities: Frontend (Primary)

  • Build and maintain the React Native driver app: QR onboarding/consent flows, GPS/BLE data display
  • Implement Mapbox GL JS features: live position overlays, zone/dwell visualization, realtime map layers
  • Own frontend performance and reliability for realtime, sensor-driven UI

Responsibilities: Backend (Secondary)

  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services in C#/.NET
  • Support GPS/BLE positioning data ingestion pipelines
  • Support telemetry ingestion and zone/dwell analytics processing
  • Work within an actor-model distributed backend (built on Microsoft Orleans) designed by the tech lead

Requirements

  • 2–5 years of professional software development experience;
  • Strong experience with React and/or React Native, with solid knowledge of modern frontend development practices;
  • Experience building interactive, data-driven user interfaces;
  • Experience with Mapbox GL JS or other mapping/geospatial technologies such as Leaflet or Google Maps is highly valued;
  • Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs;
  • Comfortable working with real-time data, such as WebSockets, live updates, telemetry or similar;
  • Some professional experience with C#/.NET, or a strong willingness to work with it as part of a fullstack role;
  • Strong written and spoken English for daily collaboration with a distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with distributed systems / actor-model concepts (e.g., Orleans, Akka)
  • Experience with BLE positioning or beacon technology
  • Background in industrial, logistics, or IoT/telemetry domains
  • Security-conscious development practices (authentication, PII handling

Benefits

  • Remote work (Vietnam-based)
  • Estimated project duration: 19 weeks
  • Full-time schedule: 8 hours per day, with mandatory availability for at least 4 hours
  • Freelance / Service Agreement
  • Hourly Rate: 12$-16$

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Director, Group Medicare Account Management is a strategic people-leader role responsible for translating the Group Medicare client engagement strategy into consistent execution across an assigned portfolio, team, or functional area.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Director, Group Medicare Account Management is a strategic people-leader role responsible for translating the Group Medicare client engagement strategy into consistent execution across an assigned portfolio, team, or functional area. Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Client Engagement & Excellence, the Director leads account management performance, client retention, experience, renewal readiness, and continuous improvement within the scope of responsibility.

The Director, Group Medicare Account Management advances Account Management from relationship management toward disciplined value delivery by establishing clear operating practices, coaching leaders and associates, and coordinating cross-functional partners to achieve measurable client, member, financial, and operational outcomes.

Key responsibilities include coordinating cross-functional teams, managing complex client portfolios, and proactively identifying opportunities for process enhancements that improve service delivery. The Director also serves as a key point of contact for issue resolution, contract renewals, and strategic consultation, ensuring that client expectations align with organizational capabilities and regulatory requirements.



The role has full accountability for:

  • Retention, renewal, and experience performance for the assigned client portfolio
  • Client and Member Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvement within the area of responsibility
  • Account Management team effectiveness, capacity, and consistent execution
  • Senior client relationships, governance, and issue escalation
  • Cross-functional coordination to deliver service, Stars, network, enrollment, and financial commitments


Enterprise Client Ownership & Value Delivery:

  • Lead client value delivery for an assigned portfolio, team, or functional area, with accountability for retention, renewal readiness, experience, and growth execution
  • Apply the portfolio segmentation and service strategy established by the Associate Vice President, tailoring account plans based on risk, value, and client needs
  • Build senior relationships with priority clients and lead governance forums, business reviews, and escalated issue resolution
  • Translate enterprise priorities including growth, Stars, margin discipline, and experience—into team goals and client-specific actions
  • Identify emerging risks and opportunities and recommend interventions to the Associate Vice President
  • Stars Activation – engage clients to promote/educate members on importance of Stars/clinical actions to improve health outcomes and CMS Stars metrics
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key clients, brokers, and internal stakeholders to support retention and growth initiatives to improve NPS.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with actuarial, clinical, legal, pharmacy, and operations teams to deliver optimal solutions for clients and address complex client needs.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant regulations and contractual obligations within Group Medicare offerings.
  • Provide regular updates to customers on Humana initiatives, CMS updates, news releases and Industry matters (e.g. Inflation Reduction Act, Bridge, Risk Score Normalization changes).
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, leveraging subject matter expertise to address complex issues, and facilitating informed decision-making to drive optimal outcomes. Consistent communication and a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Legal mindset to mitigate risks and maintain contract integrity. When necessary, participating in escalated legal issues by providing research and documentation
  • Support Group Medicare team by close market collaboration regarding provider network negotiations and terminations that impact client retention and member satisfaction outcomes
  • Monitor account performance, financial metrics, and client satisfaction to inform business decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Responsible to develop and obtain legal approval for Contract Amendments, secure renewal package signatures to solidify Humana's legal protection for products and rates sold
  • HR functions (i.e. performance evaluations of Sr. AEs, AEs and CEPs, timesheets, staffing)
  • Daily oversight of ongoing client relationship management expectations

Strategic Initiatives Ownership



This leader will lead or co-lead initiatives within the assigned scope, including:

  • Client Experience Improvement: Execute NPS action plans, improve first-year onboarding, and strengthen service consistency
  • Account Management Effectiveness: Implement portfolio segmentation, optimize caseloads, and build team capabilities
  • Renewal Excellence: Improve renewal readiness, pricing coordination, negotiation support, and margin discipline
  • Service Model Optimization: Standardize delivery practices, reduce avoidable customization, and improve efficiency
  • Retention & Loyalty: Strengthen at-risk account management, client tenure, and strategic partnership execution
  • Governance & Reporting: Maintain dashboards, operating reviews, and transparent reporting for portfolio performance


Cross-Functional Integration & Execution

  • Coordinate execution across Sales, Pricing, Finance, Network, Stars, Clinical, Operations, Digital, Marketing, and Product partners
  • Clarify ownership, milestones, and escalation paths for renewals, repricing, network changes, advocacy efforts, and Stars initiatives
  • Resolve cross-functional barriers within the Director's authority and elevate enterprise-level decisions to the Associate Vice President
  • Promote end-to-end accountability and transparent reporting for client outcomes
  • Participation in new client assignments and ongoing case load discussions tied to assignments for AEs.
  • Oversee the execution of renewal/contract negotiations for existing clients/consultants and new clients with the assistance of key internal Subject Matter Experts (SME) and legal.
  • Oversee Renewal RFP activities, ensure that strategy and direction are being carried out in proposal contents; work with SMEs on complex, custom requirements; read and edit RFPs before external submission
  • Lead renewal planning and execution for the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate, timely, and competitive renewal deliverables
  • Coordinate with Sales, Pricing, Finance, Product, and Account Management leaders to develop recommendations that balance retention, affordability, and margin expectations
  • Support or lead negotiations within delegated authority and escalate material tradeoffs or exceptions to the Associate Vice President
  • Monitor renewal milestones, risks, and dependencies; implement recovery plans when performance is off track
  • Ensure effective execution of plan build, client communications, enrollment readiness, and post-renewal follow-through
  • Provide support partnership with internal/vendor leaders to the Account Executive to present new products and services to clients (e.g., new clinical programs, initiatives, annual benefit changes, annual CMS changes)


Implementation:

  • Oversee and approve implementation plan to ensure client expectations are met
  • Oversee implementation of new business and renewals with Sr. AE/AE/CEP. Participate in the initial implementation set-up and planning meeting activities with the new account. Provide ongoing management support to Sr. AE/AE/CEP during implementation. Interact with Group Medicare Operations leadership as needed
  • Serve as an escalation point for account management, GM Sales Executive, implementation team, internal partners and client. Engage in development and delivery of external messaging on sensitive subject matters.

AI Enablement & Intelligent Automation

  • Implement approved AI and automation capabilities across Account Management workflows to improve productivity, consistency, and client experience
  • Identify high-value use cases in renewal preparation, client reporting, meeting follow-up, member engagement, and knowledge management
  • Partner with Digital, IT, Enterprise AI, Compliance, and business teams to pilot, adopt, and scale solutions within enterprise standards
  • Track adoption and value measures such as reduced administrative workload, improved cycle times, increased capacity, quality, and client satisfaction
  • Build team fluency through training, workflow integration, and responsible-use expectations
  • Recommend future capabilities and investment priorities to the Associate Vice President


Client & Member Experience (NPS Ownership)

  • Drive Client and Member NPS improvement for the assigned portfolio or functional area
  • Analyze feedback, service data, and root causes to prioritize practical experience improvements
  • Lead improvements in onboarding, service consistency, first-call resolution, communications, and outreach
  • Partner with Customer Service, Digital, and Operations to implement coordinated, measurable improvements across the client and member journey
  • Lead continuous improvement in member engagement, communications, enrollment, implementation, and client reporting processes


Leadership & Culture:

  • Build and sustain a high-performing, client-centric team grounded in The Humana Way
  • Set clear goals, decision rights, performance expectations, and accountability measures
  • Coach leaders and associates, address performance gaps, recognize strong contributions, and support succession readiness
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • The GM Director will meet monthly or more frequently with each assigned Sr. AE, AE and CEP to outline their expectations for each client within their book of business
  • Set retention targets for each Sr. AE and AE and ensure retention targets and associated sales incentive payments are accurate


Use your skills to make an impact


Required Qualifications and Leadership Profile:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
  • Extensive experience (typically 8+ years) in Medicare, managed care, health insurance, or regulated-industry experience, including 2-5+ years of people leadership
  • Demonstrated expertise in client relationship management, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong knowledge of client engagement, account management, renewals, service delivery, and financial or operational performance management
  • Strong presentation and meeting facilitation skills
  • Negotiation and conflict resolution skills
  • Communication/customer service & collaborating skills are crucial since serving/interacting with numerous internal HUM client areas
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners, communicate complex information clearly, and translate strategy into executable plans
  • Track record of developing talent, leading change, improving retention and experience, and building scalable operating practices
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled tools, automation, data governance, and responsible adoption in business workflows preferred
  • Ability to travel – 50% or more
  • Life and health license

Additional Information:

Success Measures

  • Client and membership retention
  • Client and Member NPS improvement
  • Renewal quality, timeliness, and margin performance
  • At-risk account stabilization and service performance
  • Administrative efficiency, AI adoption, and productivity improvement
  • Employee engagement, talent development, and team effectiveness

Job Description:

THE OPPORTUNITY

Scholastic (“the Company”) is the world's largest publisher and distributor of children's books, a leading provider of literacy curriculum and professional services, and a producer of educational and entertaining children's media. The Company creates quality books and ebooks, print and technology-based learning programs for K-12 classroom magazines and other products and services that support children's learning both in school and at home. With operations in 14 international offices and exports to 165 countries, Scholastic makes quality, affordable books available to all children around the world through school-based book clubs and book fairs, classroom collections, school and public libraries, retail and online.

WHY?

For more than a century, Scholastic Education has played a defining role in expanding access to literacy and learning for children everywhere. That mission remains critical today, even as the PK-12 education market has undergone a structural reset. Growth now depends far less on funding alignment and far more on disciplined sales execution, trusted relationships, and clear, defensible value. Scholastic is uniquely positioned to lead. As one of the few scaled, publicly traded companies in PK-12 education, the company is pairing its 100+ year literacy mission with renewed leadership, stronger operating discipline, and a sharper focus on accountability and data. This Regional VP of Sales role will be critical to the Scholastic Education’s ongoing evolution and modernization.

WHAT?

The Director of Sales Operations is responsible for guiding the strategic direction and execution of teams that support the organization's commercial capabilities. This role enhances revenue effectiveness by establishing measurable processes to improve efficiency in channel execution and setting growth objectives. The Director of Sales Operations works closely with the sales, operations, product, marketing and finance teams to develop strategies, implement performance metrics, design and deliver enablement and training programs, and ensure alignment on priority projects and improvement infinitives. This position oversees all aspects of channel execution and go-to-market (GTM) operations, ensuring that revenue-generating teams have the necessary resources and technology to effectively engage with customers and drive the divisions revenue growth. They will work hand in hand with the CRO, providing dynamic leadership, delivering accurate reporting and improving process documentation and implementation fidelity.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following areas:

  • Collaborates with sales and channel leadership to achieve growth goals, aligning go-to-market strategies across acquisition, utilization, and retention.

  • Works with accounting, finance, and HR to establish sales compensation rules and procedures.

GOVERNANCE AND YOUR KEY RELATIONSHIPS

The Director of Sales Operations is involved in governance areas such as business strategy, enterprise architecture, IT, and marketing planning. This role requires building strategic relationships with key stakeholders:

  • Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) and senior executives: Engages to understand organizational goals and ensure alignment in internal and external activities.

  • Sales and Marketing VPs: Collaborates to align resources, evaluate risks, and drive organizational transformation.

  • Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and IT leadership: Partners to execute technology opportunities and ensure data integrity in GTM systems.

  • Chief Operations Officer (COO) and Operations leadership: Sales Operations partners with Operations to align forecasting, processes, and execution priorities, ensuring resources, capacity, and customer delivery stay tightly coordinated with revenue goals.

  • Human resources (HR) team: Collaborates to design sales enablement programs and establish sales compensation policies.

Thank you for your consideration in choosing Scholastic.

At Axil Health, we're not just talking about the future of healthcare – we're creating it. We combine cutting-edge patient monitoring technology with compassionate, personalized care to transform the lives of those with chronic conditions. Our integrated approach brings together doctors, pharmacists, and care specialists like you to provide unparalleled support to our patients.

We're a company of thinkers, doers, problem-solvers, builders, and patient advocates. People who see a gap and close it, not wait for someone else to.

  • You'll work cross-functionally, connected to a mission that touches clinical operations, technology, and patient care at every turn.

People thrive at Axil Health when they're motivated by the actual outcome of the work: helping patients manage chronic conditions and stay connected to care between visits. This isn't a fast-growth tech culture chasing headcount for its own sake. It's a small, mission-driven team where individual contributions are visible and accountability matters.

The strongest fits tend to be people who:

  • Care about the patient behind the data point. Whether you're in clinical operations, care navigation, or support functions, the work touches real people managing real health conditions.
  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and building, not just maintaining. We're still defining processes in many areas, so people who can bring structure without waiting to be told exactly how do well.

Why You'll Love Working at Axil Health:

  • Work with a passionate team that feels like family
  • Gain experience with cutting-edge healthcare technologies
  • Enjoy a supportive work environment that encourages professional growth
  • Be part of a company that's shaping the future of healthcare
  • Competitive salary and benefits package

Join Us in Transforming Lives!

If you're ready to take your patient care skills to the next level and be part of a healthcare revolution, we want to hear from you! At Axil Health, you're not just filling a position – you're embarking on a mission to change lives.

Apply now and let's create healthier tomorrows together!

PURPOSEOFPOSITION:

Axil Health is a privately owned pharmacist collective offering both independent pharmacy, consulting, and clinical services located inside established medical facilities. The Pharmacy Intern role plays a vital role in supporting pharmacists and healthcare providers in delivering exceptional patient care within a clinical environment. This position is responsible for working with the pharmacist in charge to assist with patient engagement, documentation and chart preparation, task coordination, and administrative tasks.

MAJORRESPONSIBILITIES&ACCOUNTABILITIES:

1. Patient Engagement:

· Conduct monthly check-in calls with patients enrolled in Chronic Care Management (CCM), assessing health status, medication adherence, and addressing any concerns.

· Make daily compliance calls to patients enrolled in Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), ensuring adherence to monitoring protocols, addressing issues promptly and analyzing proper monitoring technique and compliance to medications.

· Perform medication reconciliations with patients who have upcoming appointments or medication concerns.

· Perform post visit check ins with patient to help close any gaps in care.

2. Documentation and Chart Preparation:

· Prepare patient charts for upcoming CCM encounters, ensuring all necessary documentation is complete and up-to-date.

· Document all patient interactions, interventions, and outcomes accurately in electronic health records (EHR) system, adhering to compliance standards.

3. Task Coordination:

· Coordinate with clinical pharmacists regarding urgent health-related needs, medication refills, and appointment requests communicated by patients.

· Temporarily pause CCM services for patients who cannot be reached until re-engagement is achieved, ensuring continuity of care.

· Assign tasks to yourself for follow-up on previous months phone calls

4. AdministrativeTasks:

· Complete data entry functions accurately, including updating patient records, documenting interactions, and generating reports.

· Utilize software programs for organizing and managing patient information effectively, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity.

5. Compliance and Time Documentation:

· Document compliance with daily tasks such as patient calls, chart preparation, and administrative duties, maintaining accurate records.

· Track time spent on each task throughout the day using designated time-tracking tools or methods to ensure efficient workflow management.

6. Professional Development:

· Stay updated on best practices, guidelines, and regulations related to Chronic Care Management (CCM) and Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM).

· Participate in training sessions or educational opportunities to enhance skills and knowledge in healthcare delivery, compliance, and patient engagement.

7. Team Collaboration:

· Communicate effectively with clinical pharmacists, fellow care managers, and other healthcare team members, sharing insights and collaborating on patient care plans.

· Participate in team meetings or case conferences to discuss patient progress, share best practices, and address any challenges or barriers to care delivery.

jobs.description:
We are hiring a Founder Relations Associate to be the first person founders speak to at Pairs, and to help the right ones start working with us.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

Founders who are raising hear a lot of pitches. Yours is the conversation that earns their trust, because it is about their raise, not about us.

On the first call, you learn where the company is, how much it is raising, who is already interested and what has stalled. Then you decide, with them, whether Pairs is the right next step.

When it is, you walk them through how we work and what it costs, and book the next conversation on the call. When it is not, you tell them so, and stay in touch until the timing is right.

Some founders are better served by our platform tier. For them, you run the demo and close it yourself.

We work with founders across the US, Europe and the Middle East. The expectations you set are the ones we deliver against, so you only promise what we do.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our closing team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen companies, what we decline and why.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • First conversations. A call that leaves every founder better informed about their raise, whether or not they work with us.

  • The founder's picture. Round, traction, runway, investor interest and the real blocker, captured clearly for the team.

  • The next step. Booked on the call, with the context the next person needs.

  • Founder relationships. The founders who are not ready yet, kept warm until they are.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have worked closely with founders: at an accelerator, a VC platform team, a startup, or in a founder-facing commercial role.

  • Have turned conversations into commitments, and can walk us through one where the founder was hesitant.

  • Understand how a raise works: stage, round structure, lead investors, and why investors pass.

  • Set expectations you can stand behind. You never promise an outcome, and you would rather lose a deal than oversell one.

  • Build trust quickly with founders from different markets and backgrounds.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About the Role

Aligned is looking to add a Project Manager, Compliance to support our growth. This role leads enterprise-wide compliance projects that enable the company to obtain, maintain, and expand sustainability and energy certifications across its data center portfolio. The Project Manager is operationally focused: they run the work in live, mission-critical environments, drive cross-functional execution, and keep audit-ready evidence, schedules, and decisions moving until certification or recertification is complete.

The ideal candidate has a compliance-analyst foundation and/ or is knowledgeable with controls, evidence, findings, and auditors. Additionally, they will have proven experience leading end-to-end enterprise projects. They partner daily with External Audit firms and internal owners in Finance, IT, Legal, Operations, Facilities, EHS, and Sustainability. Success is measured by on-time certification outcomes, clean audit cycles, and disciplined project control.

What You Will Own

  • Lead end-to-end project plans for enterprise sustainability and energy compliance initiatives (examples: ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, SOC2, PCI, or equivalent portfolio programs).
  • Build and maintain integrated schedules covering evidence collection, gap remediation, internal readiness reviews, external audit windows, and certification body submissions.
  • Serve as the single operational point of contact for External Audit teams: coordinate site access, document requests, interviews, findings responses, and management representations.
  • Coordinate stakeholder mapping with Finance, IT, Legal, Operations, Facilities, EHS, and Sustainability so owners, due dates, and artifacts are unambiguous.
  • Track scope, risks, issues, dependencies, and change control; escalate early when audit findings, data gaps, or operational constraints threaten the critical path.
  • Ensure projects do not compromise uptime, change-management discipline, or physical/cyber security requirements in live data centers.
  • Establish a repeatable evidence repository (policies, SOPs, meters and utility data, training records, incident logs, contractor controls) that can be reused across sites and audit cycles.
  • Prepare executive and steering-committee status: milestone health, open findings, budget vs. plan, and go/no-go recommendations for audit and submission dates.
  • Drive post-audit remediation and recertification cadence so certifications remain current as the portfolio grows or operating conditions change.
  • Capture lessons learned and harden standard work so subsequent sites and programs require less reinventing.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Compliance, Operations, Engineering, Environmental/Energy Management, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • 3 or more years as a Project Manager leading Operational projects end-to-end.
  • 3 or more years as a Compliance Analyst (or equivalent compliance / internal-controls / audit-support role) supporting enterprise or multi-site programs.
  • Additional experience leading end-to-end enterprise-level projects from kickoff through close, including schedule ownership, stakeholder management, and delivery against committed dates.
  • Demonstrated work with third-party auditors or certification bodies: evidence requests, findings, and remediation tracking.
  • Working knowledge of at least one energy or environmental management / certification framework relevant to data centers (ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, SOC2, PCI, or comparable), or clear ability to apply a compliance-analyst skill set to those frameworks.
  • Ability to run projects in live 24x7 operations without disrupting availability or violating change-control standards.
  • Strong written communication for audit narratives, evidence indexes, and executive status.
  • Proficiency with project tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent), AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, and the Microsoft 365 suite.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct data center, oil and gas, renewable energy, public utility, or comparable industry experience.
  • PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential.
  • Experience coordinating enterprise PMO governance, internal audit, SOC-style evidence processes, or customer sustainability questionnaires alongside formal certifications.
  • Prior partnership with Big 4, specialist sustainability consultants, or accredited certification bodies.

Competencies That Distinguish Success:

  • Compliance analyst rigor; knows the difference between a policy, a control, and proof the control operated.
  • Enterprise project leadership; can take a multi-function certification program from charter to closed audit.
  • Operational discipline; treats audits like production events: sequenced, documented, and reversible if something slips.
  • Cross-functional gravity; can get Finance, Legal, IT, and site ops to produce the same artifact on the same date.

Benefits & Perks:

Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Eligible employees have access to:

  • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts: HSA with employer contribution for eligible participants. FSA's offered for health and dependent care to increase tax savings.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with company match
  • Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay
  • Company-Sponsored Insurance: Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability (with medical election)
  • Optional Benefits: Voluntary life, critical illness, legal, and additional disability coverage
  • Wellness Programs: Employee assistance program (EAP), Wellhub gym membership, and other wellness initiatives

It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

At Aligned, we are committed to transparency and fostering a positive employee experience from your very first interaction with us. In compliance with Illinois pay disclosure requirements, when you join Aligned, you’ll have access to the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short and long disability, life insurance and other voluntary benefits, 401k with employer match, bonus opportunities, paid time off, wellness benefits and professional development opportunities, all designed to support your well-being and career growth. At Digital Forms we help mid-sized service businesses go through digital transformation — part consulting, part building the software ourselves. And when you build the software yourself, quality isn't a checkbox at the end. It's where the whole promise gets kept or broken.

We're kicking off a new module of a platform we've already built for an existing client from the USA, operating in a regulated domain. Design work (UX/UI and architecture) starts now, and development follows right after — which means we want a QA Engineer in the room from the very beginning, not called in once the bugs start piling up.

The good news: requirements are already defined. You won't spend your first month guessing what to test. You can get hands-on from day one — shaping the test strategy, writing test cases, and owning the QA scope end-to-end as the module takes shape around you.

It's a hands-on role in an international setup: the team is mostly Polish, the client is American, and all project documentation, specifications, and bug reports are in English — with regular meetings with the client team.

The engagement: full-time. Around 60% of your time will go to the new module — that project runs from mid-July to 10 November — with the rest supporting other projects across our portfolio. And if the collaboration works well, we're open to continuing beyond November.

Requirements

What you'll be doing

  • Functional and regression testing of web portal applications

  • Integration testing across platform components

  • Testing in AWS-based environments

  • Writing and maintaining test cases, test plans, and bug reports in English

  • Collaborating with developers, PM, and the international client team

  • Participating in QA process definition and continuous improvement — if you see a better way to do things, we want to hear it

Requirements

Hard skills:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience in software QA / testing

  • Familiarity with standard testing tools (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Postman, or similar)

Soft skills & logistics:

Nice to have

  • ISTQB certification

  • API testing and CI/CD pipeline experience

  • Previous experience in fast-paced consulting or client-facing projects

What we offer

  • 100% remote, full-time

  • A new module with requirements already defined — hands-on work from day one

  • International project for a US client in a meaningful, regulated domain — with an AI/automation element in scope

  • A clear rhythm: daily standups, bi-weekly planning and review/demo, team retros as agreed with the team

  • Collaborative, flat team structure — your voice on QA process counts

  • Strong extension potential beyond the first project

Highlights

Own quality end-to-end on a brand-new module for a US client in a regulated domain — hands-on, in the room from the first sprint, with requirements ready and waiting for you.
