Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Analyst, FP&A

Location: Remote | USA, Canada
Reports to: Senior Manager, FP&A

Employment Type: Full-time

This is a new vacancy

About the Role:

The Senior Analyst, FP&A will lead core financial planning, analysis, and performance management activities across JD Power’s Dealer and FSAAS (Financial Services and other Adjacent Services) GTM (Go-To-Market) verticals. This role will own key forecasting and reporting processes, develop scalable financial models and executive-ready insights, and partner directly with Finance leadership, product & business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape investment decisions, product roadmap prioritization, resource allocation, and strategic planning in a fast-moving, data-driven environment.

This position is well-suited for a seasoned, highly analytical finance professional who can independently lead complex analyses, influence senior product and technology partners, create new planning and reporting capabilities, and translate financial insights into clear recommendations that support product and technology priorities across the Dealer and FSAAS verticals.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead budgeting, planning, forecasting, reporting, and financial performance management processes for key areas across the Dealer and FSAAS verticals.
  • Create and enhance financial models, KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and planning frameworks that improve executive visibility and enable data-driven product investment decisions.
  • Use BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar), SQL/Databricks/Snowflake, and financial systems to design and deliver accurate, scalable reporting on Dealer and FSAAS top-line performance, and key business drivers.
  • Develop insights and recommendations for business leaders on budget performance, variance drivers, forecast risks and opportunities, investment trade-offs, and cost-optimization opportunities across technology investments and vendor spend.
  • Support the development of monthly and quarterly executive and board-level materials, translating complex financial and operational data into clear narratives for senior technology and product leadership.
  • Drive cross-functional planning with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to align roadmap planning, investment priorities, and resource allocation decisions.
  • Identify, develop, and implement process improvements and automation opportunities, including use of AI tools and data automation to increase forecast accuracy, planning efficiency, and executive visibility.
  • Lead ad hoc financial analyses and special projects for the FP&A leadership, CFO, and Dealer & FSAAS leadership, including framing the business question, building the analysis, and communicating actionable recommendations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related analytical discipline.
  • 8-10 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, FP&A, corporate finance, product/technology operations, or a related analytical role; experience supporting executive, product, and technology leadership is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in SaaS/technology companies and private equity portfolio company environments is strongly preferred.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including experience with pivot tables, lookups, and structured financial analysis; familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead financial planning processes, create new analytical frameworks, influence cross-functional product and technology stakeholders, and turn data into executive-level recommendations.
  • Ability to communicate financial concepts clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Comfort working independently, managing ambiguity, and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Familiarity with operating expense management, headcount planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and executive reporting is a strong plus. Experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, Adaptive Planning, Tableau, Power BI, or similar systems is also valued.

Compensation and Benefits


This position has a starting salary range of $80,000 - $94,000 USDper year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.excerpt: About Accelerant Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers.
jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

The Opportunity

This role is for someone who helps shape what’s worth building, designs it by building, and owns the result in production. You explore and prototype like a designer, then carry the strong ideas all the way to a shipped front-end, the exploration and the building as one craft rather than two stages with a handoff between them.

That’s possible because of how we work. When the same person designs and builds, there’s no spec to hand off and no rebuild cycle, so the work moves faster and the original intent carries straight through. You work in Product & Technology squads built for the AI era, alongside software engineers who own the systems beneath the experience: they’re accountable for whether it runs, you’re accountable for what it is. This is not a designer who occasionally prototypes or a front-end engineer who takes tickets.

Most of what gets called “AI in product” today is a button bolted onto an unchanged screen. We’re building the opposite: experiences where the agent does the work and the human reviews, corrects, and authorizes it. Knowing the difference, and being able to design and ship it, is the judgment we’re hiring for.

Where You’ll Have Impact

You’ll join Agentic MGA, the squad that powers risk selection before a policy is bound. The squad gives underwriters and members self serve pre bind analytics, pricing and appetite insight, and intelligence that learns continuously from submissions, bind outcomes, and claims performance.

The surfaces you design carry real underwriting decisions: what to quote, what to decline, what sits inside appetite and what does not. The system learns from what happens after those decisions, so the experience has to make the reasoning legible, not just deliver an answer. Some of this is making dense insurance data clear and usable under time pressure. Some of it is rethinking a workflow entirely now that an agent can carry the load. You will own these from shaping the problem through to the production front-end, working with software engineers on the systems underneath.

What You’ll Do

  • Explore and prototype to find the right answer. Real design happens here: trying directions, putting things in front of people, following the good ideas and throwing out the rest. Most of what you make is for learning, not shipping, and that’s the point. Production is where the right answer lands, not where it starts
  • Carry features from design through to production front-end. The design decision and the code are the same job, in the same hands, so the work keeps its fidelity instead of being lost in a handoff
  • Help frame what’s worth building. Talk to underwriters and members, test whether the problem is real, and shape scope alongside your squad rather than waiting for a finished spec
  • Build the supervisory surfaces of an agent-native platform: a submission triage queue an underwriter trusts at a glance, a confidence and citation pattern they can act on, an appetite or pricing signal that shows its reasoning
  • Use AI tools across the full loop (research, design, prototype, build, test, iterate) as the default way you work, not an occasional accelerator
  • Own the invisible craft that separates polished from pretty: performance, accessibility, cross-device behavior, and the responsiveness that makes an interface feel fast
  • Build with and contribute to our AI-native design system: the patterns, rules, and decision logic that let people, AI, and engineers create coherent, on-brand experiences from a shared foundation
  • Ship early, learn from users and production, and iterate continuously, applying real judgment to AI-generated output rather than trusting it

What We’re Looking For

  • A builder who designs and ships front-end to production. You’ve owned a problem, made the call on what the experience should be, and shipped it yourself
  • Specialty insurance experience, on the pre bind side. This one is a requirement, not a preference. You understand what an underwriter is doing when they assess a submission, what appetite means in practice, how an MGA differs from a carrier, and why bind rate and loss performance are the numbers that matter. You’ve designed for these users before, and you can tell when a workflow is wrong on the business logic and not just the interaction
  • You set direction without a brief. You take an ambiguous problem area, decide what matters, and get it moving. You are the design judgment on your squad and comfortable being the person accountable for whether what ships is good
  • Strong design judgment and taste. In a world where AI produces competent interfaces instantly, the ability to tell good from merely functional, and to push work past the default, is the scarce skill
  • Product instinct. You can tell what’s worth building, cut scope without being told to, and validate with real users rather than waiting for certainty
  • Comfortable building and shipping production-quality front-end in a modern web codebase, using AI tooling at every stage. You know AI’s failure modes, can tell when output looks right but isn’t, and own the quality rather than trusting it. We care that you can ship and know when it’s right, not which framework you came up on
  • A genuine interest in using AI not just to produce screens faster, but to rethink what designing a product even is when the agent does the work and the human supervises
  • The ability to design data-rich, high-stakes interfaces for demanding professionals who are making consequential decisions quickly

Depth and quality of your experience matter more than years, and there is no single right background on the build side. Strong candidates come from design, from engineering, and from places in between. The insurance experience is the one thing we are firm on. This is not a role for someone early in their career.

Why Join Accelerant?

  • Real impact: you’re building the experiences that change how specialty insurance operates, for customers inside and outside Accelerant
  • Real ownership: short feedback loops, meaningful autonomy, and builders trusted to make consequential decisions and ship them
  • AI-native by default: we use AI seriously, both in how we build and in what we deliver to customers, and this role is at the center of that
  • One craft, not two handed off: design and engineering in the same hands, on the same squad, shipping the same work
  • A remote-first squad of talented people working together across the globe

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Drives the planning and execution of elements of clinical trials in partnership with the Project Lead.
    • Ensures projects adhere to strict timelines and are delivered within budget.
    • Serves as subject matter expert of relevant project management tools and systems.
    • Coordinates internal resources and third parties/vendors for the efficient execution of projects.
    • Maintains and distributes study-specific financial reports and contributes to study’s financial health using financial processes and systems.
    • Conducts ongoing analysis of project performance to drive the successful completion of short and long-term goals.
    • Documents project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders.
    • Leads communication between project team members, ensuring all parties are informed of project status and changes.
  • Documents and escalates project risks and issues and drives timely follow-through and completion.
    • Maintenance of systems and project management tools and methodologies.
    • Drives quality assurance activities, including preparation for audits and internal review, prepare documentation and follow through to resolution on actionable issues.
    • Oversees tasks and activities by providing mentorship and coordinating junior team members, while operating independently with minimal oversight.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

jobs.title: Events Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who we are:At Wagepoint, we're good people.  It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Team by collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kind by challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The role at high level:

We're looking for a talented Events Marketing Manager who enjoys tackling hard problems and wants to create meaningful impact for small businesses across Canada. In this role, you'll own the strategy, planning, and execution of Wagepoint's event program, including tradeshows, industry events, partner and customer events, annual summits, and Wagefest, our two-day virtual event. You'll also own the execution of our webinar strategy and delivery of every webinar in collaboration with the content marketing team. You will report directly to our Growth Marketing Manager.

What you'll be expected to own:

  • Own Wagepoint's annual event strategy and calendar across tradeshows, industry events, customer and partner events, proprietary experiences, and annual summits.

  • Research and evaluate event opportunities based on audience, strategic fit, cost, reach, and potential business impact.

  • Recommend where Wagepoint should invest, scale back, or create its own experiences.

  • Build clear plans for each event, including objectives, target audience, experience, promotion strategy, budget, timelines, and success measures.

  • Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of tradeshows and industry events, including contracts, booth requirements, shipping, staffing, booth design, signage, collateral, giveaways, demos, and on-site logistics.

  • Own Wagefest from strategy and programming through promotion, production, and post-event follow-up, including speakers, agenda, registration, communications, content, and attendee experience.

  • Plan and execute three annual summits, including the theme, concept, objectives, speakers, agenda, attendee experience, and post-event follow-up.

  • Manage event budgets, vendors, venues, production partners, and suppliers, including negotiating for the best value from event investments.

  • Own event timelines, registrations, travel, shipping, staffing, and other logistics while keeping internal stakeholders aligned and on track.

  • Build repeatable event playbooks, checklists, processes, and templates that make the program easier to execute and scale.

  • Establish success measures for every event, track performance and ROI, and use results to improve future event selection, execution, and investment.

  • Own the end-to-end execution of Wagepoint's webinar strategy in collaboration with the content marketing team, including scheduling, speaker coordination, registration, promotion, platform setup, live production, and post-webinar follow-up.

  • Work closely with Sales and external partners before events to align on target audiences, objectives, pre-booked meetings, and follow-up responsibilities.

  • Coordinate with the broader marketing team on event assets to ensure every event is on-brand.

  • Partner with Marketing, SMB and Partner Sales teams on post-event plans that turn attendance and engagement into ongoing customer and prospect opportunities.

  • Bring an ownership mindset to the role by anticipating problems, closing gaps, and making sure every event is well organized and ready to go.

What you bring to the table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a related role.

  • Experience owning events from strategy and planning through execution and post-event measurement.

  • Experience with tradeshows, conferences, virtual events, and executive or customer experiences.

  • Proven ability to build event plans and budgets and manage vendors, agencies, and production partners.

  • Experience planning and running webinars, including platform setup, promotion, and live production.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.

  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to keep multiple people moving in the same direction.

  • A commercial mindset and understanding that events are an investment that should support growth, relationships, and the brand.

  • Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to anticipate problems and close gaps without needing to be chased.

  • A hands-on approach and willingness to manage and execute all aspects of an event, regardless of the size or significance of the task.

  • Adaptability and the ability to keep moving when priorities change.

  • A measurement-focused mindset, with the ability to track event performance and ROI and use results to improve future decisions.

Bonus points if:

  • You have experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payroll, accounting, bookkeeping, or another complex category.

  • You have experience marketing to SMBs, accountants, or bookkeepers.

  • You have experience owning large-scale virtual events or multi-day conferences.

  • You have experience with partner, customer, or executive events.

  • You have experience using event platforms, marketing automation, and CRM tools to manage registration, engagement, and follow-up.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact: Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture: Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth: We believe learning is part of the job. We're committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation: Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote: Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you'd like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression.

Gestionnaire, marketing événementiel – Offre d'emploi

Qui sommes-nous

Chez Wagepoint, nous sommes du bon monde. Et c'est facile à ressentir quand on est entouré de personnes qui réalisent le meilleur travail de leur carrière, à créer un logiciel de paie remarquable pour les petites entreprises de partout au Canada.

Notre équipe réunit des parcours, des perspectives, des expériences et des idées variés pour faire de la paie la partie la plus simple de la gestion d'une entreprise.

Le télétravail est notre norme, nous sommes en pleine croissance et nous cherchons des personnes passionnées qui ne se contentent pas de la première solution venue ni de la façon dont les choses ont toujours été faites. Nous tenons profondément à nos clients comme les uns aux autres, et nous savons qu'en matière de paie, l'exactitude compte.

Nos valeurs orientent notre façon de travailler et ce que nous attendons les uns des autres :

  • Cultiver l'impact en nous concentrant sur l'essentiel et en offrant des résultats concrets à nos clients.

  • Ne faire qu'une équipe en collaborant ouvertement, en communiquant clairement et en nous ralliant autour d'objectifs communs.

  • Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance en remettant en question les idées reçues, en apprenant rapidement et en agissant avec empathie.

Si vous voulez bâtir l'avenir de la paie dans un milieu où vos idées sont accueillies et où votre contribution compte, ne cherchez pas plus loin !

Le rôle

Vous aimez les problèmes complexes et vous voulez faire une vraie différence pour les petites entreprises de partout au Canada ? Nous cherchons justement une personne pour occuper le poste de gestionnaire du marketing événementiel. Vous prendrez en charge la stratégie, la planification et la réalisation du programme d'événements de Wagepoint : salons professionnels, événements de l'industrie, événements pour nos partenaires et nos clients, sommets annuels et Wagefest, notre événement virtuel de deux jours. Vous serez aussi responsable de mettre en œuvre notre stratégie de webinaires et de livrer chacun d'eux, en collaboration avec l'équipe du marketing de contenu. Vous relèverez directement de notre gestionnaire du marketing de croissance.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Piloter la stratégie et le calendrier annuels des événements de Wagepoint : salons professionnels, événements de l'industrie, événements clients et partenaires, expériences maison et sommets annuels.

  • Repérer et évaluer les occasions d'événements selon le public, la pertinence stratégique, les coûts, la portée et les retombées potentielles pour l'entreprise.

  • Recommander où Wagepoint devrait investir davantage, réduire sa présence ou créer ses propres expériences.

  • Bâtir un plan clair pour chaque événement : objectifs, public cible, expérience, stratégie de promotion, budget, échéancier et indicateurs de succès.

  • Diriger de bout en bout la planification et la réalisation des salons professionnels et des événements de l'industrie : contrats, exigences du kiosque, expédition, personnel, conception du kiosque, signalisation, documentation marketing, articles promotionnels, démonstrations et logistique sur place.

  • Prendre en charge Wagefest de A à Z, de la stratégie et de la programmation à la promotion, à la production et au suivi après l'événement, y compris les conférencières et conférenciers, le programme, les inscriptions, les communications, le contenu et l'expérience participant.

  • Planifier et réaliser trois sommets annuels : thème, concept, objectifs, les conférencières et conférenciers, programme, expérience participant et suivi après l'événement.

  • Gérer les budgets des événements, les fournisseurs, les lieux et les partenaires de production, et négocier pour tirer le maximum de chaque investissement.

  • Gérer les échéanciers, les inscriptions, les déplacements, l'expédition, le personnel et le reste de la logistique, tout en gardant les parties prenantes internes sur la même longueur d'onde et dans les temps.

  • Créer des guides pratiques, des listes de contrôle, des processus et des modèles réutilisables qui simplifient la réalisation du programme et facilitent sa croissance.

  • Définir des indicateurs de succès pour chaque événement, suivre la performance et le rendement du capital investi (RCI), et s'appuyer sur les résultats pour améliorer le choix, la réalisation et le financement des prochains événements.

  • Assurer de bout en bout la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de webinaires de Wagepoint avec l'équipe du marketing de contenu : planification, coordination des conférencières et conférenciers, inscriptions, promotion, configuration de la plateforme, production en direct et suivi après chaque webinaire.

  • Travailler de près avec l'équipe des ventes et nos partenaires externes avant chaque événement pour s'entendre sur les publics cibles, les objectifs, les rencontres planifiées à l'avance et le partage des suivis.

  • Coordonner le matériel de chaque événement avec le reste de l'équipe marketing pour qu'il respecte notre image de marque.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing, Ventes PME et Ventes partenaires sur les plans de suivi après l'événement, pour transformer la participation et l'engagement en occasions durables auprès de nos clients et prospects.

  • Faire preuve d'un grand sens des responsabilités : anticiper les problèmes, combler les lacunes et veiller à ce que chaque événement soit bien organisé et prêt à démarrer.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Un baccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en marketing événementiel, en marketing terrain, en marketing expérientiel ou dans un rôle connexe.

  • De l'expérience dans la prise en charge d'événements, de la stratégie et de la planification jusqu'à la réalisation et à la mesure des résultats.

  • De l'expérience avec les salons professionnels, les conférences, les événements virtuels et les expériences pour la haute direction ou la clientèle.

  • Une capacité éprouvée à bâtir des plans et des budgets d'événements, et à gérer des fournisseurs, des agences et des partenaires de production.

  • De l'expérience dans la planification et la tenue de webinaires, y compris la configuration de la plateforme, la promotion et la production en direct.

  • De solides compétences en gestion de projets et la capacité de mener de front plusieurs événements, échéances et parties prenantes.

  • Un grand souci du détail, sans jamais perdre de vue le portrait global.

  • D'excellentes aptitudes en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, et le talent de faire avancer tout le monde dans la même direction.

  • Le sens des affaires : vous savez qu'un événement est un investissement qui doit soutenir la croissance, les relations et la marque.

  • Un grand sens des responsabilités : vous anticipez les problèmes et comblez les lacunes sans qu'on ait à vous courir après.

  • Une approche concrète et la volonté de gérer et de réaliser tous les aspects d'un événement, peu importe la taille ou l'importance de la tâche.

  • De la souplesse et la capacité de garder le cap quand les priorités changent.

  • Un esprit axé sur la mesure : vous suivez la performance et le RCI de vos événements, et vous vous servez des résultats pour prendre de meilleures décisions.

Ce qui vous démarquera

  • Vous avez de l'expérience dans le secteur des logiciels-services (SaaS) interentreprises, des technologies financières, de la paie, de la comptabilité, de la tenue de livres ou dans un autre domaine complexe.

  • Vous avez de l'expérience en marketing auprès des PME, des comptables ou des teneurs de livres.

  • Vous avez déjà pris en charge des événements virtuels d'envergure ou des conférences de plusieurs jours.

  • Vous avez de l'expérience avec des événements pour des partenaires, des clients ou la haute direction.

  • Vous avez de l'expérience avec les plateformes d'événements, l'automatisation marketing et les outils de gestion de la relation client (CRM) pour gérer les inscriptions, l'engagement et les suivis.

Ce que nous vous offrons en retour

  • Impact : Mettez la main à la pâte et contribuez directement à la croissance et au succès de Wagepoint.

  • Culture : Travaillez aux côtés d'une équipe qui aime vraiment résoudre des problèmes ensemble, qui célèbre ses réussites, qui se soutient dans les moments difficiles et qui trouve toujours le temps pour une mauvaise blague à l'occasion.

  • Croissance : Pour nous, apprendre fait partie du travail. Nous nous engageons à vous aider à vous améliorer chaque jour (un clin d'œil à notre valeur Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance !) en vous offrant du perfectionnement professionnel, de nouvelles expériences et des perspectives d'évolution de carrière au fil de notre croissance.

  • Innovation : La curiosité et l'expérimentation sont encouragées ! Apportez vos idées, remettez en question les idées reçues, utilisez l'IA de façon responsable et contribuez à inventer de meilleures façons de travailler.

  • Télétravail : Travaillez d'où vous êtes le plus productif. Le télétravail a toujours été la norme chez Wagepoint : vous y gagnez en souplesse, en autonomie et, on l'espère, un peu plus de temps avec les personnes (et les animaux) que vous aimez.

Envie de vous joindre à l'équipe ? Posez votre candidature dès maintenant et aidez-nous à faire de la paie la partie la plus simple de la gestion d'une entreprise.

Prochaines étapes

Si le poste vous parle, nous aimerions beaucoup vous connaître ! Pas besoin de lettre de présentation officielle : envoyez-nous simplement votre curriculum vitæ et, si le cœur vous en dit, quelques lignes sur ce qui vous emballe dans cette occasion.

Si nous convenons que le courant passe, une personne de notre équipe communiquera avec vous pour planifier un appel.

Psssst !

En 2026, nous avons été reconnus parmi les meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada pour le bien-être mental et l'inclusion. Cet engagement se prolonge dans notre processus d'embauche, où nous nous efforçons d'offrir une expérience accueillante, respectueuse et inclusive dès le premier jour.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous les horizons, expériences, identités et perspectives, et nous nous engageons à bâtir un milieu de travail où chaque personne peut s'épanouir.

Comme nous sommes une entreprise en télétravail, toutes les entrevues se déroulent virtuellement. Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à une étape ou l'autre du processus de recrutement, faites-le-nous savoir. Nous serons heureux de vous accompagner !

Cette offre d'emploi vise un poste actuellement vacant.

Dans le cadre de notre processus d'embauche, des outils basés sur l'IA appuient l'examen initial des candidatures. Rassurez-vous : notre équipe des opérations RH examine attentivement toutes les candidatures et prend les décisions finales quant à la progression des personnes candidates.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe Moresby Group helps the largest companies in the world rapidly realize savings by renegotiating with their fragmented supplier bases, leveraging more than 2 million proprietary data points from 100,000+ previous negotiations.
jobs.description:
About the job

The Moresby Group helps the largest companies in the world rapidly realize savings by renegotiating with their fragmented supplier bases, leveraging more than 2 million proprietary data points from 100,000+ previous negotiations.

With $10 billion of negotiations executed in the last twelve months and services available in more than 150 countries across 15 industries, The Moresby Group leverages AI-powered analytics, elite human negotiators, and proprietary data intelligence to deliver audit-ready, documented results within one fiscal quarter.

Role Overview

As an Administrative Coordinator, you'll be the operational backbone for our negotiation team—ensuring negotiators stay focused on high-value work, and nothing falls through the cracks. This isn't traditional admin work. You'll own calendars, set pace, analyze performance data, coordinate across stakeholders, and proactively solve problems before they become bottlenecks.

What You'll Do

Calendar & Workflow Ownership

  • Own negotiators' calendars entirely: ensure schedules are tight, organized, and aligned with project KPIs
  • Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, and efficiency gaps
  • Create and manage negotiation meetings with proper context, follow-up systems, and documentation

Supplier Engagement & Coordination

  • Professionally engage suppliers to identify the right decision-makers for negotiations
  • Manage multi-channel follow-up throughout each project
  • Navigate executive channels appropriately: knowing when to involve EAs, when to go direct, and how to message at the right level both internally and externally
  • Schedule calls between supplier decision-makers and negotiators with precision
  • Maintain detailed, actionable records in our CRM (Close.io)

Pace Setting & Performance Analysis

  • Set and maintain the pace of supplier engagement and negotiation timelines
  • Proactively analyze KPIs related to supplier activities: response rates, negotiation cycle times, bottlenecks
  • Identify patterns and recommend process improvements to increase efficiency
  • Flag risks or delays early and coordinate solutions

Data & Strategic Research

  • Analyze historical spend data and pricing proposals in Excel to surface insights
  • Research supplier backgrounds, organizational structures, and strategic positioning
  • Extract and synthesize intelligence that informs negotiation strategy

What We're Looking For

  • Preferred: 3+ years supporting senior executives in a fast-paced environment
  • Operational excellence: You own complex calendars, manage competing priorities, and keep leaders focused on what matters
  • Proactive problem-solver: You see around corners, anticipate needs, and fix issues before they're escalated
  • Executive communication skills: You know how to message appropriately across levels, navigate EA relationships, and represent leadership professionally
  • Energized by pace, precision, and being close to the action
  • Comfortable working within EST business hours in a mostly fully remote environment

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Analytical mindset and comfort with Excel, CRM platforms (Salesforce, Close.io), or data tools
  • Experience with tools like Slack and Google Workspace
  • Systems thinking approach—you build processes, not just execute tasks
  • Supported executives in consulting, private equity, or high-growth operational environments
  • Managed complex stakeholder coordination or project timelines with multiple moving parts

Environment & Perks

  • Direct Impact: Small, efficient team where your work visibly moves the needle
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full benefits package + retirement savings match
  • Remote-First: Work from home within EST hours; Toronto-based onboarding and quarterly team meetings
  • Annual Retreats: Close-knit team that values time together
  • Charitable Giving: We've donated $100K+ from the savings we generate

The Moresby Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering an inclusive, barrier-free work environment. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. If accommodation is required during recruitment, contact our Talent team directly.

AI Disclosure: The Moresby Group may use artificial intelligence to assist in screening, assessing, or selecting applicants for this position.

jobs.title: Partner Development Manager (MSSP), Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Partner Development Manager (MSSP), Acquisition, you will be tasked with recruiting new strategic Managed Service partners and building revenue-generating security service offerings. Ideal candidates bring prior experience selling full-stack security solutions, expanding product footprint within an account, executing strategic business plans, and outperforming the market, with a background in high-tech sales and prior experience selling to Service Providers and/or Managed Security Service Providers.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Stay current on the SentinelOne competitive landscape and sell the value of our solutions and services relative to competitors.
  • Ensure partners receive timely product and MSP/MSSP model updates for each relevant product area, and work with internal teams to build service offerings and develop launch content with partners.
  • Drive program management and governance for service offering launches.
  • Evangelize partner service offerings and bring the voice of the partner back into SentinelOne's sales organization.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate weekly forecasts of MSP/MSSP revenue for your assigned territory.
  • Stay aligned with local teams on forecasting, enablement, and launch of newly formed partnerships.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • BS technical degree or equivalent.
  • 5 or more years of above-quota sales experience, preferably as a Regional Sales Executive/Manager selling security solutions across endpoint, identity, data, and cloud.
  • Deep knowledge of current security solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage a variety of technical and business leaders internally and externally.
  • Enterprise sales experience with an actionable network of MSSP decision makers.
  • Superb organizational and reporting skills.
  • Experience growing the sales enablement function to support sales in a rapidly evolving, competitive marketplace.
  • Experience working with channel partners and a strong understanding of partner-centric go-to-market approaches.
  • A "whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to deliver above-quota performance.
  • Prior startup experience.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

jobs.title: Mobile Technical Lead with Kotlin MultiPlatform
jobs.excerpt: Our client is a leading technology provider in the retail industry, delivering modern point-of-sale and store operations solutions to retailers across multiple markets.
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading technology provider in the retail industry, delivering modern point-of-sale and store operations solutions to retailers across multiple markets. As part of an ongoing platform modernization initiative, they are evolving their client architecture away from a legacy Java 8 Swing-based POS client toward a modular, offline-first, multi-platform model — supporting stationary POS terminals, self-checkout kiosks, and self-scanning devices across diverse retail environments.

The shared business logic layer is built with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), targeting both JVM/Desktop and Android clients. This layer is the heart of the platform: it owns the domain rules, use cases, and data flows for critical retail operations — item registration, checkout, payment, customer management, and promotion handling — while remaining fully decoupled from platform-specific concerns and UI. Business continuity through offline operation, high testability, and performance under real retail conditions are non-negotiable priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • Architecture ownership: Define clean repository, service, facade, DTO, and bridge contracts between Kotlin, platform-specific code, and the VueJS/TypeScript UI layer.
  • Technical delivery: Design, implement, and maintain shared KMP modules for POS business capabilities, ensuring code is high-quality, maintainable, and performant across JVM/Desktop and Android targets.
  • Platform integration: Implement platform-specific code for desktop and Android targets using expect/actual patterns, without leaking platform concerns into shared business logic.
  • Offline-first delivery: Build offline-capable flows with local persistence, caching, synchronization readiness, and explicit failure handling.
  • Code quality: Write clean, well-structured code, participate in reviews, and improve existing modules through refactoring where needed.
  • Testing: Write automated tests for domain rules, use cases, repositories, bridge contracts, and coroutine-based flows.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers, QA, product owners, and architects to align on contracts, requirements, and feature delivery.
  • Knowledge sharing: Support teammates by sharing knowledge and mentoring less experienced Kotlin developers when appropriate.
  • Team alignment: Respect team agreements and processes, while providing regular updates on progress, trade-offs, and technical decisions.


Qualifications:

Must Have

  • 8+ years of experience with Kotlin, including architecture decision making with KMP at platform scale, not only within individual applications or domain layers
  • Strong system-level Android experience (not just application-level)
  • Strong hands-on KMP delivery to at least two targets (preferably Android and JVM/Desktop) and KMP-Swift/iOS interoperability knowledge (XCFramework, expect/actual patterns, Flow bridging - a successful candidate will have to take cross-platform decisions that iOS developers can work with)
  • Java-to-Kotlin/KMP migration at platform scale
  • Architectural leadership and vision — the candidate must be comfortable stepping into ambiguity and proposing concrete answers
  • Modular product architecture with customer-specific extension points - experience designing multi-tenant or multi-customer product platforms is essential
  • Knowledge transfer and mentoring — must be able to train engineers in modern KMP patterns and architectural thinking
  • Senior stakeholder communication — will interact with technical leadership; must articulate trade-offs clearly and build confidence in the approach
  • Solid understanding of Clean Architecture: domain, use-case, infrastructure, and platform layers with dependency inversion and repository abstractions
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow: structured concurrency, suspend APIs, Flow-based state and events, cancellation, and error propagation
  • Experience with offline-first or local-first client architecture: local persistence, caching, synchronization concepts, and conflict handling
  • Familiarity with dependency injection patterns, preferably Koin: constructor injection, module composition, and test overrides
  • Strong testing discipline: unit and integration tests using Kotlin Test or equivalent, test doubles, and coroutine testing utilities
  • Experience integrating REST/OpenAPI-style services: typed DTO mapping, serialization, and resilient client-side communication
  • Comfortable with Gradle Kotlin DSL, modular builds, and CI-friendly project structures
  • Effective communication skills for collaboration with frontend developers, QA, and product stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Compose Multiplatform experience
  • POS / retail embedded systems (checkout, payment terminals, scale integration, ESL), direct domain experience being a differentiator
  • Desktop JVM client experience, especially Electron sidecar or local service integration patterns
  • Understanding of VueJS 3 and TypeScript to collaborate effectively on Kotlin-to-UI bridge contract design
  • Experience with plugin or extensibility architecture: extension points, lifecycle management, and isolation
  • Performance engineering experience for latency-sensitive client operations (e.g., fast item scan, payment flows)
  • POS, retail, payment, promotion, or hardware peripheral integration experience

jobs.excerpt: About PerlePerle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Perle

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Perle is hiring a freelance transcriptionist fluent in Tswana for a remote transcription role. This is a paid contract position open to qualified contributors worldwide.

1. Role Overview

You will transcribe 2-speaker, channel-separated audio recordings in Tswana. Each file has two clearly separated speakers. Your job is to produce a clean, accurate, sequentially ordered transcript with speaker labels and timestamps.

2. What You Will Do

  • Listen to 2-speaker audio recordings in Tswana
  • Type out what each speaker says, accurately and in full
  • Label each speaker turn as Speaker 1 or Speaker 2, matching the audio channel
  • Add timestamps at the start of each speaker turn (format: HH:MM:SS)
  • Ensure transcripts are sequential with no unexplained gaps

3. Requirements

  • Native or near-native fluency in Tswana (spoken and written)
  • Strong written Tswana — accurate spelling, punctuation, and grammar
  • Ability to work independently and meet daily output targets
  • Access to a computer with a stable internet connection
  • Availability for at least 4 hours per day
  • Prior transcription experience is a plus but not required — all contributors must pass a qualification test

4. Quality Standard

  • Word Error Rate (WER) of 5% or less on all delivered transcripts
  • Zero speaker label errors — Speaker 1 must always correspond to Channel 1
  • Transcripts reviewed on a rolling basis; feedback provided promptly
  • Files that do not meet the quality threshold will be returned for correction

5. Project Details

Detail

Information

Language required

Tswana

Project type

Audio transcription (manual)

Commitment

~at least 4 hours/day (remote, flexible schedule)

Start date

As soon as qualified — rolling onboarding

6. How to Apply

Submit your application through the Perle platform. You will be asked to complete a short qualification task — a 5-minute audio transcription sample in Tswana. Applicants who pass the qualification test will be onboarded immediately and assigned to production tasks.

This role sits on the investor side of Pairs. In banking you built the investor lists and drafted the outreach. Here you run it end to end: you find the right investors, open the conversation, and book them into meetings with founders whose opportunity fits.

The work rewards rigour. Every list is qualified before it is used, every message is written for the person receiving it, and every reply gets a next step.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals, angels and funds that back companies directly. Our model is introductions and relationship management, not deal execution.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to investor conversations, and to learning which investors are ready to commit capital.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team, on a process that already works. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

This is an early-career role. The pace is high, and the people who do well here keep the quality high with it.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Investor lists. Who fits each opportunity by stage, sector, check size and recent activity, qualified before anyone is contacted.

  • First conversations. Messages that read like a person wrote them, and replies turned into calls.

  • Investor meetings. Qualified investors booked with founders, with the context they need before the call.

  • Accurate records. Every conversation, meeting and outcome logged, so nothing is lost between calls.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have worked as an analyst in investment banking, M&A advisory, corporate finance or capital advisory, and have built investor or buyer lists on live processes.

  • Know the difference between a long list and a qualified one, and can explain how you get from one to the other.

  • Can write a short, specific message to a busy investor that gets a reply.

  • Keep your pace high without letting quality slip, and follow a process without needing a reminder.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • Room to grow into a senior investor-side role as your network grows

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation Range: $90K - $150K

Requirements

  • Strong backend, full-stack, product engineering, or systems engineering fundamentals.

About the role

The Solution Architect – Fiber & Structured Cabling, AI Data Center is a customer-facing technical role responsible for designing and architecting high-density fiber and structured cabling solutions for large-scale AI data center environments. The role works closely with customers, Solution Specialists, Account Executives, engineering, Professional Services, OEMs, manufacturers, and delivery teams to translate AI infrastructure requirements into scalable, repeatable, and executable physical connectivity designs. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in data center fiber infrastructure and understands the unique density, speed, scale, quality, and deployment requirements associated with GPU clusters, high-performance networks, and hyperscale AI environments.

Annual compensation: $170K - $200K + bonus

What you'll be doing

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture for fiber and structured cabling solutions supporting AI data center programs.
  • Translate customer compute, network, rack, and deployment requirements into physical layer designs, standards, BOMs, and implementation requirements.
  • Design high-density fiber architectures supporting GPU clusters, Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, storage networks, and data center interconnects.
  • Develop rack-to-rack, row, zone, meet-me-room, backbone, horizontal, and cross-connect cabling architectures.
  • Define fiber types, connectorization, polarity, patching, labeling, pathway, containment, and cable management standards.
  • Develop and validate cable matrices, port maps, connectivity schedules, rack elevations, drawings, BOMs, and installation documentation.
  • Partner with OEMs and infrastructure manufacturers to validate interoperability, standards, product selection, and technical roadmaps.
  • Support estimating, proposals, statements of work, RFQs/RFPs, technical presentations, and customer design reviews.

  • Identify opportunities to standardize and automate fiber design, documentation, BOM creation, and deployment methodologies.

  • Ability to interpret network designs, rack elevations, port maps, equipment layouts, construction drawings, and customer technical standards.

  • Ability to collaborate across sales, architecture, engineering, Professional Services, project management, operations, field delivery, and partner organizations.
  • Ability to operate in fast-moving environments where designs and deployment requirements evolve rapidly.
  • AI infrastructure and large GPU clusters

  • High-performance Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics
  • Hyperscale or cloud data center fiber architecture

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

As an Implementation Manager at Atominvest, you will own the end-to-end delivery of our platform for some of the world's most sophisticated alternative investment managers, and act as their day-to-day contact and the face of Atominvest throughout. White-glove service is part of our competitive edge — clients trust one person to understand their business, solve their technical problems, and be accountable end-to-end. To do that credibly, you need to be hands-on and technical — as comfortable mapping a client's data model and scoping an API integration as you are running discovery workshops or presenting to a C-suite sponsor.

You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder implementations from first workshop to go-live, designing the implementation plan itself rather than just executing someone else's. Delivery and technical substance are what earn you the trust to be the face of the account — not the reverse. You'll work closely with Sales, Product and Engineering to ensure client outcomes are delivered to the highest standard.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full client lifecycle: discovery, solution design, configuration, data migration, integrations, UAT, training, go-live, and post-deployment success

  • Act as the client's single day-to-day point of contact and the face of Atominvest — the credibility to hold that position comes from actually knowing the platform, the data, and the plan in detail

  • Run structured discovery workshops to translate a client's fund structures, data model, and reporting requirements into a concrete implementation plan and platform configuration

  • Design and advise on implementation plans — sequencing, dependencies, resourcing, and technical approach — rather than simply executing a pre-set template

  • Work with Product and Engineering to scope and discuss integrations with client technical teams (APIs, SFTP, data feeds), defining what's feasible and what the client needs to build or provide

  • Lead structured implementation programmes for enterprise clients, managing complex timelines, dependencies, and senior stakeholder expectations

  • Analyse client datasets, fund structures, and workflows to design and configure optimal platform solutions

  • Run executive business reviews with C-level contacts alongside Account Managers, distinct from technical discovery sessions, to align on progress and value delivered

  • Proactively manage risks and customer health

  • Partner with Product to manage change and operational risk during feature deployments — coordinating rollouts, communicating impact to clients, and ensuring new functionality lands smoothly within live production environments

  • Act as the bridge between clients and the product roadmap — gathering structured feedback, influencing prioritisation, and owning delivery of new features to your client base

  • Deliver consistently high-quality, responsive, white-glove support — treating every client issue with ownership and clear judgment

  • Build genuine trust with client stakeholders at all levels, throughout the implementation and beyond — not just at renewal

  • Identify expansion opportunities by understanding clients' broader operating models and strategic goals

Requirements

  • 3–6 years leading enterprise B2B SaaS implementations end-to-end, ideally within financial services or asset management — you've personally configured the platform, run the data migration, and solved the technical problems, not just coordinated the project plan and chased other people's tasks

  • Strong working knowledge of private markets — you can hold your own in a conversation about waterfalls, capital calls, or LP reporting requirements without translation

  • Genuinely hands-on and technical: comfortable working with APIs, data mapping, and integration concepts, and confident scoping technical requirements directly with a client's IT or data team

  • Proven experience running discovery workshops that produce a concrete implementation plan — not just a requirements document

  • Highly analytical, with strong Excel skills and comfort reconciling and migrating complex client datasets

  • Exceptional project management instincts — you track every dependency, own every deadline, and communicate proactively when things shift

  • A natural relationship-builder who's comfortable being the day-to-day face of a vendor to a demanding, sophisticated client — you read a room, adapt your style to a CFO or a data analyst, and can challenge and guide senior stakeholders with confidence

  • Delivery substance first: this isn't a role where charm and responsiveness alone can carry you — clients trust you because you know their data and their platform inside out, and the relationship is built on that

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive with autonomy, move quickly, and bring solutions not problems

Knowledge & Asset Creation

Job Summary: The Health Information Coding Trainer ensures coders are trained and up to date on the latest regulatory changes and requirements that affect coding compliance and hospital reimbursement. The trainer handles all on-the-job training for new coding graduates, coders transitioning to another level, experienced coders for any special educational needs and annual and/or ongoing educational updates. The trainer must stay current and up-to-date on all coding resources that affect coding and reimbursement. Primarily the trainer must keep coders-in-training on track with proficient outcomes both productivity and quality wise. The Health Information Coding Trainer will work with HIM management to design appropriate curriculum, teach coding guidelines, rules, etc., and report to the Health Information Manager.

Minimum Education: High School Diploma or GED required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Minimum score of 85% on pre-employment coding test. Ability to train coders remotely. Ability to utilize related software and computer/PC skills. Advanced knowledge of coding. Excellent interpersonal, written and oral skills. Ability to analyze data and produce reports using MS office. Demonstrates expertise in all types of coding.

Prepares coders for Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Risk Adjustment Coder and/or specialty certification exams. Assists in development of curriculum and training programs for in person and virtual classroom settings utilizing HealthStream, MedLearn and other available educational software. Continuous education to stay current on coding regulations and requirements.

Decision Making: Independent judgment in planning sequence of operations and making minor decisions in a complex technical or professional field.

Job Description:

THE COMPANY:

Based in Phoenix Arizona, Jonas Chorum is a client-centric provider of cloud-based hospitality technology solutions serving independent hoteliers, management companies and hotel chains. With more than 3,000 installations, Jonas Chorum offers the most comprehensive and fully-integrated solutions available. Our comprehensive cloud solutions include: CloudPM property management, CloudCRS central reservations & GDS, and Cloud Enterprise analytics & business intelligence.


JOB TITLE: Business Development Rep - Intern

Reports to: Vice President of Sales

Department: Sales

Status: Exempt


BASIC FUNCTION:

The Business Development Representative Intern will be responsible for finding, qualifying and driving new leads into the top end of the Jonas Hospitality sales funnel. The BDR Intern will work closely with the Regional Sales Directors (RSDs) to manage back to base sales orders, contract processing, lead qualifications as well as supplemental efforts in support of the BDR in determining what hotels to prospect and which opportunities to take the lead on. The BDR Intern, will need to maintain a master sales plan that is easy to follow and shows methodical break downs of how and when b2b efforts and prospects will be contacted, and opportunities will be closed.

  • Database build as required.

  • Identify business opportunities by a series of research, qualifying and discovery to establish prospects needs and goals.

  • Qualify, sell and close smaller opportunities with a focus on b2b orders.
  • Learn to demonstrate Jonas Hospitality solutions to prospective clients and serve as a backup to the application consultants.
  • Stay up to date with Industry trends, market activities and competitor products.
  • Use Social Media to help drive brand and product awareness and source potential leads.
  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies.
  • Commit to outbound sales objectives of 50-100 outbound calls per day.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:


Education and Experience:

4-year College Degree preferred Previous experience working on a sales team preferred, especially in hospitality sales. Previous hotel operations would be ideal.


Technical Skills:

Must be comfortable speaking on a telephone with good tonality and speed. General experience with windows and MS Office software Ability to learn technical details regarding computer hardware and third party software products offered by the Company. Experience using Salesforce.com.


Personal Qualifications:

Successful applicant must be driven and hungry for success. We are looking for someone who possesses a hunter mentality and does not take no for an answer Ability to work well individually or as part of a team. Desire to provide outstanding customer service. Excellent organizational skills. Great attention to details. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Ability to maintain high degree of confidentiality. Willingness to enhance own performance through self-study.

High degree of confidentiality concerning Jonas Hospitality and customer business.

Travel required: Minimal

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.
