jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionJoin the future of newsWe’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.

About Our Team

The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning Newsroom and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.

Why This Role Matters

The Washington Post is seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to design and operationalize the infrastructure that powers our go-to-market organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, systems, analytics, and execution — enabling revenue teams to operate with greater clarity, efficiency, and accountability.

This is a dual-ownership role: approximately half your time will be spent architecting frameworks, strategies, and operational models; the other half implementing, running, and iterating on them directly. You will own end-to-end delivery across GTM strategy, pipeline governance, CRM systems, revenue analytics, compensation design, deal desk operations, marketing operations, and AI-first GTM initiatives.

You will work in close partnership with a dedicated GTM Enablement Manager, who leads Sales Excellence and cultural programming. Your focus is the operational and systems backbone that makes those programs possible and scalable.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you will design and operationalize the frameworks, processes, and systems that support revenue growth across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and related business functions. You will play a critical role in improving forecasting accuracy, pipeline visibility, operational consistency, and cross-functional alignment across the revenue organization.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives equally in strategic problem-solving and hands-on execution. You will help shape how our go-to-market engine evolves while directly building and maintaining the operational systems that support scalable growth and informed decision-making.

What Motivates You

  • You enjoy building operational frameworks and systems that directly influence business growth — and you want to own the execution of those systems, not just their design.
  • You thrive in environments where strategy and hands-on delivery are equally valued. You are energized by seeing your work move numbers, not just move decks.
  • You are motivated by solving complex operational problems across people, processes, systems, and data — and you approach ambiguity with curiosity and a bias for action.
  • You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Legal, and Enablement teams to improve how the revenue organization operates.
  • You are driven by turning data into actionable insight — building the reporting infrastructure that empowers leaders to make faster, more confident decisions.
  • You value operational clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement — and you build systems that create those qualities in the teams around you.
  • You are genuinely excited about AI and its potential to transform revenue operations — you already use AI tools in your daily work and want to help define what an AI-first GTM org looks like.
  • You balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and understand that the best framework in the world is worthless if it doesn’t get implemented.

How You'll Support the Mission

This role carries owned accountability across the following domains, with equal responsibility for both strategy design and direct execution.

GTM Strategy & Operations

  • Design and evolve the go-to-market operational model, including ICP definition, market segmentation, competitive positioning, and GTM motion design.
  • Operationalize territory assignments, account routing rules, and pipeline hygiene cadences directly in CRM.
  • Translate executive business objectives into specific operational blueprints, processes, and measurable execution plans.

AI-First GTM Strategy & Operations

Lead the development of an AI-first GTM operating model — identifying where AI agents, automation, and predictive intelligence can replace or augment manual RevOps workflows across every domain. Evaluate, recommend, and implement AI-native GTM tools for pipeline intelligence, lead scoring, forecasting, and conversation analytics (e.g. Clari, Clay, 6sense, Gong Forecast). Build and document AI-assisted workflows for common RevOps tasks — territory modeling, QBR prep, comp modeling, pipeline inspection — to drive speed and consistency across the team. Use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Notion AI) to accelerate your own output and serve as the internal subject matter expert on emerging AI capabilities relevant to revenue operations. Track AI tool ROI across the revenue org; partner with GTM Enablement to train and enable the revenue team on approved AI workflows.

Marketing Operations

Design and own the lead lifecycle model, including MQL, SAL, and SQL definitions, handoff rules, and SLA standards between Marketing and Sales. Define lead scoring methodology, segmentation logic, and attribution modeling strategy (first-touch and multi-touch) in partnership with Marketing and Finance. Administer and optimize the marketing automation platform (MAP), including workflows, nurture sequences, campaign operations, and MAP-to-CRM data hygiene. Build and deliver campaign performance reporting, funnel conversion dashboards, and channel ROI analysis.

Deal Desk

Design and own the deal desk framework, including approval tiers, escalation paths, authority matrices, and SLA standards for non-standard deal review. Develop deal structuring guidelines covering discounting thresholds, multi-year pricing, bundling, and non-standard commercial terms, in partnership with Finance and Legal. Serve as the primary deal desk point of contact for AEs — reviewing, approving, and structuring complex deals within defined governance parameters. Manage deal approval workflows end-to-end: from AE request through Legal redline to closed-won booking and post-close reconciliation. Track deal exceptions and discount patterns; produce monthly deal desk reporting for revenue leadership.

Compensation Design

Design comp plans aligned to business outcomes and growth stage, including incentive structures, accelerators, SPIFFs, and quota frameworks. Model plan cost and efficiency in partnership with Finance; manage the annual and mid-year comp plan rollout process.

Forecasting & Revenue Analytics

Run weekly forecasting operations and maintain forecast accuracy tracking across segments and sales teams. Build and manage dashboards for pipeline health, rep performance, conversion trends, and revenue metrics that support executive decision-making. Deliver QBR analytics including win/loss analysis, pipeline cohort reporting, and full-funnel performance reviews.

Planning & Capacity

Own annual and H2 revenue planning cycles, including capacity modeling, headcount planning, territory design, and coverage model development. Lead QBR preparation, facilitation, and follow-through across the revenue leadership team. Develop and maintain quota frameworks and compensation models in partnership with Finance.

CRM Systems & Technology

Build and maintain Salesforce workflows, fields, automations, and integrations that improve operational efficiency, data integrity, and seller productivity. Manage the broader GTM tech stack — evaluating integration health, monitoring automation performance, and enforcing data hygiene standards. Own the systems and data foundation required to support AI-driven GTM motions, including clean data pipelines, unified customer records, and model-ready CRM architecture.

Process & Methodology

Architect sales stage definitions, exit criteria, qualification frameworks (e.g. MEDDIC), and handoff protocols between Marketing, SDR, AE, and Customer Success. Define and enforce pipeline management standards, deal governance, and cross-functional rules of engagement. Establish and run a Quarterly → Monthly → Weekly operational cadence across the revenue organization.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Proven ability to operate with equal ownership across strategy design and hands-on execution — you design the framework and build it.
  • Deep understanding of revenue operations principles across forecasting, pipeline management, CRM governance, GTM process design, and revenue analytics.
  • Strong Salesforce expertise including workflow automation, process builder, reporting, and CRM administration.
  • Advanced analytical skills — comfortable building complex models in Excel or Google Sheets and creating self-serve reporting in BI tools such as Tableau or Looker.
  • Genuine fluency with AI tools in a professional context — you already use AI to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable work, and move faster than traditional methods allow.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical, operational, and executive audiences.
  • Experience designing compensation plans, quota frameworks, territory models, and capacity plans aligned to organizational growth objectives.
  • Familiarity with deal desk operations including non-standard deal structuring, commercial governance, and approval workflows.
  • Experience with marketing operations, lead lifecycle management, attribution modeling, and MAP administration.
  • Highly self-directed and operationally rigorous — you identify gaps before they become problems and drive improvements independently and collaboratively.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, or a related operational role within a B2B SaaS or high-growth organization.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing operational frameworks, processes, and systems that support revenue growth and organizational scalability.
  • Strong Salesforce expertise including workflow automation, reporting, CRM administration, and process optimization.
  • Experience owning or supporting forecasting processes, territory planning, pipeline management, and revenue analytics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; experience building dashboards in BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Legal teams.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-native GTM tools and translating their output into operational decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent CRM administration experience.
  • Experience working with GTM platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Gong, Outreach, Clari, Clay, 6sense, ZoomInfo, or CPQ tools.
  • Experience owning compensation design, quota planning, or capacity modeling end-to-end.
  • Hands-on deal desk experience including non-standard deal structuring, CPQ configuration, and approval governance.
  • Experience with marketing operations, attribution modeling, funnel analytics, or MAP administration.
  • Experience in a RevOps consulting or advisory capacity — you have seen multiple GTM environments and can pattern-match quickly.
  • Familiarity with PLG or hybrid PLG + Sales motions.
  • SQL, Python, or advanced data analysis capabilities for deeper analytical work.
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or prompt libraries for a revenue or GTM team.
  • Familiarity with no-code automation tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n) applied to RevOps workflows.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development program

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status

The salary range for this position is:

$130,300 - $242,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

The Post strives to provide its readers with high-quality, trustworthy news and information while constantly innovating. That mission is best served by a diverse, multi-generational workforce with varied life experiences and perspectives. All cultures and backgrounds are welcomed.

jobs.title: Finance Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Protect Democracy seeks a Finance Operations Specialist to join our small, highly collaborative Finance team.
jobs.description:
Protect Democracy seeks a Finance Operations Specialist to join our small, highly collaborative Finance team. In this role, you will manage the financial lifecycle of organizational spending, from budget and contract through purchase order, invoice, payment, and financial reporting. This is an excellent opportunity for a finance operations professional who enjoys owning complex cross-functional processes, understands how individual transactions connect to budgets and financial reporting, and is motivated by building systems that help an organization operate effectively.

Protect Democracy was formed with an urgent and explicit mission: to prevent our democracy from declining into a more authoritarian form of government. We anchor all of our work in service of our mission: it is the foundation of our team, be it litigation, advocacy, or ensuring that our organization has the secure financial operations to continue to meet the urgency of the moment.

This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership. You will manage cross-functional financial workflows and participate in day-to-day transaction processing, partnering closely with Accounting, Legal/Compliance, People Operations, and teams across Protect Democracy. You should be interested in the full financial story behind a transaction—not simply whether an invoice can be paid, but what commitment it relates to, where it belongs in the budget, whether appropriate approvals and documentation are in place, and how it should ultimately appear in our financial reporting.

You can work remotely from nearly any location in the United States.* We strongly encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and from across the political and ideological spectrum to apply.A commitment to our mission andcross-ideological strategyfor defending our democracy is essential.

The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 15, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

Please note that candidates who reach the final hiring stage will be required to satisfactorily complete a pre-offer background check.**

The Finance Operations Specialist will:

  • Own significant portions of Protect Democracy's contract-to-payment lifecycle, coordinating cross-functional workflows from Finance review and contract execution through vendor setup, purchase orders, invoice review, payment, renewal, and closeout;

  • Develop strong working knowledge of organizational, team, and project budgets and spending commitments, using that context to review proposed spending, maintain accurate PO and commitment records, monitor contract utilization and upcoming actions, and identify issues requiring resolution;

  • Review and process invoices, reimbursements, and card transactions while protecting the integrity of financial data, ensuring appropriate documentation, approvals, coding, policy compliance, and connection to underlying contracts, POs, and budgets;

  • Project-manage Finance Operations initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, decisions, dependencies, and execution through completion;

  • Design and continuously improve Finance systems, workflows, and controls, including Ramp procurement/contract functionality, Finance Help Desk processes, integrations, automations, and procedures;

  • Serve as a knowledgeable Finance partner to staff and vendors, independently resolving routine and moderately complex issues and exercising judgment about when matters require escalation;

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis by maintaining reliable committed-spend information, identifying potential variances, and helping connect operational spending activity to the broader financial picture;

  • Contribute to broader Finance priorities and projects, including year-end, audit, reporting, systems implementation, and other cross-functional work as needed.

Requirements

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Approximately 4–7 years of relevant professional experience in finance operations, accounting operations, procurement, accounts payable, or a related field, including experience across multiple stages of the procure-to-pay or contract-to-payment lifecycle;

  • Demonstrated experience independently owning processes or workstreams and project-managing cross-functional work across financial entities involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables;

  • Working knowledge of accounting, budgets, and financial reporting, including the ability to understand how operational transactions and individual spending decisions affect the general ledger and broader financial plans;

  • Sound judgment and problem-solving ability, including experience identifying discrepancies, resolving moderately complex operational issues independently, and escalating appropriately;

  • Strong organizational, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to manage substantial transaction/workflow volume and competing priorities without losing sight of the larger financial context;

  • A proactive, systems-oriented approach, with demonstrated interest in improving processes, not simply maintaining them as they currently exist;

  • A deep commitment to Protect Democracy's mission.

Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience with nonprofit, legal, advocacy, project- or grant-based financial structures;

  • Familiarity with Sage Intacct, Ramp, or comparable financial/procurement systems.

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $84,300 - $94,000 (FLSA Exempt) commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience, capabilities, and skills, and in alignment with internal equity.

About Protect Democracy

  • *Flexible location. We are a remote-first organization based exclusively in the United States, meaning our staff work within the US and primarily virtually. We also offer shared workspaces for those who enjoy working in an office environment. We are established for remote work in many states across the country, and while candidates based anywhere in the United States are welcome to apply, we may not be able to offer employment in your current location. If you proceed in the hiring process, we will discuss where you currently live and what is possible in our initial interview. All staff are also required to travel at least two times per year to team retreats, and this role also requires periodic travel. (Accommodations to this requirement will be made only in exceptional circumstances.)

  • Commitment to an inclusive workplace. Protect Democracy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. Protect Democracy encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

  • Phenomenal benefits. Our benefits package includes generous sick leave and a flexible vacation policy where we encourage team members to take 4-5 weeks every year, along with 12 paid holidays, 6 weeks of paid family medical leave, and 18 weeks of paid parental leave. We also offer a 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match that vests immediately. Additionally, we cover employee medical premiums at 100% (with up to 95% coverage for dependents depending on plan selection), and employee and dependents dental/vision at 100%. All employees have access to long-term disability and life insurance, fertility benefits, a home office stipend, and bonuses at the discretion of the Executive Director.

  • Ample opportunities for personal & professional development. Candidates who do not meet all listed criteria should still apply, as our organizational structure focuses on providing mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ? Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

👥 Diversité

Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE "Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP "Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY "We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

GROWTH "Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

Want to be a bswifter?

At bswift we’ve been transforming benefits administration since 1996, making it simpler, smarter, and more human. Our state-of-the-art, cloud-based technology and services empower employees to understand, manage, and love their benefits. From downtown Chicago, and remotely across the country, we serve thousands of companies and millions of people nationwide, reducing administrative burdens and freeing HR teams to focus on creating thriving, people-first workplaces.

We’re looking for motivated and goal-driven individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence and creating solutions that make a difference. The reward is a fun, flexible and creative environment with ample opportunity for professional and personal growth. If you love the bswift values of pursue excellence, embrace accountability, deliver superior service, and be a great place to work, we want to hear from you!

ABOUT US:

bswift is a leading benefits administration company that specializes in providing tailored solutions for our clients. Our mission is to simplify the complex world of employee benefits and deliver exceptional service to our clients. We are looking for a talented and experienced individual to join our Engagement Solutions team as the Director, Account Services.

bswift Engagement Solutions is our communication agency, a team of more than 50 strategists, writers, designers, researchers and communication experts who help HR, benefits and internal communications leaders create communication employees actually notice, understand and act on. We support annual enrollment, year-round benefits engagement, total rewards, benefits education and workforce communication, taking clients from research and strategy through creative development and multichannel execution. Our work has earned recognition including Gold Hermes Creative Awards, and our account management team is the engine behind it. They are the people who keep complex, high-stakes client campaigns moving on time and on point.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Director, Account Services leads the account management function within the bswift Communication Agency. This is a newly created role, built to bring structure, consistency and strategic leadership to a team that sits at the center of how our clients experience bswift.

Reporting to the Vice President, Engagement Solutions, you will lead and develop a team of account managers, own the standards and processes by which client work moves through the agency, and serve as the team’s strongest advocate. You will partner closely with the Senior Directors, Communication and collaborate with our Creative and Operations teams to ensure account managers are set up to deliver exceptional, on-time work.

We are looking for a leader who is energized by building something. You will inherit a talented team and a real opportunity to move the function from tactical execution toward proactive, strategic partnership — refining workflows, getting more out of the tools we already have, and staying at the forefront of how AI can make project management smarter and faster.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR (Essential Functions):

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Team leadership and development

Lead, coach and develop a team of six account managers, including regular one-on-ones, goal setting, performance reviews and career development planning

Hire, onboard and train new account managers, building ramp plans that bring new team members to full productivity quickly

Serve as a visible advocate for the account management team — surfacing capacity concerns, removing roadblocks and ensuring the team has the tools, information and support needed to do their jobs well

Balance workload and resourcing across the team, matching account manager capacity and strengths to client needs

Establish clear expectations, competency standards and career paths for the account management function

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement

Client and account oversight

Own the overall health of the agency’s client relationships from an account management standpoint, ensuring consistency and quality across all accounts

Directly manage a small volume of high visibility and revenue accounts within the business, implementing account and project management best practices and leading the team through the day to day.

Set and enforce best practices for client management, including communication cadence, status reporting, escalation paths and documentation standards

Step in on complex, high-visibility or at-risk accounts to provide senior-level support, issue resolution and direct client engagement

Partner with the Senior Directors of Communication to align account management support with client strategy and consulting priorities

Identify opportunities to strengthen and expand client relationships, partnering with consulting leads to execute

Represent the account management perspective in client planning, renewal and new business conversations as needed

Project management, process and operations

Own and continuously refine the agency’s project management standards, intake processes and workflows

Ensure projects across the team are scoped, scheduled, resourced and delivered on time and within budget

Maximize the capability of the agency’s project management platform (including Monday.com), driving consistent adoption, meaningful reporting and automation wherever possible

Establish clear visibility into team capacity, project status and delivery metrics, and report on them to leadership

Partner with Creative and Operations to streamline handoffs, reduce rework and eliminate low-value manual steps

Move the function from reactive and tactical toward proactive and strategic by anticipating client needs and building repeatable approaches

Innovation and AI enablement

Stay at the forefront of AI and emerging tools in project and account management, identifying, piloting and scaling the applications that improve speed, quality and consistency

Bring new ideas to how the agency works, building the business case and leading change management for adoption

Champion continuous improvement, using team feedback and delivery data to prioritize the changes that matter most

jobs.excerpt: Integration and Automation Engineer About us:At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours.
jobs.description:
Integration and Automation Engineer

About us:

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview:

Fullbay runs on a growing portfolio of business applications, and the Integration & Automation Engineer makes them work as one system. You'll design, build, and operate the integrations, data pipelines, and automations that connect Rillet, Salesforce, Masset, Slack, and the Snowflake data warehouse, so data moves reliably, manual work disappears, and reporting can be trusted.

This is a core technical seat inside IT and Security, and an early one. You'll set the standards for how integrations get built, monitored, documented, and secured, all while supporting two parallel product platforms during the migration. The work also lays the foundation for how AI agents access Fullbay's data, which makes this a chance to shape both how the company runs today and how it uses AI tomorrow.

The Right Wrench for the Job

In a heavy-duty shop, the best technicians know that a truck doesn't run on one good part. It runs because the fuel system, the electrical harness, and the ECM all talk to each other without anyone thinking about it. When one connection fails, the whole rig sits in the bay. That's the work this role owns: the connections nobody notices until they break.

You're the right fit if you take pride in integrations that run quietly, fail loudly, and can be picked up by someone else without a phone call. You're comfortable moving from an API doc to a Snowflake model to a runbook in the same afternoon, you treat credentials and service accounts with the care they deserve, and you're curious about how AI agents will tap into company data in the years ahead.

This isn't the role for someone who needs a dedicated integration team, an established architecture, and a backlog that's already been scoped. If you do your best work when the standards are already written and someone else decides how things connect, this isn't your shop. But if you're energized by building the plumbing from scratch, enjoy partnering with Finance, RevOps, and IT to turn manual pain into reliable automation, and want to help define how Fullbay's data works for both people and agents, we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • API Integration Development: Design, build, and maintain integrations between Fullbay's business applications (e.g., Rillet, Salesforce, Masset, Slack, Snowflake) to enable reliable, automated data flow across systems.
  • Data Pipelines: Build and maintain data pipelines feeding Fullbay's Snowflake data warehouse, supporting both organizational reporting and AI agent consumption of Fullbay data.
  • Process Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes across business applications and design automations that remove them, in partnership with the business owners affected.
  • Monitoring & Error Handling: Build monitoring, logging, and alerting for integration jobs so failures are caught and resolved before they affect the business, rather than discovered downstream.
  • Vendor API Management: Manage API credentials and authentication for integrated systems, track vendor API changes and deprecations, and coordinate directly with vendors on integration issues.
  • Dual-Platform Awareness: Account for Fullbay's two parallel product platforms (legacy and current systems) when building integrations that touch product data, since both remain in active use during the migration period.
  • Documentation: Document integration architecture, data flows, credentials ownership, and runbooks so integrations are maintainable by others, not just their original builder.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with business stakeholders (e.g., Finance on Rillet, RevOps on Salesforce) and other IT & Security team members to gather integration requirements and prioritize work.
  • Security & Access Governance: Apply least-privilege principles to service accounts and API keys, and support security review of integrations as Fullbay's governance program matures.
  • Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building integrations or automations between SaaS/business applications required.
  • Practical experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and modern authentication protocols (OAuth2, API keys) required.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language commonly used for integration work required.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse platform (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered in place of a degree.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Comfort working independently in a fully remote environment, with no dedicated integration team to lean on and while helping define the processes as they're built.
  • Experience with Snowflake specifically, including data modeling for a warehouse serving both reporting and application/agent consumption, strongly preferred.
  • Preferred: experience integrating financial/accounting systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct).
  • Preferred: experience with the Salesforce API and data model.
  • Preferred: experience with AWS services relevant to integration work (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge).
  • Preferred: familiarity with iPaaS/automation platforms (e.g., Workato, Zapier, Tray.io, n8n).
  • Preferred: exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other emerging patterns for AI agent access to business data and systems.
  • Preferred: experience at a small or scaling company (under ~500 employees) where integration processes and standards were still being built.
  • Strong written communication skills, with a track record of documenting technical work clearly for others to maintain.
  • Security-conscious approach to credential, secret, and API key management.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, compliance-driven Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist to own end-to-end payroll processing and benefits administration across multiple entities. This role sits at the intersection of HR and Finance, serving as the primary bridge between the two teams on all compensation-related matters, while also providing reliable generalist HR support under the direction of the HR Director.

Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist Compensation and Benefits

$70,000-$90,000 depending on experience and location

100% Remote position

Health, Dental, and Vision insurance

401(K) with matching contribution

Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

Responsibilities

Payroll Administration

  • Manage the end-to-end processing of employee compensation, ensuring workers are paid accurately and on schedule.
  • Process multi-entity payroll on schedule, ensuring accuracy, regulatory compliance, and timely submission across all applicable jurisdictions.
  • Maintain payroll records, audit pay data, resolve discrepancies (including SUTA setup and account management), and reconcile payroll reports against Finance records.
  • Manage payroll implications of employee status changes — new hires, terminations, leaves of absence, reclassifications, and compensation adjustments.
  • Support payroll setup and administration for newly established entities, including a non-profit arm, ensuring proper classification of employees and compliance with applicable tax-exempt entity requirements.
  • Manage international workers and contractors by navigating country-specific currencies, statutory benefits, and local tax laws, as needed.
  • Prepare and file periodic and year-end tax forms, including W-2s.
  • Reconcile payroll data with the general ledger and bank statements.
  • Generate internal reports for Finance and Human Resources.
  • Assist internal or external auditors by providing documentation.
  • Answer employee inquiries regarding paychecks, tax withholding, or deductions.

Benefits Administration

  • Administer group health, dental, vision, life, and ancillary benefit plans, including open enrollment, qualifying life events, and COBRA processing.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefits inquiries, vendor escalations, and carrier issue resolution.
  • Reconcile monthly benefits invoices against enrollment data and coordinate corrections with Finance.
  • Support the annual benefits renewal process, including data preparation, employee communications, and enrollment system updates.

HR Generalist Support

  • Maintain personnel records, HRIS data integrity, and employee files in compliance with applicable recordkeeping requirements.
  • Assist with onboarding and offboarding administration, including documentation, systems access coordination, and I-9 compliance.
  • Support HR reporting needs, including headcount, turnover, benefits utilization, and ad hoc data requests from leadership.
  • Partner with your direct supervisor on HR projects, compliance initiatives, and company planning as directed.
  • Complete and submit HR paperwork accurately and timely.
  • Perform other duties and assigned tasks.

Qualifications

  • SHRM-CP and CPP certification required at a minimum; PHR or FPC certification is a strong plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Accounting, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on payroll processing experience using a recognized payroll platform or equivalent, with demonstrated accuracy in multi-state payroll.
  • At least 3 years of benefits administration experience, including carrier management, open enrollment coordination, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of federal and state wage and hour laws, benefits regulations (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA), and payroll tax requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage payroll and benefits across multiple legal entities or business units simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with non-profit or tax-exempt entity HR and payroll considerations (e.g., 501(c)(3) employee classification, Form 990 employee disclosure requirements).
  • Proficiency in HRIS and payroll platforms (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, Gusto, or equivalent); experience in multi-system environments preferred.
  • Comfort working in a remote environment with Finance, Operations, and HR stakeholders across separate business units.
  • Ability and means to travel up to 10% of the time as needed.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Windchill Java Developer focused on deep, low-level Windchill customizations using Java, PTC APIs, and PTC’s customization frameworks. This role suits engineers who enjoy working close to the platform, extending its behavior through services, listeners, and processors while preserving a clean and upgrade-friendly customization layer. The ideal candidate will bring strong Java fundamentals, deep familiarity with the Windchill platform internals, and a disciplined, performance-aware engineering style. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop advanced Java customizations within Windchill, including custom services, listeners, processors, validators, and helpers.
  • Extend the Windchill data model with custom types, attributes, and relationships using Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Build custom JSP and HTML extensions, including custom tables, actions, and wizard pages.
  • Develop custom queues and background processes for asynchronous Windchill tasks.
  • Implement complex workflow expressions and robot delegates in Java, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of Java customizations, including profiling, query tuning, and caching strategies.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?

At Really Great Reading, we are building a bright, diverse, and passionate team dedicated to leading the industry in improving literacy scores nationwide. With nearly two decades of leadership bringing the Science of Reading to thousands of schools, we design innovative products, training, and materials that transform how educators teach and how students learn. Here, we empower our team with the tools, support, and professional growth opportunities they need to thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment—where your work truly makes a difference.

Why This Role Matters

Behind every successful marketing campaign is an operation that makes sure the right message reaches the right audience at the right time, and that we can measure what happens next. At Really Great Reading, our marketing team supports product launches, state-specific campaigns, customer communications, and sales enablement, all powered by the same core systems: HubSpot, email, automation, and reporting.

When those systems work well, campaigns launch on schedule, teams have reliable data, and we can see what's working and where we need to adjust. The Marketing Operations Manager owns that reliability, turning campaign plans into working builds and keeping our marketing systems healthy as we grow.

Success in this role means campaigns launch accurately and on time, HubSpot and our marketing data remain reliable, email performance stays healthy, and our teams have the reporting and automation they need to make informed decisions and work more efficiently.

The Role

The Marketing Operations Manager is the technical and operational partner responsible for the systems, processes, and execution that keep RGR’s marketing programs running effectively.

You’ll own HubSpot administration, email health, and technical campaign execution across product launches, priority-state campaigns, lifecycle and customer communications, and sales enablement. Working closely with Product Marketing, Content, and Sales, you’ll translate campaign requirements into reliable builds, automation, and reporting. Strategy owners define what a campaign needs to accomplish; you determine how to build it well and make sure it runs.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably between marketing strategy and technical execution: equally capable of translating campaign goals into effective HubSpot builds, troubleshooting systems and data when something isn’t working, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to keep campaigns moving and measurable.

What You’ll Do

  • HubSpot administration. Own HubSpot configuration, properties, lists, user permissions, data hygiene, and marketing integrations.
  • Email health and deliverability. Monitor sender reputation, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene, and resolve deliverability issues before they affect campaigns.
  • Consent and compliance. Maintain subscription types, consent workflows, and opt-out handling in line with applicable email and privacy regulations.
  • Lifecycle and sequence builds. Build nurture, lifecycle, customer communication, and sales sequence templates in HubSpot from briefs provided by Product Marketing and campaign owners.
  • Technical campaign execution. Build emails, forms, workflows, and landing page components, and run QA so campaigns launch on schedule.
  • Reporting implementation. Build dashboards and reports to requirements, and keep campaign and attribution data clean and consistent.
  • Build intake and process. Maintain campaign build templates, intake, and QA checklists, so requests arrive complete and ship predictably.
  • Automation and efficiency. Implement automation and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual campaign, operational, and reporting work.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 3–5 years of experience in marketing operations, HubSpot administration, or lifecycle marketing
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience with workflows, lists, properties, forms, and email
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability and authentication
  • Experience building automated nurture or lifecycle programs
  • Reporting and attribution literacy, including building dashboards and troubleshooting data issues
  • Strong QA habits and the ability to manage several campaign builds at once
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with non-technical partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • HubSpot certifications, such as Marketing Hub or Operations Hub
  • Experience with consent management and email and privacy regulations
  • Experience with integration or automation tools such as Zapier or Make, or with AI-assisted workflows
  • Basic HTML and CSS for email and landing page troubleshooting
  • K–12 education, EdTech, or B2B experience with long sales cycles

What We Offer

We take care of the whole person, because we believe that when our team thrives, so do the students and educators we serve. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive 401(k) with company matching
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Paid Time Off to support rest, renewal, and life outside of work
  • Employee Discount Program and partner savings
  • Ongoing professional development and learning investment
  • Wellness initiatives designed to support physical, mental, and emotional well-being
  • Evolving benefits shaped by team member voice and values

Physical Requirements

This is a fully remote role. Team members work primarily at a computer and regularly engage in video conferencing, document review, and digital collaboration. You must be able to work at a screen for extended periods, use standard input devices, and participate in virtual meetings.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Really Great Reading is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performing workplace that reflects the diverse students, educators, and communities we serve. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation, improve learning outcomes, and advance educational equity nationwide.

WSP jest wiodącą na świecie firmą inżynieryjną, specjalizującą się w infrastrukturze, transporcie, ochronie środowiska, energii i budynkach.

Mamy jasną wizję tego, w jaki sposób chcemy pomóc uczynić świat lepszym miejscem, wspierając społeczności i to, co jest naprawdę ważne dla naszej przyszłości.

Wyobraź sobie lepszą przyszłość dla nas wszystkich - i lepszą przyszłość dla Ciebie.

Ze względu na dynamiczny rozwój na rynku, WSP w Polsce poszukuje ekspertów do naszego działu Infrastruktury. Obecnie poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Bridge engineer.

W tej roli dołączysz do wielobranżowego zespołu, który odzwierciedla podstawowe wartości naszej firmy: solidarność, pasję do realizacji złożonych projektów na dużą skalę oraz innowacyjność i życzliwość.

TWOJA NOWA ROLA, CO BĘDZIESZ ROBIĆ?

GŁÓWNE OBOWIĄZKI:

  • Prace projektowe w branży mostowej, obliczenia i modelowanie konstrukcji w programie 3D.

  • Analiza rozwiązań technicznych i materiałów pod kątem doboru technologii i metod budowlanych.

  • Weryfikacja poprawności i optymalizacja rozwiązań projektowych, sporządzanie przedmiarów robót.

  • Komunikacja i koordynacja przygotowywanych projektów z innymi zespołami technicznymi.

  • Branie czynnego udziału w komunikacji z Klientem oraz spełnianie wymagań projektowych Klienta.

ZESPÓŁ

Zespół mostowy WSP tworzy profesjonalne rozwiązania projektowe związane z nowymi i rewitalizowanymi obiektami. Posiadamy doświadczenie we wszystkich aspektach inżynierii mostów. Bierzemy czynny udział na każdym etapie procesu projektowego różnorodnej skali inwestycji infrastrukturalnych, począwszy od koncepcji, poprzez projekty budowlane, wykonawcze, po nadzór autorski na budowie.

Wykonujemy audyty techniczne obiektów istniejących i projekty wzmocnień. Naszą specjalnością są także optymalizacje kosztowe.

Używamy najnowszych narzędzi projektowych, takich jak analiza 3D FEM (za pomocą różnych programów – SOFiSTiK, Robot Structural Analysis, BRIGADE i Mathcad) do obliczeń, a także oprogramowania Tekla i Revit do modelowania BIM. Członkowie naszego zespołu posiadają międzynarodowe doświadczenie zdobyte przy projektach w Szwecji, Finlandii, Anglii, Niemczech i na Bliskim Wschodzie.

Działem zarządza Dyrektor działu Infrastruktury i Konstrukcji. Zespół w tym momencie liczy około 40 osób, należą do niego inżynierowie i koordynatorzy BIM.

CO BY BYŁO, GDYBYŚ TO BYŁ TY?

WYMAGANIA

  • Doświadczenia w projektowaniu infrastrukturalnym (mosty).

  • Znajomość Polskiego Prawa Budowlanego, Norm i Standardów w swojej branży.

  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.

OFERUJEMY

Środowisko pracy inspirowane różnorodnością, napędzane przez integrację.

Nasza elastyczna organizacja pracy - doceniamy wartość równowagi między życiem zawodowym a prywatnym i zachęcamy do jej znalezienia.

Job Title: Infrastructure Reliability Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer to build and operate the large-scale data systems that power modern AI training and evaluation pipelines. The role combines deep data engineering expertise with a strong understanding of AI workloads, focusing on ingestion, transformation, quality assurance, lineage, and high-throughput delivery of data to training jobs across diverse modalities. The ideal candidate has experience operating petabyte-scale data systems, strong software engineering fundamentals, and clear understanding of how data infrastructure choices propagate into model quality and training efficiency.

  • Build high-throughput data loading systems that maximize GPU utilization during training.
  • Implement labeling workflows, active learning pipelines, and human-in-the-loop data improvement systems.
  • Design storage architectures balancing cost, throughput, and latency across data tiers.
  • Build evaluation dataset construction pipelines with strict integrity and contamination controls.
  • Implement data privacy, redaction, and consent enforcement throughout the pipeline.
  • Collaborate with ML researchers and engineers to align data systems with model development needs.
  • Drive observability of data quality, drift, and pipeline health across the AI data estate.
  • Optimize cost and performance through compression, format selection, and caching strategies.
  • Document data systems, schemas, and operational procedures for broad internal use.
  • Stay current with AI data infrastructure research and emerging open-source tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Six or more years of data engineering experience, with significant work supporting ML or AI workloads.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and at least one JVM or systems language.

Job Summary

The Sales Compensation Analyst, Systems & Operations is a hands-on member of the Sales Compensation team, cross-trained across the team's core operational areas — system administration (Callidus/SAP Commissions), payment processing, accruals and reconciliation, and seller support. Because system automation doesn't cover every scenario, this role also requires strong hands-on Excel skills to independently calculate, validate, and reconcile commission and incentive payments, build supporting models, and produce audit-ready backup when the system output needs to be checked, corrected, or replicated manually. The analyst ensures the accuracy and integrity of compensation data end to end and provides reporting and analysis that supports sales, finance, and executive leadership, with a keen eye toward opportunities for process improvement and ways to automate manual work.


Key Responsibilities

Compensation Systems & Platform Administration

  • Serve as operational point of contact for the Callidus (SAP Commissions) platform, acting as backup system administrator and managing the day-to-day relationship with the implementation partner.
  • Set and lead recurring meetings with internal stakeholders on system deliverables, timelines, and open items.
  • Maintain and prioritize tracking of all Callidus configuration updates, enhancements, and defect resolutions; produce routine status reports and escalate risks proactively.
  • Test all system updates for completeness and accuracy prior to production deployment; document and communicate defects with resolution timelines.
  • Manage the annual implementation partner budget; reconcile vendor invoices against contracted deliverables and escalate anomalies to leadership.
  • Oversee the Salesforce intake queue for Account, Opportunity, and compensation-related data updates; maintain SOPs, governance approval levels, and intake procedures.
  • Contribute to the ongoing design and improvement of compensation processes, systems, plan structures, and quota/modeling tools.

Manual Calculation, Validation & Reconciliation

  • Independently calculate, validate, and reconcile commission and incentive payments in Excel when system logic cannot fully automate a scenario, ensuring every payout is accurate and audit-ready.
  • Build and maintain Excel-based models and calculators to test plan designs, quota structures, and edge cases before they are configured in Callidus.
  • Execute daily data intake audits to verify completeness and accuracy of feeds into Callidus; identify, document, and resolve data defects and processing delays with upstream teams.
  • Produce the monthly accrual file for Accounting & Finance, and extract commission calculations for management, executive, and HR payout approval.
  • Lead compensation audit workflows for specific sales representatives, and complete ad hoc audit requests in partnership with the legal team.

Reporting & Business Partnership

  • Build and maintain performance-versus-goal tracking and KPI reporting using data from Salesforce, the data warehouse, and Callidus.
  • Build Annual Comp Structure & Plan documents in partnership with Sales and Sales Operations leadership.
  • Produce performance reporting on sales initiatives and programs (promotions, new customers, program ROI) and additional ad hoc analysis as needed.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex or time-sensitive intake requests, and resolve sales force inquiries received through compensation support channels.

Seller Support

  • Research and resolve seller compensation questions, payout discrepancies, and calculation issues.
  • Clearly explain calculation results; escalate complex plan-design or policy questions to the appropriate team member.
  • Support ad-hoc audit requests with the legal team as needed.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve process accuracy and efficiency.
  • Participate in automation, AI-enabled validation, and other improvements led by the team.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience) required.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in sales compensation administration, sales operations, or a related analytical role.
  • Understanding of sales compensation plan mechanics and how they drive sales behavior and support broader sales organization goals.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Callidus (SAP Commissions) or a comparable incentive compensation management (ICM) platform, required.
  • Experience using Salesforce CRM for data management or operational workflows.
  • Experience in a medium to large-sized sales organization preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced Excel skills required, including complex formulas, mathematical/conditional logic, and the ability to build and troubleshoot commission calculations manually without relying on the ICM system.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy in high-volume operational environments.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and bring projects to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Clear, direct communication skills; able to translate technical system issues for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with proven follow-through on open items.
  • Comfortable cross-training and flexing across operational functions.
  • Familiarity with data or reporting tools (SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau) a plus.
  • Knowledge of SOX compliance and audit-ready documentation practices preferred.

Job Description Summary

Intergalactic now a part of Unison, a GE Aerospace Company, is a team of engineers, technologists, designers, mathematicians, and problem solvers committed to a singular idea: reviving the no-boundaries mentality in aerospace. We are a team of the nation’s best, regardless of where we live.

The Electrical Systems Engineer will serve as a technical leader for high‑reliability digital power conversion and electric drive systems, spanning architecture, detailed design, verification, and validation of Thermal Management Systems. This role focuses on developing and qualifying TMS control systems, advanced DC/DC conversion hardware and controls for aerospace applications, including high‑voltage power conversion, motor drive systems, and associated protection, monitoring, and control circuitry. The systems engineer will drive cross‑functional integration across systems, hardware, test, and manufacturing teams, ensuring safe, robust, and compliant solutions that meet customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

While providing Thermal Management Systems requirements support, collaborating with mechanical and systems engineering teams to ensure integrated electrical and thermal solutions for high‑reliability aerospace hardware is a paramount function to this position.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Own system‑level requirements flow‑down for digital power conversion hardware, decomposing customer and system requirements into clear, testable hardware and firmware requirements, and ensuring traceability throughout the design lifecycle.
  • Document and communicate design decisions, analyses, and test outcomes through formal reports and technical reviews, ensuring traceability and a strong customer‑driven focus.
  • Lead architecture and detailed design of digital power conversion, including DC/DC stages, gate drives, protection circuits, sensing chains, and control electronics, with emphasis on high‑voltage and high‑power aerospace applications.
  • Plan and execute verification and validation of digital power conversion hardware and systems, including procedure authorship, lab setup, and execution of environmental, functional, and performance tests (e.g., DO160/MIL-STD-461/MIL-STD-704‑type conditions, thermal, vibration, electrical stress).
  • Define and validate insulation coordination and HV design rules, including creepage/clearance and high‑voltage practices for converters and drive systems operating at several kilovolts, to meet aerospace safety and reliability expectations.
  • Design and Review PCBs and schematics for power stages, gate drivers, control boards, and sensing modules using industry‑standard tools (e.g., Mentor Graphics, Altium), collaborating with layout, mechanical, and systems teams to ensure robust, manufacturable designs.
  • Lead high‑voltage testing and qualification activities, including partial discharge (corona) tests and insulation tests at altitude and ground level, using results to drive design improvements and ensure long‑term reliability.
  • Work with AI&T to develop and improve automated test benches and lab infrastructure for digital power testing, including scripting and automation where appropriate, and act as a champion for lab safety, structured test procedures, and safe operation at high voltage and high power.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to early career engineers and peers in power converter design, HV test, and system integration, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, structured problem solving, and respect for people
  • Contribute to proposals, trade studies, and technology roadmaps for TMS control systems, digital power systems, including evaluation of new topologies, devices, and architectures.

Required Minimum Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering or related discipline with emphasis in power electronics, power conversion, or electric drives.
  • Significant experience (e.g., 15+ years) in electrical engineering and electrical systems engineering with focus on power electronics, digital power conversion, and/or electric drive systems, and controls hardware for aerospace or similarly demanding applications.
  • Proven experience leading the design, verification, and validation of power conversion hardware (DC/DC, AC/DC, DC/AC) and associated control electronics.
  • Experience with high‑voltage systems, insulation coordination, and HV testing and qualification activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional technical teams and manage technical scope, schedule, and risk.

Desired Characteristics & Experience:

  • Strong background in electrical systems engineering, requirements decomposition, and PCB/schematic design for power and control boards (gate drivers, sensors, DSP/control boards, HVDC filters, EMI filters), including DO160/MIL-STD-461/MIL-STD-704‑aware design practices and integration with system‑level requirements.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in complex aerospace programs and coordination of cross‑functional teams, with clear alignment to GE Aerospace Behaviors (Respect for People, Continuous Improvement, Customer Driven).
  • Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools for power electronics (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, LTSpice, PSIM, PSCAD) and experience using them to guide design and test.
  • Proficient use of IBM DOORS and familiarity with MBSE tools
  • Familiarity with JIRA and Confluence
  • Experience designing and validating high‑voltage, high‑power conversion systems (e.g., up to several kilovolts) for aerospace, including insulation coordination and partial discharge considerations.
  • Hands‑on HV lab experience, including oscilloscopes, power analyzers, HV test setups, and automated test benches, with a demonstrated commitment to lab safety and structured test procedures.

Additional Information:

  • Up to 10% travel is required.

*** This position can be remote or on-site in St. George Utah

GE Aerospace will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.


The base pay range for this position is $130,000 - $150,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 23, 2026.


GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.


GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.
