jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

The DCX Client Services - Home Based Project Manager will work as a full-time employee for a growing business based in the United States. You will get a chance to learn new skills as well as demonstrate skills you've learned in the past. You will be responsible for closely following the instructions and processes outlined by our client.


In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the successful delivery of digital marketing projects and campaigns from kickoff through completion. You will work closely with clients, creative teams, marketing specialists, developers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within approved scope, and to the expected quality standards.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced agency environment. You should be able to anticipate potential roadblocks, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and keep projects moving while maintaining a strong understanding of the client's goals and expectations.


REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Project Planning & Organization – Effectively plans, coordinates, and manages multiple digital marketing projects, campaigns, and deliverables while meeting deadlines and priorities.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management – Communicates clearly and professionally with clients and internal teams, facilitates meetings, provides project updates, and ensures everyone understands responsibilities and next steps.
  • Attention to Detail & Quality Assurance – Maintains accuracy across project timelines, campaign requirements, content, creative assets, tracking, approvals, and final deliverables.
  • Problem Solving & Risk Management – Proactively identifies potential delays, resource constraints, scope changes, quality issues, and other project risks and takes appropriate action to keep projects on track.
  • Digital Marketing Project Knowledge – Understands the general workflow and dependencies involved in digital marketing projects, including websites, SEO, paid media, social media, email marketing, content, creative production, and digital campaigns.
  • Leadership & Accountability – Takes ownership of project outcomes, follows up on action items, holds stakeholders accountable to deadlines, and escalates issues when necessary.
  • Scope & Timeline Management – Ensures projects remain aligned with approved requirements, timelines, budgets, and client expectations while identifying and communicating scope changes.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead and coordinate digital marketing projects and campaigns from kickoff through final delivery
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, task assignments, and dependencies
  • Coordinate with creative, content, SEO, paid media, web development, social media, and other marketing teams to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule
  • Serve as a primary point of coordination between clients and internal project teams
  • Facilitate internal and client meetings, prepare agendas, document decisions, and distribute meeting recaps and action items
  • Monitor project progress and proactively follow up with team members on outstanding tasks and deadlines
  • Identify project risks, bottlenecks, resource constraints, and potential delays and develop solutions or escalate them appropriately
  • Ensure project deliverables are aligned with the approved scope of work (SOW), campaign objectives, timelines, and client expectations
  • Coordinate the review and approval process for marketing materials, creative assets, website updates, content, advertisements, and other digital deliverables
  • Manage feedback and revisions by ensuring comments are documented, assigned, tracked, and resolved
  • Conduct or coordinate quality assurance checks before deliverables are presented to clients or launched
  • Coordinate website, landing page, email, social media, paid advertising, SEO, and other digital marketing deliverables as required
  • Assist in coordinating campaign launches and ensuring all required assets, links, tracking, approvals, and dependencies are completed
  • Monitor project budgets, hours, and time tracking to help ensure projects remain financially aligned with approved scope
  • Communicate project status, milestones, risks, and upcoming priorities to clients and internal leadership
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, files, timelines, task boards, and project records
  • Help improve project management processes, workflows, templates, and documentation
  • Support onboarding and implementation of new clients, campaigns, and internal processes
  • Work collaboratively with Project Managers, Account Managers, Marketing Specialists, Designers, Developers, Copywriters, and other team members
  • Stay informed about evolving digital marketing tools, platforms, technologies, and AI-enabled workflows
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned based on business and client needs

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Advertising, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in project management, digital marketing, marketing operations, account coordination, agency operations, or a related role.
  • Experience working in a marketing agency, advertising agency, digital marketing team, or client services environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, campaigns, or clients simultaneously is preferred.

Communication

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively with U.S.-based clients and internal teams
  • Comfortable facilitating meetings, presenting project updates, and communicating project risks or delays
  • Ability to communicate professionally and confidently with stakeholders at different levels

Digital Marketing Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of digital marketing concepts and workflows, including:
  • SEO
  • Paid search/PPC
  • Social media marketing
  • Email marketing
  • Content marketing
  • Website development and maintenance
  • Landing pages and conversion-focused campaigns
  • Digital advertising and creative production
  • Analytics, tracking, and campaign reporting
  • Understanding of how different marketing functions work together within a campaign
  • Basic understanding of marketing performance metrics and KPIs is a plus

Technical & Project Management Skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
  • Experience with project/task management platforms such as Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, JIRA, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with communication and collaboration tools such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with proofing and approval platforms such as PageProof, ProofHub, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with website content management systems such as WordPress is a plus
  • Familiarity with digital marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, or similar tools is a plus
  • Strong ability to manage project timelines, dependencies, priorities, and deliverables
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to maintain an organized digital workspace and project documentation

Additional Job Requirements

  • Education: College degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or any related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of proven work experience as Project Manager or similar role.
  • Highly organized and able to multitask and oversee several projects simultaneously.
  • Website project experience is a plus
  • Strong understanding of formal project management methodologies.

About DCX

DCX is a leading BPO that supports growth minded small and medium sized businesses in the United States. If you're interested in working with some of the fastest growing companies in the USA, we're excited to have you apply!


To our customers, we promise that we will help them focus on their most important goals by providing superior back-office services. We bring a mindset of quick response, attention to detail, and innovative ideas to all that we do for our customers.


To our team members, we promise to be a company that is, first and foremost, dedicated to our employees. We aim to be a compassionate organization that looks after everyone's well-being through generous salaries, empathetic management, and growth-oriented training. We are always looking to offer perks in addition to pay, including work-from-home opportunities, travel allowances, meals, and more.

We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you better!

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.description:
Your Career Starts Here — Help Albertans Find the Right Membership

The Opportunity

This posting is for a regular part-time position with hours ranging from 21-30 hours per week. Availability between 8:00 am – 9:00 pm, 7 days a week, including statutory holidays, is required

Eligibility for this position requires residing in the greater Edmonton or Calgary area.
Are you a driven, people-first communicator who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment? As a Member Sales Representative (MSR-Sales), you will be a key part of AMA's Consolidated Contact Centre (CCC), where you'll connect with members and prospective members daily to help them find the right memberships, products, and services. This role blends consultative sales, member service, and multi-queue flexibility, making it ideal for someone who is energized by hitting targets, building relationships, and contributing to a team that genuinely cares about Albertans.

A Place to Belong
AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!
For us, curiosity fuels innovation. We value people who are eager to explore new ideas and who are comfortable putting emerging technologies into practice. We see experience with AI‑powered tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar platforms as a real plus - especially when it’s used to work smarter, increase efficiency, and find better ways to get things done.

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive salary and flexible benefits, with five packages to choose from and up to $3,000 in health and wellness spending accounts.
  • Employer-paid retirement savings program, including 5% AMA contribution and 5% matching.
  • Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, driver education, registry services, and more.
  • Free travel medical insurance for you and your immediate family.
  • Ongoing professional development, with unlimited learning opportunities, LinkedIn Learning Access, and dedicated time for personal growth.
  • Vacation earnings paid out with each pay period.

Who You Are

  • A driven sales professional who is motivated by achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Confident and resilient when handling objections and rejection: you see challenges as opportunities.
  • An active listener with strong verbal and written communication skills who builds rapport quickly.
  • Flexible and adaptable, able to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume contact centre environment.
  • Solutions-focused and resourceful, with the ability to quickly identify member needs and recommend the right products and services.
  • A collaborative team player who contributes positively to team performance and a supportive work culture.
  • Detail-oriented, with the ability to process transactions accurately and navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously.
  • Committed to delivering a friendly, professional member experience that reflects AMA's 'Practically Family' culture.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Drive membership acquisition and retention by managing outbound calling activities and achieving established sales, conversion, and retention targets.
  • Conduct consultative, needs-based conversations to identify member needs and recommend the most appropriate AMA memberships, products, and services.
  • Handle inbound and outbound member interactions professionally, following established service, sales, and quality standards.
  • Promote and enroll members in value-added products and services, including Auto Renew, AMA Gift Cards, eBill, and membership upgrades.
  • Manage follow-up activities to ensure timely outreach, maximize conversion opportunities, and enhance the member experience.
  • Identify and resolve member concerns effectively or escalate issues appropriately to ensure a positive member experience.
  • Support members with online account access and digital self-service tools.
  • Flex between queues based on call volume, service levels, and operational requirements to support CCC service delivery.
  • Maintain accuracy when processing transactions and using membership systems and contact centre tools.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and contribute ideas that enhance member experience, sales performance, and operational effectiveness.

What You Bring to the Table

  • High School Diploma or equivalent is required; post-secondary education is an asset.
  • Demonstrated customer service experience and sales experience, including achieving sales or retention targets.
  • Bonus points if you have experience in a contact centre environment.
  • Experience using customer service, customer relationship management, or sales systems is an asset.
  • Strong sales skills with resilience when handling objections and rejection.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and confidently handle member questions.
  • Proficiency with computer applications and contact centre systems, including Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work scheduled shifts in accordance with operational requirements, including weekends and statutory holidays.

Belonging Matters Here
AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact . We’ll work with you feel supported throughout your journey with us.

jobs.excerpt: 🧠 About Legion HealthAt Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.
jobs.description:
🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Job Type: Full-Time

  • Role Type: Provider Partnerships / Field Sales / Referral Growth / Growth / Sales

  • Ideal Experience Level: 4+ years carrying and hitting a quota in a full-cycle, customer-facing role

  • Location: Dallas, Texas territory (field-based), with occasional travel for team offsites and strategic meetings

  • US Visa Sponsorship: Yes

🚀 The Opportunity

Legion is hiring a Provider Partnerships Lead to build and own the referral relationships that connect providers to Legion's psychiatric care. This is a ground-floor, quota-carrying role on a brand-new team: you'll be one of Legion's first dedicated field sales hires, which means you'll help define the playbook, not just run it.

PCPs see mental health needs in their patients every day but rarely have a fast, trusted place to send patients. You'll be that trusted place — building in-person relationships with physicians, medical assistants, office managers, and administrators that turn a single conversation into a durable referral pipeline.

You will own your defined territory like a business: unlocking new practice relationships, running the full partnership cycle, and growing referral volume in accounts you've already won.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • Carry a quota for provider referral partnerships and referral volume in your territory, and treat it as your scoreboard.

  • Run the full cycle: self-source through prospecting, build the case with practice decision-makers, and close.

  • Keep your pipeline and account activity clean and current in the CRM.

  • Spend the majority of your week in the field meeting with physicians, medical assistants, office managers, and administrators; supplement with virtual outreach and follow-up.

  • Represent Legion credibly to clinical and administrative customers, translating a new category of AI-enabled psychiatric care into a clear, compelling referral case.

  • Map the decision-making unit inside each practice and build multi-threaded relationships that move a partnership from first meeting to live referrals.

  • Become a trusted resource to providers by educating them on Legion's model and the impact fast, accessible psychiatric care has on their patients.

  • Set each practice up for a clean handoff so patient referrals convert into scheduled visits.

  • Feed what you learn in the field back into messaging, targeting, and the sales playbook. You're building this function, not inheriting it.

  • Partner with leadership on territory design, targeting, and process as the team scales.

  • Collaborate with your peers across territories sharing what's working, troubleshooting objections together, and helping build a team where everyone's win rate goes up.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If You…

  • Are driven by the number: hitting quota is satisfying, beating it is the point, and you don't need anyone chasing you for it.

  • Would rather write the playbook than inherit one, and see the ambiguity of a new category as opportunity, not friction.

  • Earn trust with physicians quickly. You can get in front of a busy clinician, read the room, and move a skeptical conversation toward a signed partnership.

  • Treat change as normal. Territories, tooling, and the field/virtual mix will evolve as we scale, and you adapt fast while staying focused on results.

  • Are energized by the mission of making fast, affordable psychiatric care accessible through better referral pathways.

  • Welcome coaching and feedback and treat growth as a team sport.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

  • 4+ years carrying and hitting a quota in a field-based or B2B2C role; healthcare, medical device, or pharma referral sales strongly preferred.

  • Comfort and skill in front of clinical and administrative buyers; you can build physician rapport and move a conversation toward a partnership.

  • Strength selling in person, with the judgment to know what a given relationship needs.

  • Highly organized and analytical, comfortable owning a number and reasoning from your own pipeline data.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the polish to represent Legion well externally.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales tooling.

  • Existing relationships with provider referral networks are a plus, but not required.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Comp: OTE range of $120,000 to $180,000 depending on experience. Competitive base + uncapped, performance-based variable commission tied to your number, plus meaningful early-stage equity

  • Additional Perks: Mileage and travel reimbursement at the IRS standard rate, coverage for field and provider engagement expenses, cell phone stipend

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work Setup: Hybrid — primarily in-field throughout the Dallas territory, with remote planning and some travel for team meetings

  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Impact: Build the referral engine that connects primary care to the future of psychiatric care

  • Growth Opportunities: As we scale, this role can grow into a leadership role, building out enablement or larger partnership role.

📝 How to Apply and Hiring Process

  • Apply here: Use the application form on this page.

  • Overview of our hiring process:

    1. Resume + Recruiter Screen

    2. Hiring Manager Interview

    3. Founder Interviews (2)

    4. Professional Reference Checks

  • Estimated time-to-hire: 3 weeks

  • Start date: ASAP

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

  • Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.

  • Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.

  • A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.

  • Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.

  • Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.

  • Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

What you'll do:

  • Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.

  • Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.

  • Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.

  • Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.

  • Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.

  • Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.

  • Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.

  • AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What you'll bring:

  • Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.

  • Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.

  • Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).

  • Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.

  • Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).

  • Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).

  • Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.

  • Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.

  • University degree in Computer Science or any related field.

  • Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

Benefits & Perks 🎁

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Health and life insurance program.

  • Learning & development budget.

  • Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply!We’d love to hear from you!

All applications will be treated with confidentiality.Please note that due to the high volume of CVs received, only candidates who are a good fit will be contacted for an interview.

As part of our commitment to diversity in the workforce, Infiterra is dedicated to Equal Employment Opportunity, ensuring that all individuals are treated with respect and consideration without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

jobs.description:
Chief Operating & Financial Officer (COFO)

Backpack Healthcare | Hybrid/Remote | Preferred: MD, GA, IL, MI, or VA

Build the Operating and Financial Engine Behind the Future of Behavioral Healthcare

Backpack Healthcare is on a mission to make high-quality mental healthcare more accessible to children, adolescents, young adults, and families who have historically been left out of the system.

We are a Medicaid-first, venture-backed behavioral health company delivering whole-family telehealth care across Maryland, Virginia, Georgia, Michigan, and Illinois. With 170+ clinicians, 219 employees, and more than 100 payer relationships, we are growing quickly while building a clear path to profitability.

We are looking for a Chief Operating & Financial Officer (COFO) who is ready to help build what comes next.

This is not a role for someone who wants to sit on the sidelines, analyze what happened, and prepare reports.

You will run the operating and financial engine of Backpack Healthcare.

You will own the numbers, own the outcomes, and lead the teams responsible for delivering both. You will work directly with our CEO and leadership team to turn data into decisions, decisions into execution, and execution into measurable results.

If you are energized by complexity, move quickly, love solving hard problems, and want to have a direct impact on the trajectory of a growing healthcare company, this could be the opportunity for you.

What You'll Do

💰 Own Financial Performance & Profitability

You will be accountable for Backpack's financial performance and the plan that gets us to sustainable profitability.

  • Own budgeting, forecasting, monthly close, financial reporting, and GAAP-compliant financial operations.

  • Build and manage the company's operating model, unit economics, and financial planning processes.

  • Translate financial data into clear operating decisions and actionable priorities.

  • Establish the financial discipline, visibility, and accountability required to scale.

  • Serve as a primary financial voice to our board and investors.

  • Present company performance, forecasts, risks, opportunities, and the path to profitability with confidence.

  • Partner with the CEO on fundraising, including financial modeling, investor materials, diligence, and financing negotiations.

💵 Own Revenue Cycle & Payer Economics

Revenue cycle isn't something you'll review from a distance. You'll own the results.

  • Take executive ownership of billing, collections, and revenue cycle performance across all states and payers.

  • Drive measurable improvements in clean claims, denials, days in A/R, and cash collections.

  • Analyze payer performance, reimbursement trends, and operational leakage.

  • Partner with Growth and Partnerships on Medicaid and MCO pricing, bids, and rate negotiations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve reimbursement, margin, and cash flow.

🤝 Make Every Direct Contract Work

Every contract needs to make business sense.

  • Model the economics and expected margin of direct contracts before they are signed.

  • Build the operational and financial plan required for successful implementation.

  • Establish staffing, onboarding, billing, and KPI requirements before launch.

  • Track actual performance against projected economics after launch.

  • Conduct post-launch reviews and take action when contracts miss targets — whether that means fixing operations, repricing, or renegotiating.

⚙️ Lead Business Operations

You will connect the dots across the organization and ensure our systems actually work together.

Your scope will include business operations, PMO, strategy and operations, credentialing, and care coordination.

  • Establish clear KPIs for each function and review performance on a consistent cadence.

  • Hold leaders accountable for measurable outcomes.

  • Build scalable processes that support multi-state growth.

  • Help prepare the organization for new market launches and expansion.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and eliminate them at the system level.

  • Ensure that referrals, hiring, credentialing, scheduling, billing, contracts, and cash work together as one operating system.

👥 Lead People & Administration

  • Provide executive oversight of the HR function, including talent, compensation, benefits, and workforce planning.

  • Partner with leadership to ensure we have the right people, structure, and accountability to support growth.

  • Manage critical vendor relationships and contracts.

  • Build an environment where leaders understand their numbers, own their outcomes, and follow through.

🛡️ Own Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure operational and financial compliance with Medicaid requirements, state regulations, HIPAA, and applicable accounting standards.

  • Identify risks before they become problems.

  • Bring solutions and action plans — not simply flags.

  • Build processes that make compliance sustainable as Backpack scales.

The Kind of Leader Who Will Thrive Here

We are looking for an operator, not simply an executive with an impressive résumé.

You act.

You see a problem on Monday and have a plan moving by Tuesday. You don't wait for perfect information or endless consensus.

You hold people accountable.

You establish clear expectations, inspect results, have direct conversations when targets are missed, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

You live in the KPIs.

You know the daily, weekly, and monthly metrics that drive the business. You use them to make decisions — not decorate PowerPoint slides.

You operate with urgency.

In healthcare, delays have consequences. A slow hire, delayed credentialing, missed claim, or inefficient workflow can affect both the company's financial performance and a family's ability to access care.

You're relentlessly curious.

You don't make assumptions. You ask why until you understand the root cause.

You are willing to get into the claims data, understand payer mix, examine workflows, and pressure-test the economics of a contract yourself before making a recommendation.

You think in systems.

This is a requirement.

You understand how referrals connect to intake, how hiring connects to capacity, how credentialing connects to revenue, how scheduling connects to utilization, and how billing connects to cash.

You don't patch symptoms. You fix systems.

You are an AI-native operator.

You see technology and AI as force multipliers.

Your first instinct is to ask:

Can we automate this? Can we build it? Can AI do this faster or better?

You use AI yourself to move faster, analyze information, and make better decisions. Backpack is building an AI-enabled data environment where leaders can access and interrogate company data through simple prompts — and we expect this role to take full advantage of it.

You can move between the weeds and the big picture.

One day you may be digging into a claims report or contract margin. The next, you're presenting a profitability strategy to the board.

You are equally comfortable doing the analysis yourself and stepping back to determine the strategic move.

You can keep up.

You'll work alongside a CEO who understands clinical operations, recruiting, forecasting, revenue cycle, growth, and the data connecting them.

You will be expected to bring answers, challenge assumptions, move quickly, and continuously raise the bar.

You are comfortable in the investor room.

You can confidently represent the business to our board and investors.

You know the numbers. You understand the story behind them. You can defend the plan, answer difficult questions, communicate risks honestly, and build confidence in where the company is going.

You don't take direct feedback personally.

This is a high-accountability environment.

You will receive direct feedback and be expected to give it in return. You can separate ego from outcomes, absorb tough feedback without becoming defensive, push back thoughtfully with data, and keep moving forward.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • MBA or CPA strongly preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive finance and operations leadership experience, including at least 5 years in healthcare.

  • Hands-on experience with Medicaid reimbursement and revenue cycle management; behavioral health experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated success helping a growth-stage or venture-backed company move toward profitability.

  • Experience presenting directly to boards and investors.

  • Experience supporting at least one institutional fundraising round.

  • Multi-state healthcare operations experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated success redesigning financial and operational processes end to end.

  • Proven ability to build cultures of accountability and consistently hit measurable targets.

  • Strong financial modeling, analytical, strategic, and operational skills.

  • Genuine commitment to expanding access to behavioral healthcare for underserved children and families.

What We Offer

Base Salary: $225,000–$300,000 annually

Plus:

  • Performance bonus tied to measurable KPI outcomes

  • Exceptional equity package

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Opportunity to directly influence the growth and trajectory of a venture-backed healthcare company

  • The chance to help expand access to behavioral healthcare for children and families who need it most

Why Backpack?

At Backpack Healthcare, we believe everyone carries an invisible backpack filled with experiences, stress, trauma, and challenges that others may not see.

Our job is to help make that backpack a little lighter.

As our COFO, you'll have the opportunity to build the systems, financial foundation, and operational infrastructure that allow us to reach more families — while helping build a company that is financially strong enough to serve them for the long term.

If you're looking for a traditional CFO seat, this probably isn't it.

If you're looking for a role where you can build, operate, challenge, solve, and make a measurable impact every day, we'd love to meet you.

Join Backpack Healthcare and help keep the financial foundation strong behind the work we do every day. 🎒

Backpack Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that the strength of our care depends on the diversity and wellbeing of our team. We celebrate differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other traits that make each person unique. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply for any position for which they are qualified and to bring their unique perspectives, experiences, and talents to our team.

jobs.description:
🚢 Discover OneOcean:
OneOcean is a unified brand born from the integration of OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group.
Owned by Lloyd’s Register, an organisation with more than 260 years of trust, integrity and leadership at sea, OneOcean combines the agility and ambition of a fast-moving innovator with the strength and stability of one of the world’s most trusted maritime institutions.
At the heart of OneOcean is a portfolio unlike any other in maritime. A comprehensive, integrated portfolio built on years of expertise, trusted by thousands of maritime professionals around the world.
🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance.
🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew?
  • Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.
  • Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024.
  • Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.
🧭 Navigating the position: Data Architect

As a Data Architect at OneOcean you will own the data architecture across our growing data organisation — partnering with the Data Engineering, BI and AI teams to facilitate roadmap delivery. You will own the discovery, documentation and specification of the data structures and models required for our products and analytics, including reverse-engineering source data from OneOcean SaaS products and helping design the right data stores for each use case. You will be a senior individual contributor working hand-in-glove with the Data Team Lead, BI Team Lead and AI Team Lead — providing the architectural backbone that keeps their delivery aligned, coherent and scalable.

You will work across the full breadth of our data estate — operational sources, lakehouse, analytical serving (Apache Druid, Apache Superset, Power BI) and the vector stores powering our AI products. You will set modelling standards, write the specifications that engineers build from, and ensure that what we build today doesn't paint us into a corner tomorrow.

This is a fully remote, Romania-based role.

🚢 Your Voyage Ahead:

  • Own the data architecture across OneOcean's data organisation — operational, lakehouse, analytical-serving and vector layers — providing a coherent target state and a pragmatic path to it.
  • Lead the discovery, documentation and specification of the data structures and models required to support product and analytics roadmaps.
  • Reverse-engineer source data from OneOcean SaaS products — building accurate logical models of upstream systems and identifying the data contracts, grain and semantics our pipelines depend on.
  • Design the right data store for each use case — choosing between OLTP, columnar / OLAP, lakehouse and vector approaches; making the trade-offs explicit.
  • Define and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models; produce clear ERDs, lineage and dimensional designs (star / snowflake, conformed dimensions, surrogate keys).
  • Establish and enforce modelling standards, naming conventions, data contracts and schema-evolution practices across teams.
  • Partner with the Data Team Lead, BI Team Lead and AI Team Lead — translating product and analytics needs into specifications their engineers can build from, and unblocking architectural decisions as they arise.
  • Collaborate with Product, Architecture and Engineering Team Leads to align data direction with the wider engineering strategy.
  • Champion data governance — cataloguing, lineage, ownership, quality, security and privacy.
  • Document architectural decisions (ADRs) so the why is preserved alongside the what.
  • Mentor engineers across the data organisation on modelling, design and architectural reasoning — without line-managing them.
  • Stay current with the data landscape and bring in proven techniques as they mature; foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and knowledge sharing.

🚢 Recommended to bring on board: 

  • 8+ years of commercial experience in data engineering, BI engineering or data architecture roles, with significant time spent on modelling and specification.
  • Demonstrable experience owning data architecture across multiple workloads — operational, analytical, lakehouse and (ideally) AI / vector.
  • Deep data-modelling expertise — conceptual, logical and physical; dimensional / star-schema; SCD; data contracts; semantic-layer design.
  • Strong SQL across multiple dialects; comfortable reading and reasoning about complex source-system schemas.
  • Proven ability to reverse-engineer SaaS / operational systems — discovering grain, primary keys, relationships, soft-delete patterns and quirks that aren't in the docs.
  • Solid working knowledge of analytical serving (e.g. Apache Druid, Apache Superset, Power BI) and the modelling patterns that make them perform.
  • Working knowledge of lakehouse approaches (e.g. Delta Lake) — MERGE semantics, partitioning, schema evolution.
  • Pragmatic decision-making — able to balance ideal architecture against delivery pressure and explain the trade-offs clearly.
  • Excellent written and visual communication — produces specifications and diagrams that engineers can build from with minimal ambiguity.
  • Exceptional collaboration and stakeholder skills — comfortable bridging engineering, BI, AI, product and business audiences.
  • Documentation discipline — Confluence-grade architectural records, ADRs, model dictionaries and onboarding material.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with vector databases and the modelling considerations for AI / RAG workloads (chunk strategy, metadata schema, embedding versioning).
  • Exposure to Data Vault or Anchor modelling alongside dimensional approaches.
  • Catalog / lineage tooling (e.g. DataHub, Atlan, Collibra, or similar) and data-quality frameworks (e.g. Great Expectations, Soda).
  • Experience with data contracts as code (e.g. Open Data Contract Standard) or schema registries.
  • Awareness of relevant data-protection regimes (GDPR, UK GDPR) and how they shape modelling decisions (PII tagging, retention, minimisation).
  • Python familiarity sufficient to read pipeline code and collaborate on PRs without needing translation.
  • Cloud-platform awareness — AWS preferred — and IaC familiarity (Terraform).
  • Maritime or other regulated-industry domain experience.

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Meta Media Buyer to take full ownership of Wild Pastures' paid social growth across Facebook and Instagram.

You'll own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of our Meta account, driving profitable customer acquisition for a subscription-based e-commerce business while working closely with our creative team to develop high-performing advertising.

This isn't a role where you'll simply manage campaigns. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex performance problems, thinks critically, challenges assumptions with data, and continuously looks for new opportunities to grow the business.

You'll collaborate closely with our creative strategists, editors, designers, and leadership team to turn performance insights into better creative—and better creative into stronger business results.

We value specialization over generalization. If Meta is your craft and you're passionate about becoming exceptional at it, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Meta as a growth channel for Wild Pastures, managing campaign strategy, account structure, budget allocation, optimization, and scaling across Facebook and Instagram.
  • Drive profitable growth for a subscription business by managing performance against clear business objectives, including ROAS, MER, nCAC, CPA, customer lifetime value (LTV), and payback efficiency.
  • Design and execute structured testing roadmaps across creative, offers, landing pages, campaign structures, and bidding strategies to continuously improve account performance.
  • Own platform creative strategy, using performance insights to identify opportunities and develop new concepts.
  • Brief and guide creative development, partnering with creative strategists and editors to bring strategy to life and improve performance.
  • Transform performance insights into creative direction by identifying patterns, winning messaging, audience behaviors, and emerging opportunities.
  • Monitor account performance daily, proactively identifying trends, investigating root causes, and communicating risks, opportunities, and recommendations before they become larger problems.
  • Stay up to date with Meta platform changes, measurement updates, attribution best practices, and emerging direct-response advertising trends.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta advertising for subscription-based e-commerce or direct-response brands.
  • Demonstrated success acquiring customers profitably for subscription businesses, with a strong understanding of customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), retention, churn, and payback period.
  • A proven track record of scaling profitable campaigns while managing meaningful advertising budgets.
  • Experience owning a Meta account end-to-end, from strategy through execution and optimization.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and genuine curiosity for solving performance problems.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics and how they connect to overall business growth.
  • Experience optimizing for subscription-specific business metrics rather than first-purchase revenue alone, with an understanding of customer quality, retention, and long-term profitability.
  • Comfortable using analytics and attribution platforms beyond Ads Manager (GA4, Haus, Mixpanel, or similar tools are a plus).
  • Strong creative instincts and an understanding of what makes effective direct-response advertising.
  • Ability to translate performance insights into actionable creative feedback that improves future campaigns.
  • Experience working closely with creative teams through briefing, iteration, and testing.

Bonus Points

  • Experience marketing premium food, health, wellness, supplement, or direct-to-consumer subscription brands..
  • Experience working within high-growth ecommerce companies..
  • Experience with AI-driven campaign optimization and emerging Google advertising technologies..
  • Familiarity with creative testing frameworks and direct-response marketing..
  • A passion for regenerative agriculture, nutrient-dense food, health, or wellness.

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it

  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team

す。

jobs.description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly gives Main Street businesses the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it. We only get paid one way: when they make real money. We own the entire system of record, all business applications (we replace ServiceTitan, House Call Pro, RingCentral, Squarespace, Docusign, Square, and a dozen other applications), and dozens of AI agents ourselves embedded natively inside our business applications, with native data read & write access to our system of record. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready AI Agents to our customers in under 30 minutes with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

Wonderly has the most result-driven business model, because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents work. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - we deliver real revenue and profit to our customers. All of our software and AI Agents are free - we charge a % of revenue we deliver for our customers. Each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve their revenue by 5-20%. This is the ultimate outcome-based pricing, only possible when you own the entire end-to-end system and all the agents yourself.

Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months of stealth to build. We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $2T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion) - all that $ gets pumped into Wonderly.

About the Hiring Manager

Hey, I'm Bishop, Head of Operations at Wonderly.

I'm extreme, direct, and care a lot about getting to the truth. I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.

I work best with people who are high-agency, low-ego, and can handle intensity without needing a perfect playbook.

The Role

We’re hiring someone who understands contractor sales from the inside.

Not a generic operator. Not someone who has only read about sales. Someone who has actually seen how homeowners buy, how estimates get built, how onsites go sideways, how quotes get delayed, and why contractors lose jobs they should have won.

You’ll work across customer operations, homeowner sales, product, and contractor performance.

Your job is to help us figure out:

  • Are we accepting the right contractors?

  • Are we qualifying homeowners correctly?

  • Are contractors walking into onsites with enough context?

  • Why are quotes going out late or not at all?

  • Why do some contractors close well and others close almost nothing?

  • What should our CSMs inspect every week?

  • What product/tooling should we build to help contractors quote faster and close more?

What Makes This Role Different

Most sales roles ask you to sell.

This role asks you to take what you know about selling and turn it into a system.

We are not hiring you to be one good salesperson. We are hiring you to help hundreds of contractors close more of the leads we send them.

You’ll listen to homeowner calls, review contractor sales calls, inspect deals, shadow onsites, find where revenue is leaking, and turn that into scripts, workflows, playbooks, coaching, and product feedback.

If you want a clean sales role with a quota and a territory, this is not it.

If you want to help build the sales performance layer for thousands of service businesses, this is it.

Backgrounds That Tend to Work

People from these backgrounds tend to thrive:

  • Remodeling sales manager

  • Remodeling sales rep

  • Kitchen / bath / design-build sales

  • In-home sales for high-ticket home improvement

  • Roofing sales

  • HVAC sales

  • Plumbing sales

  • Windows / doors / exterior sales

  • Anyone who has run onsites, quoted jobs, handled objections, followed up, and closed homeowners

Backgrounds we care less about:

  • Generic SaaS sales with no home services exposure

  • Pure account management with no selling

  • Big-company roles where you were far away from the actual customer

  • Anything where you have never had to sit across from a homeowner and close a real job

What matters more than the resume:

  • You understand homeowner psychology

  • You know what a good onsite looks like

  • You can tell when a contractor is legit vs full of it

  • You can explain why a deal was won or lost

  • You are direct, practical, and allergic to theory-only advice

  • You can turn messy real-world sales behavior into a script, checklist, or process

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and fast changes

Expectations

  • 60–70 hour weeks during this growth phase

  • Real ownership of a real problem within your first 2 weeks

  • Performance is transparent — you'll see your numbers daily and so will everyone else

  • The scope evolves constantly. If you want a stable job description, this isn't it.

  • Regular travel to shadow contractors, homeowner appointments, and customer sales motions in the field

Compensation

Base: $50,000-$90,000

OTE: $150,000-$200,000+

This is a performance-comp role. A meaningful portion of compensation will be tied to the revenue / closed work generated from the customers or book of business you help improve.

Equity in Wonderly may be included depending on experience and role fit.

Remote, with regular in-person work / field visits.

jobs.description:
Salted Stone, a fast-paced, full-service digital marketing agency, is looking for a Senior HubSpot Solutions Strategist to join our growing team. Our mission is to empower growth-minded companies through creative solutions combined with smart technology. We believe nothing is impossible and always solve for the customer. We aim to attract, engage, and develop exceptional people and, in turn, deliver distinctive, lasting improvements for our customers. This is a mid-to-senior-level full-time position reporting to the Director of Solutions on our Solutions Architecture team (commonly known as Technical Marketing elsewhere).

The Senior HubSpot Solutions Strategist provides comprehensive support to the solutions team, possessing complete knowledge and deep understanding of specialized areas, principles, and practices within their professional discipline. They quickly assess problems & come up with best-in-class plans to solve them. In resolving a wide array of issues, they employ creative & technical solutions. This role represents HubSpot solutions expertise, representing a fully qualified, experienced professional in a mid- to late-career position.

Ideal candidates enjoy working directly with our clients and internal team to lead engagements from a technical standpoint (think: ideation up to execution), are organized, great communicators, and aren’t afraid to tackle challenges head-on! Though this is largely a client-facing role, you won’t be responsible for the day-to-day management of client needs and requests (that’s what we have our Client Services team for).

Job Responsibilities

  • Execute and deliver all elements of the Salted Stones Solutions Team Product offerings consistently and efficiently (Data Migration, Portal Strategy, and HubSpot Onboarding, including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, etc.)
    • Lead process and workshops to design CRM system setups and optimization on HubSpot, including mappings, technical data strategy, general process, and lead flow.

    • Be able to generate a standard ERD for either existing or proposed integration structure

Required Competencies

  • Previous agency experience in a client-facing role.
  • Proven track record and advanced experience with HubSpot (Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, Service Hub, CMS Hub, Operations Hub, Commerce Hub)
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to drive and participate in multiple client engagements at once
  • Strong technical writing skills & documentation skills, primarily for the creation of compelling client-facing deliverables
  • Ability to confidently communicate with clients regularly.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and time management skills; and you're comfortable managing multiple projects (budgets, timelines, personalities) simultaneously.
  • Advanced Understanding and/or direct experience with Google Analytics, Databox, and similar analytics tools.
  • Advanced understanding and/or direct experience with Google Tag Manager
  • Advanced knowledge of marketing and sales automation tools, business intelligence tools, data enrichment tools, etc.
  • Advanced Experience with SEM/SEO tools. (Example: Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Yoast, etc.)
  • Advanced experience architecting and building scalable marketing, sales, and service operations systems, specifically using HubSpot.
  • Ability to analyze opportunities to deploy creative solutions and automation that streamline productivity, reporting, and the customer experience.
  • Technical knowledge of marketing and sales automation tools, business intelligence tools, data enrichment tools, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with other MATs (Eloqua, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, etc.)
  • Experience with other Marketing/Sales/CS Ops point solutions tools. Examples: Intercom, Drift, Zendesk, etc.
  • Proficiency in IPAAS software (e.g., Zapier, Automate.io, etc.) and middleware.
  • General understanding of global data privacy laws and requirements, such as GDPR.
  • Experience with Data Visualization tools and platforms. (Examples: Domo, Salesforce Einstein, Snowflake, Tableau, Grow, etc.)
  • Experience building conversational (chatbot) flows using Intercom or Drift.

S2 General Requirements

  • Team player. Friendly, authentic, collaborative, and makes an effort with relationships (the S2 team, clients, HubSpot). Shows care and respect for those around them and themselves. Live our Values.

  • Prioritises communication - Clear, transparent, and consistent with communication across your team and manager, with other teams, and with clients. If in doubt, over-communicate! Isn’t afraid to call out and help correct mistakes before they impact the team or the business.
  • HubSpot-centric. HubSpot is at the center of most work at Salted Stone. Not everyone has to be a HubSpot expert to work here, but everyone needs to have a baseline interest and understanding.

You’ll enjoy working:

In a fully remote role. We’re set up to hire in CA, CO, ID, LA, MI, NC, NM, NV, PA, TX, and WA. Your new Leader is located in ID (MST time). Our wider team is spread across North America, Australia, Ireland, India, and the Philippines, so there may be times that we ask you to flex your schedule to allow for collaboration with different time zones. Service Data and Reporting

Essential - Data and Quality

The Director will help leadership answer the questions that matter most: Where should we focus? What is changing? Where are the opportunities and risks? What should we invest in, accelerate, or change?

This is a role for someone who can find the signal in the noise, challenge assumptions, turn insight into action, and use AI to fundamentally improve how a global sales organization works.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Governance

  • Drive annual and quarterly WW Sales planning in partnership with the VP, Commercial Acceleration and SVP WW Sales, including priorities, targets, budgets, goals, and KPIs.
  • Translate company strategy and business performance into clear WW Sales priorities and investment choices.
  • Establish an effective business rhythm across performance reviews, strategic priorities, leadership meetings, and decision-making.
  • Develop strategy papers, executive narratives, and recommendations that bring clarity to complex business decisions.
  • Ensure key decisions translate into clear ownership, actions, and measurable outcomes.

Revenue Intelligence & Pattern Recognition

  • Build a decision-grade view of WW Sales performance across pipeline, conversion, velocity, win/loss, customers, partners, regions, segments, and growth motions.
  • Build deeper intelligence across New Customers, New Sites, Partners, and Accounts, connecting internal data with relevant external signals to identify growth opportunities and whitespace.
  • Develop Account Insights & Intelligence that brings together customer growth, investments, facility and network changes, buying signals, installed-base opportunities, and market dynamics to help answer: Why this account? Why now? What opportunity exists? What should we do next?
  • Identify patterns, risks, leading indicators, and opportunities that may not yet be visible in the traditional pipeline.
  • Move WW Sales from reporting what happened to understanding why it happened and anticipating what comes next.
  • Use AI-assisted research, analytics, modeling, and pattern detection to find signals faster and turn intelligence into clear priorities and action.

WW Sales Organization, Productivity & Fiscal Planning

  • Lead role, capacity, and coverage planning to align the WW Sales organization with its growth priorities.
  • Use data to understand productivity and determine where people and investment can create the greatest business impact.
  • Identify work that should be simplified, standardized, automated, centralized, redesigned, or stopped.
  • Own the fiscal planning rhythm for WW Sales, including budget, OPEX, forecast variances, and optimization opportunities in partnership with Finance.
  • Provide leadership with a consistent view of resources, productivity, performance, and spend to support better investment decisions.

Transformation & AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Shape and drive high-impact transformation initiatives from opportunity identification through measurable business impact.
  • Use business performance, customer and partner insight, and Revenue Intelligence to identify and size new growth and transformation opportunities.
  • Establish clear measures of what is working, what isn't, and why, helping leadership determine what should be scaled, redesigned, or stopped.
  • Modernize manual, spreadsheet- and email-heavy workflows into simpler, intelligent, technology-enabled ways of working.
  • Identify and scale high-value applications of AI, automation, and agentic workflows across sales intelligence, planning, seller productivity, and operations.
  • Identify friction across the seller, customer, and partner experience and help make AutoStore simpler to do business with.

Strategic Execution & Leadership

  • Maintain a clear view of the highest-priority WW Sales and Commercial Acceleration initiatives, expected outcomes, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
  • Create simple governance that drives accountability and speed without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the VP, Commercial Acceleration and WW Sales leadership.
  • Bring an independent, fact-based point of view and constructively challenge assumptions when the data suggests a different path.
  • Connect teams across regions and functions to move strategic priorities from idea to action to measurable impact.

Key Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in sales strategy, revenue operations, business transformation, management consulting, or related roles, ideally in B2B technology or global organizations.
  • Strong strategic and analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear recommendations and action.
  • Strong business and financial acumen with experience interpreting revenue, customer, partner, financial, and operational data.
  • Proven ability to shape and lead cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience with organizational, capacity, and fiscal planning.
  • AI-forward, with practical experience using AI, analytics, and automation to solve business problems and improve productivity.
  • Strong executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and turn analysis into decisions.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic & Analytical: Connects data, business performance, and market signals to identify what matters.
  • Curious & Insight-Driven: Asks better questions, finds patterns others miss, and challenges assumptions with evidence.
  • Business & Growth Mindset: Understands how customers, partners, investment, and execution come together to drive growth.

Job Title: National Clinical Applications Specialist, Cardiac & Vascular Ultrasound

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

You will serve as the centralized clinical subject matter expert for advanced cardiovascular ultrasound applications within the General Imaging organization. In this role, you will support customer installations, drive adoption of advanced applications, conduct competitive demonstrations, assist with strategic sales opportunities, manage customer escalations, and contribute to the development of internal clinical education programs. This is a national role supporting the United States and Canada and requires extensive travel.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary cardiac and vascular ultrasound clinical expert for the General Imaging organization which includes the United States and Canada, providing advanced application support across internal and customer-facing activities.
  • Partner with commercial teams to support strategic sales opportunities, competitive displacement efforts, and high-value cardiovascular demonstrations.
  • Provide technical and clinical leadership during customer evaluations by demonstrating advanced ultrasound applications, workflow benefits, product capabilities, and differentiating technologies.
  • Support advanced customer installations by helping accelerate onboarding, application utilization, workflow optimization, and customer confidence.
  • Act as an escalation resource for complex cardiac and vascular clinical questions, customer concerns, and specialized application support needs.
  • Develop and deliver internal education, training resources, and clinical tools to strengthen field capability across cardiac and vascular applications.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Education, Sales, Service, and clinical teams to align training priorities, customer needs, product feedback, and market intelligence.
  • Support adoption of new product introductions, advanced imaging features, and cardiovascular workflow enhancements through clinical education and field readiness activities.
  • Build relationships with key clinical stakeholders and thought leaders to support best practices, protocol optimization, and customer success.
  • Capture and communicate field insights, competitive feedback, customer needs, and clinical workflow challenges to the business.
  • Work integrally with associated teams to create, manage, coordinate and deliver training (globally) to internal and external partners and customers. This will include select duties as content developer, trainer, and registrar.
  • Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Uses prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
  • In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
  • Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.
  • A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor with proven interpersonal skills or an early people leader who can hire and develop talent. Provides informal guidance to new team members

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of clinical experience in cardiac and vascular ultrasound, with demonstrated expertise in advanced cardiovascular applications and workflow.
  • Willingness to travel up to 90% a week as needed to support customer installations, demonstrations, escalations, training, and business priorities.
  • Would need to live within 1-hour of an International Airport.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 6+ years in ECHO and vascular ultrasound experience.
  • Registered sonography credential such as RDCS, RVT, RCS, or equivalent cardiovascular ultrasound certification preferred or required based on business standards.
  • Strong understanding of clinical education, application training, customer onboarding, and workflow optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver complex clinical and technical information to a variety of audiences, including customers, sales teams, clinical specialists, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting ultrasound product demonstrations, customer evaluations, competitive positioning, or strategic commercial opportunities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, clinical, product, service, and education teams.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
  • Previous Commercial experience
  • Advanced clinical knowledge of cardiovascular ultrasound systems, applications, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience mentoring clinical teams or developing scalable training content for field organizations.
  • Ability to translate customer needs, workflow challenges, and competitive insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and support successful adoption of advanced technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and support high-impact business needs in a dynamic environment.
