jobs.title: Mainframe Network Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other.
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Technology

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$94,400.00 - $155,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Mainframe Network Engineer to join our organization as we grow and transform our Enterprise Technology Solutions organization, Our Infrastructure Engineers serve as a foundational cornerstone of the enterprise technology ecosystem, encompassing a diverse portfolio of critical systems that power all business operations. This discipline may include mainframe systems, compute resources, storage solutions, collaboration tools, and specialized platforms that enable system interoperability. As the bedrock layer of the technology stack, Infrastructure Engineering creates the resilient, secure, and scalable environments upon which all other technology services depend, balancing the maintenance of established systems with the adoption of modern cloud-native approaches to drive organizational agility and innovation. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, this this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Responsible for performing analysis, design, and implementation of infrastructure components across various domains (which may include mainframe systems, collaboration tools, compute resources, storage solutions, or other specialized areas) with a high degree of accuracy.

Technical Execution:

  • Define and implement technical requirements for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational support using appropriate automation methodologies.
  • Enhance infrastructure deployment workflows to improve system reliability, resource utilization, and operational efficiency while resolving infrastructure issues of intermediate complexity.
  • Configure and optimize physical, virtualized, and cloud-based infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and operational resilience across multiple technology domains.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure monitoring, capacity planning, and incident response procedures while ensuring adherence to security protocols and compliance requirements.

Strategic Input:

  • Collaborate with software, platform, and operations teams to align infrastructure capabilities with application requirements and business needs.
  • Provide technical guidance to Associate and Sr Associate Infrastructure Engineers while contributing to infrastructure standards and best practices.
  • Evaluate new infrastructure technologies and methodologies to identify opportunities for operational improvements and technology modernization.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?


Technical Expertise & Education:

  • 3 years of infrastructure engineering/systems administration experience preferred.
  • If specializing in a certain domain of infrastructure engineering, proven expertise in that specific area with ability to work across related systems.
  • Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of infrastructure expertise including the ability to understand system concepts necessary to do the job effectively, demonstrate willingness, cooperation, and concern for business issues, and possess in-depth knowledge of immediate infrastructure systems worked on.

  • Core Mainframe & Operating System Skills
    • IBM z/OS: Deep proficiency in the z/OS Communications Server environment.
    • Protocols & Architecture: Hands-on experience with SNA (Systems Network Architecture), VTAM (Virtual Telecommunication Access Method), and APPN/Enterprise Extender for SNA-over-IP communication.
    • Environment Navigation: Familiarity with standard mainframe interfaces like TSO/ISPF, JCL (Job Control Language), and IOF (Interactive Output Facility.
  • Networking & Connectivity Skills
    • TCP/IP Stack: Advanced configuration and management of the z/OS TCP/IP stack, routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP), and Layer 2/Layer 3 integration.
    • Trace & Packet Analysis: Ability to execute and analyze complex VTAM network traces and sniffer/TCP/IP packet captures to isolate bottlenecks.
    • Infrastructure Integration: Working knowledge of modern enterprise hardware and software, including switches, firewalls, load balancers, and 3270 emulators.
  • Security & Policy Management
    • Pagent & AT-TLS: Customization of the z/OS Policy Agent and Application Transparent Transport Layer Security for network policy and encryption rules.
    • Certificates & Encryption: Administration of digital certificates, keyrings, SSH, and SSL/TLS protocols.
    • Secure File Transfers: Support for enterprise file-moving tools like SFTP, FTPS, and Connect:Direct.
  • Automation, Scripting & Monitoring
    • Scripting Languages: Competency in REXX, CLIST, Python, or Linux BASH for workflow automation and generating SMF (System Management Facilities) reports.
    • Diagnostic Tools: Experience utilizing IBM NetView, IBM or equivalent performance and capacity-planning tools.

Leadership & Influence:

  • Strong communication skills that enable clear, concise interactions with team members and stakeholders.
  • Your ability to document infrastructure work in an accessible manner, ask clarifying questions on requirements, and actively listen ensures seamless collaboration.
  • You welcome constructive feedback and use it to continuously improve your approach to infrastructure challenges.
  • You demonstrate intermediate leadership capabilities with a proven track record of self-motivation and initiative.
  • Your ability to identify and pursue personal growth opportunities in infrastructure technologies shows your commitment to professional development and positions you to take on increasing responsibilities within our team.

Strategic & Business Acumen:

  • Intermediate delivery skills including the ability to deliver infrastructure work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, decompose infrastructure assignments into small batch deployments, and contribute to system architecture tradeoff and negotiation discussions.
  • Proven problem-solving skills including infrastructure debugging abilities, allowing you to determine source of issues in unfamiliar systems or environments, ability to recognize and solve repetitive infrastructure problems proactively and permanently, recognize mistakes using them as learning opportunities, and break down large infrastructure problems into smaller, more manageable ones.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in work experience plus 2 years of infrastructure engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. About inquirED

inquirED supports teachers with high-quality instructional materials that make joyful, rigorous, and transferable learning possible for every student. About the role

Description

inquirED is seeking a Senior Proposal Manager to own state and district RFP responses and instructional materials adoption submissions for pre-K/TK, elementary social studies, and elementary core ELA.

You will lead the full proposal process—from interpreting solicitation requirements and developing a response plan to writing persuasive narratives, coordinating supporting materials, and submitting complete, accurate proposals on time. As the primary writer and project owner, you will turn complex curriculum information into clear, evidence-backed responses that address each evaluator’s requirements and priorities.

This role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong writing skills, and the judgment to manage complex submissions independently. You will coordinate colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Curriculum, Product, Partner Experience, and Operations, establish clear responsibilities and deadlines, and resolve routine issues with minimal guidance. Your work will help inquirED earn state approvals and district awards that bring our curricula to more teachers and students.

Own state and district submissions

  • Manage RFPs and adoption submissions across pre-K/TK, elementary social studies, and elementary core ELA, taking responsibility for the complete submission from initial review through confirmed receipt.
  • Read all solicitation documents, rubrics, attachments, and addenda; build compliance matrices that capture eligibility criteria, required responses, supporting evidence, forms, submission rules, and deadlines.
  • Develop project plans with clear owners, milestones, review cycles, and internal deadlines, managing multiple submissions simultaneously.
  • Identify potential disqualifiers, unclear requirements, and resource constraints early; prepare clarification questions and escalate decisions that require leadership or specialist input.

Write persuasive, accurate proposals

  • Serve as the primary writer for executive summaries, curriculum narratives, implementation plans, and other substantive proposal responses.
  • Tailor each response to the state or district’s priorities, evaluation criteria, and scoring rubric.
  • Translate input from curriculum and product experts into clear explanations of instructional design, standards alignment, research, assessment, differentiation, and implementation support.
  • Accurately represent each curriculum’s scope, available grade levels, components, and any required companion programs.
  • Verify claims and supporting evidence, adapting existing content to each solicitation rather than relying on generic responses.

Coordinate contributors and protect submission quality

  • Give subject matter experts focused requests that identify the question, required evidence, response format, and deadline.
  • Coordinate standards alignment materials, research documentation, pricing, certifications, contractual exceptions, samples, and reviewer access with the appropriate owners.
  • Review and edit contributor materials before circulating consolidated drafts for further review.
  • Conduct final checks for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance, including signatures, file naming, page limits, formatting, and addendum acknowledgments.
  • Complete portal uploads and coordinate electronic or physical delivery, retaining submission records and confirming receipt before deadlines.

Improve proposal readiness and results

  • Maintain a calendar of relevant state adoption windows and district RFP opportunities, partnering with Sales to assess eligibility, product fit, and submission readiness.
  • Provide bid/no-bid recommendations based on requirements, evaluation criteria, available evidence, and the resources needed to submit a competitive response.
  • Maintain an organized, current library of approved narratives, evidence, standards documentation, and submission materials across all three curriculum areas.
  • Track submission outcomes, request evaluator feedback when available, and use findings to strengthen future responses.
  • Improve workflows and quality checks to prevent recurring errors and reduce unnecessary rework.

Requirements

  • Typically 4–7 years of related experience in proposal writing and management, with demonstrated ownership of complex competitive submissions.
  • Experience managing state or district education RFPs, instructional materials adoption submissions, or comparable public-sector procurements.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, including experience serving as the primary writer of persuasive, evidence-backed proposals.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret detailed solicitation requirements, build compliance matrices, and write to formal evaluation criteria.
  • Strong project management skills and a record of coordinating contributors and meeting overlapping deadlines.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accountability for the accuracy and completeness of final submissions.
  • Ability to work independently, determine an effective approach to new assignments, resolve problems, and improve processes.
  • Ability to learn and clearly explain pre-K/TK, elementary social studies, and elementary core ELA curricula, including their instructional approaches and implementation requirements.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with educational publishing, curriculum procurement, or state instructional materials reviews.
  • Familiarity with early childhood instruction, inquiry-based social studies, knowledge-building ELA, and the science of reading.
  • Experience preparing standards alignment documentation or coordinating curriculum evidence for formal reviews.
  • APMP certification or training in an established proposal methodology.

Why Work For Us

  • Chances to Connect: Biannual company retreats and optional local meetups

  • Perks and Stipend: Technology package provided, plus a home office stipend
  • Learning and Development: Educational and development opportunities, monthly Brunch and Learns, and more!

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Health; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer who thrives in collaborative environments and wants to build technology that makes a real difference in public health. You'll work within our SAFe Agile framework alongside architects, consultants, and fellow developers to deliver Salesforce solutions for health departments nationwide.

This role is ideal for someone who values teamwork over solo heroics, enjoys iterating on solutions with input from colleagues and clients, and finds satisfaction in building systems that help communities flourish.

How You'll Work

You'll be part of an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions where you'll help shape the technical roadmap alongside the full team
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives
  • Cross-functional Teams: You'll collaborate closely with architects, business analysts, and quality engineers rather than working in silos
  • Continuous Improvement: You'll have regular opportunities to reflect on what's working and suggest improvements to our processes

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow
  • Collaborate with architects on solution design and implementation approaches
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives
  • Write clean, well-documented, testable code that follows our team standards
  • Partner with QA to ensure high-quality deliverables
  • Contribute to code reviews with constructive, supportive feedback
  • Help translate public health requirements into technical solutions
  • Support the development of our PH360 platform

Experience Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • 1-3 years of work experience in governmental public health (local, state, federal, tribal, or non-profit)
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe environments
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required

Technical Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation tools
  • Understanding of Salesforce data modeling and security model
  • Familiarity with integration patterns and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and test-driven development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification
  • Experience with Service Cloud or Health Cloud
  • Familiarity with HIPAA compliance requirements
  • Experience with SAFe Agile methodology
  • Background in public health data systems or epidemiology workflows

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step. We've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

How we work: Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us. Success is measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work). We view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

The natural rhythm of consulting: Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds. They should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Willingness to adhere to our no-drug workplace policy. You must agree to undergo eVerify for employment status at hiring.

No 3rd Party Recruiters.

We value initiative. If you're genuinely interested in this role, show us. (However, please do not use the "Schedule a Meeting" feature on our website. You will be disqualified.) We notice candidates who take the extra step to express real interest. Demonstrate the value that you will add to F&T Labs.

At Flourish and Thrive Labs, we believe in the unique value each candidate brings. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and experiences, even if you don't meet all listed qualifications

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the TeamNetlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day.
jobs.description:
About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up.

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out.
  • Own the call on where paid creates incremental value for Netlify. Design the tests, prove which channels and audiences drive growth our organic funnel wouldn't have delivered anyway, and decide where to scale, where to hold, and where not to spend at all.
  • Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures.
  • Own budget planning, pacing, and ROI reporting for all paid spend, and make the case for where to double down or pull back.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to get attribution and UTM tracking right before scaling spend, so every dollar is measurable.
  • Define target audiences and channel mix aligned to Netlify's ICP; partner with Product Marketing on messaging inputs for paid creative.
  • Build the measurement framework for CAC, signup/pipeline contribution, and payback by channel.
  • Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off.
  • As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment
  • Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports
  • A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there
  • Experience managing an external agency or partner relationship, including setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable to them
  • Working knowledge of attribution and marketing measurement, and a history of partnering with Marketing Ops or Data teams to get tracking right before spend scales
  • Some experience marketing to developers or technical audiences, or with a PLG motion where paid acquisition runs alongside a large organic and self-serve funnel

This Role Is a Great Fit If

  • You're energized by building and scaling a new paid program, not just optimizing one that's already mature.
  • You think like an owner of budget and outcomes, not just a briefs-and-reports manager of an agency.
  • You're comfortable moving between strategy (channel mix, targeting, budget allocation) and getting into the details yourself when it matters.
  • You care about attribution being right before spend scales, not as an afterthought.
  • You want to build in close partnership with Lifecycle, Campaigns, and Marketing Ops rather than run paid as a separate lane that hands off a spreadsheet at the end of the quarter

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include:

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing .

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $150,000 - $200,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

We’re looking for a Sr. Director, Brand and Integrated Marketing to help write the next chapter of the Hint brand. This is a high-impact role for a marketer who combines sharp strategic thinking, exceptional creative judgment, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to put the pieces together to build winning 360 programs.

You’ll be one of the key leaders shaping how the Hint brand grows. You’ll lead our annual brand planning, develop the strategy behind our biggest brand moments, and independently steer integrated campaigns from brief through launch. You’ll connect consumer and cultural insight with commercial opportunity—ensuring that the work we do builds the brand while delivering meaningful business results.

You’ll be a critical partner to our Commercial and Innovation teams, helping identify where the brand can unlock growth, shaping the consumer strategy behind new products and initiatives, and bringing innovation to market in ways that strengthen both the portfolio and the Hint brand.

You’ll also define how Hint connects with our target consumer — crafting sharp social, creator and influencer, partnership and experiential strategies —building new ways for consumers to discover, engage with, and fall in love with the brand.

  • Own the brand plan and growth agenda. Lead annual brand planning and translate business priorities, consumer insights, market dynamics, and cultural opportunities into a focused roadmap for how Hint will grow. Identify the biggest opportunities for the brand and make clear choices about where we should play, and where we shouldn't.
  • Partner with Commercial teams to turn brand strategy into growth. Partner with Sales and Commercial leaders to understand customer, channel, and marketplace opportunities and translate them into compelling marketing and go-to-market plans. Ensure our brand strategy connects to the realities of how and where consumers shop, and that our marketing helps unlock both consumer demand and commercial growth.
  • Help shape the Innovation agenda. Partner closely with Innovation and cross-functional teams to identify and develop products and initiatives that can drive incremental growth and strengthen the brand. Bring the consumer and brand perspective to innovation strategy, from identifying opportunities and defining the consumer proposition through launch. Ensure new products feel strategically connected to the Hint brand while creating meaningful reasons for consumers to choose us over the competition.
  • Lead the big ideas. Own integrated brand and product campaigns from strategy through launch. Develop the brief, shape the narrative arc, build the go-to-market plan, align cross-functional partners, and keep the work moving. You’ll be expected to operate with significant autonomy and minimal oversight.
  • Make the work better. Partner closely with our internal Creative team and agency partners to develop work that is distinctive, strategically sharp, and unmistakably Hint. Bring a strong point of view, give clear feedback, and hold a high bar. You’ll know when to push, when to challenge, and when to make the call.

Find the people, platforms, partners, and moments that can help us reach consumers in ways that feel natural to the brand.

  • Be the voice of the brand. Bring the Hint point of view into cross-functional conversations. Protect what makes the brand distinctive while pushing it forward. Advocate decisively for what is right for Hint, even when it requires challenging assumptions or making difficult tradeoffs.
  • Turn strategy into action. We move quickly. You’ll bring the structure and operational rigor to turn ambitious ideas into great work—setting priorities, creating clarity, making decisions, and keeping teams and partners accountable.
  • Measure what matters. Define clear measures of success across brand health, consumer engagement, innovation, and commercial performance. Use data, insights, and learnings to sharpen our strategy, improve our marketing, and ensure our investments are driving meaningful growth.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in brand, consumer, or integrated marketing, ideally in CPG, beverage, food, lifestyle, retail, or another consumer-focused business.
  • A strategic thinker who can connect consumer insight, brand strategy, innovation, and commercial opportunity into a clear growth agenda.
  • Experience leading integrated campaigns end-to-end—from identifying the opportunity and writing the brief to creative development, go-to-market, launch, and optimization.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales/Commercial and Innovation teams to translate business opportunities into consumer-facing strategies and successful launches.
  • Exceptional creative instincts. You know what great work looks like, can brief creative teams effectively, and have the judgment to make the work better.
  • Experience building brands through social, creators/influencers, partnerships, events, experiential, or other relevant connection channels.
  • The ability to operate independently and thrive in an environment where you are expected to figure things out, take ownership, and move quickly.
  • A highly effective cross-functional leader who can earn trust and influence across Marketing, Creative, Innovation, Sales, and Commercial.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. You can sell a growth strategy to executives and write a brief that gets a creative team excited.
  • A balance of big-picture thinking and getting-your-hands-dirty execution.
  • A proven track record of developing high-performing teams and growing talent.

Benefits

jobs.description:
We need someone who understands data deeply and uses Python to wrangle it — not a platform engineer, not a pure pipeline builder, but a data specialist who's comfortable with research, investigation, and the unglamorous work of making messy energy market data actually usable.

You'll spend significant time on tasks like: mapping BM units to power plants and fuel types, reconciling legacy data formats with current ones, ensuring consistency between different Elexon message types, and cleaning time-series data (outliers, gaps, overlaps). Some of this requires genuine investigation — cross-referencing sources, making judgment calls, documenting edge cases. There's no API that solves these problems for you.

Python is your primary tool (Pandas, Numpy, standard libraries) to minimise manual effort, but you should be comfortable that some detective work is unavoidable. If you find satisfaction in truly understanding a dataset's structure and quirks — rather than just piping data through and hoping for the best — this role is for you.

Data Mapping and Research

• Map BM units from Elexon to their corresponding power plants, substations, and fuel types — combining API data, public registers, and manual research

• Map substations to ETYS zones and grid supply points

• Build and maintain reference/master datasets that link identifiers across disparate sources (Elexon, National Grid ESO, TEC register, etc.)

• Document mappings, assumptions, and known limitations clearly for downstream users

Data Reconciliation and Consistency

• Reconcile legacy data formats with current formats (e.g., historical operational data stored in different schemas or granularities)

• Ensure consistency between different Elexon message types — understand the market data structure well enough to know why BOALF, BOD, and DISBSAD might not perfectly align and how to handle it

• Investigate discrepancies between data sources and determine authoritative values

Data Cleaning and Quality

• Clean time-series data: detect outliers (price spikes, meter errors), fill gaps appropriately, resolve overlapping or duplicate timestamps

• Develop reusable Python-based cleaning routines that can be applied across datasets

• Understand why data quality issues occur (settlement reruns, late submissions, format changes) not just patch them

Pipeline Development (Supporting the Above)

• Write and maintain Python data grabbers for energy market APIs

• Build dbt models to transform raw data into clean, analysis-ready datasets

• Orchestrate workflows via GitHub Actions

• Design PostgreSQL schemas that reflect your understanding of the domain

Requirements

• Strong Python skills for data work — you're fluent with pandas, comfortable writing clean, testable code, and can build reusable data processing logic. This is not an Excel role.

• Solid SQL skills — complex queries, window functions, CTEs in PostgreSQL

• Experience with messy, real-world data — you've done reconciliation, cleaning, or mapping work before and understand it's not always automatable

• Methodical and detail-oriented — you notice inconsistencies and want to understand root causes

• Good documentation habits — you know that undocumented mappings and assumptions are technical debt

• Self-directed — you can own ambiguous problems, do your own research, and communicate findings clearly

Nice to Have

• Experience with energy, utilities, or market data (any geography)

• Familiarity with UK energy markets, Elexon data, or grid operations

• dbt experience for transformation pipelines

• Exposure to time-series data challenges (irregular timestamps, gaps, restatements)

Highly Desirable — Agentic AI Coding Experience

We value candidates who can build software using agentic AI coding systems. This is fundamentally

different from using code completion tools or chat-based assistants.

Not What We're Looking For

• Platform/infrastructure engineers who prefer to stay above the data layer

• People who expect clean, well-documented data as input

• Those uncomfortable with research, ambiguity, or "manual" investigation work

Practicalities

• Remote-first with async collaboration (Slack, GitHub, documented decisions)

• Core overlap with UK business hours expected (at least 4 hours daily)

• Competitive compensation based on location and experience

Benefits

  • Plenty of opportunities for learning and professional growth
  • B2b contract with a paid vacation

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chargeback Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Chargeback Operations Intern, you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

  • Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.
  • Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

  • Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Chargeback Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Indirect Category Management leads category strategies, sourcing programs, supplier management activities, and complex procurement initiatives for assigned Indirect spend categories. This role partners with business leaders to understand requirements, improve supplier value, deliver cost savings, and strengthen procurement process discipline. The Senior Manager provides direct leadership to assigned procurement resources, including coaching, prioritization, work allocation, performance feedback, and professional development. The ideal candidate is a results-driven procurement leader who excels at managing strategic professional services categories and cultivating senior stakeholder relationships across the organization. They bring extensive experience negotiating consulting, legal, audit, tax, engineering, and advisory services agreements; developing category strategies; optimizing supplier portfolios; and delivering sustainable cost reductions while ensuring business continuity, regulatory compliance, and service excellence.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Category Strategy

• Develop and execute multiyear category strategies that support business objectives and procurement value targets. Responsible for development and actionable opportunity pipelines.
• Develop actionable strategic sourcing plans, initiative pipelines, and category roadmaps for assigned Indirect categories.
• Monitor and utilize market intelligence, supplier segmentation, and business demand patterns, and risk mitigation plans to inform sourcing strategy.

Strategic Sourcing & Negotiations

• Develop negotiation strategies that address commercial value, service expectations, risk, contract flexibility, and supplier performance.
• Partner with Legal, Finance, Compliance, and business stakeholders to support contract review and business decision-making.
Supplier & Financial Management
• Manage key supplier relationships and support supplier performance reviews, issue resolution, and continuous improvement efforts.
• Deliver annual P&L Reduction and P&L Protection targets through sourcing, negotiation, demand management, supplier optimization, working capital, savings pipeline, benefit validation, and budget impact.
• Track sourcing results, validate benefits with Finance as appropriate, and support leadership reporting.
• Establish preferred supplier programs o aggregate spend with suppliers and professional services governance across functional domains.
Team Leadership
• Directly supervise Category Managers, Analysts, Specialists, or other assigned procurement team members.
• Provide coaching, feedback, talent development planning, workload prioritization, governance and performance management.
• Mentor team members on category strategy, sourcing discipline, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation preparation.
• Promote collaboration, accountability, process alignment, and consistent procurement standards within the team.
Stakeholder Management
• Develop executive stakeholder relationships and drive organizational alignment to position Procurement as a strategic business partner.
• Partner with CFO and supporting org in Finance, General Counsel and other corporate business leaders to ensure early engagement of procurement and visibility at the leadership levels
• Implement a well-coordinated, finance supported spend control tower to provide transparency and impact on functional budgets to the best possible level of granularity
• Lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influencing senior leaders to achieve enterprise objectives and maximize value.
• Champion change management efforts to ensure adoption of procurement strategies, processes, and technologies.
• Balance stakeholder priorities with governance, risk management, and business requirements to support informed decision-making.
• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across Procurement and business functions.
Digital Procurement & Analytics Capability
• Demonstrates a strong ability to leverage digital procurement technologies, data analytics, and process automation to drive business value to improve decision-making and enhance stakeholder outcomes.
• Possess hands-on experience utilizing procurement platforms and analytical tools to support category strategy, sourcing execution, supplier management, and performance reporting.


EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
• 10+ years of procurement, sourcing, supply chain, category management, finance, or related business experience.
• 3+ years of direct people leadership experience preferred or required based on organizational need.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

•Strong knowledge of indirect procurement, category management, strategic sourcing, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and procurement best practices across multiple spend categories.
• Expertise in leading complex sourcing events, supplier negotiations, and cross-functional procurement initiatives that drive cost optimization, operational efficiency, supplier performance, and measurable business value.
•Experience managing business stakeholders and indirect supplier relationships and delivering measurable savings or value outcomes.


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Inside working conditions.

• No environmental hazards are indicated for this classification.

jobs.description:
About Slang AI

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences.

At Slang AI, we believe how we build matters just as much as what we build. We foster a culture rooted in hospitality, ownership, and clarity, where every “Slangsta” feels valued, supported, and connected to the broader impact of our work in the AI-powered future of restaurants.

What Your Experience Will Be

As a Sales Development Representative at Slang AI you'll be at the very front end of our growth engine - the person who first opens the door for our sales team to transform the way restaurants serve their guests. Day-to-day, your work lives in the outbound motion: researching restaurant operators who fit our Ideal Customer Profile, crafting compelling cold emails and LinkedIn messages, and picking up the phone to start real conversations with decision-makers. You'll be fast, disciplined, and creative - because getting through to busy operators takes all three.

You'll work closely with your Hiring Manager and Account Executives, handing off warm, well-qualified opportunities and collaborating with Marketing on campaigns and messaging. This role reports to the regional Sales Director, who is a hands-on coach invested in your growth, running weekly team trainings and 1:1 sessions where you'll dissect calls, iterate on sequences, and celebrate wins together. This is a fully remote role, with occasional travel for team offsites, company events, and key industry conferences. You'll work from wherever you do your best work, using Hubspot and AI tools that sharpen your prospecting and personalization. If you're the kind of person who loves the thrill of a conversation, the satisfaction of hitting a number, and the challenge of figuring out the most effective way to break through - this is your seat.

Why You Belong Here and How You Will Grow

At Slang AI we recruit with intention and we build with care. Our team is genuinely competitive (we're not going to apologize for that), but the competition is additive, not corrosive - the best performers share their playbooks because a rising tide lifts all ships.

You'll grow here because we build growth from the start. Your first 30 days come with: product immersion, shadowing AEs, learning our ICP inside and out, and calibrating your outreach with your manager before the dial starts turning up. After that, weekly team training, peer coaching, and a culture of transparency around metrics mean you always know how you're tracking and what to do about it. Slang's values - Overachiever Fever, AI Native, Humility Ability, and Be a Good Host - aren't posters on a wall; they're the actual operating principles of the team you're joining.

Being AI Native isn't an afterthought here. We use AI in how we sell, how we prospect, how we iterate on copy. You'll learn how to leverage these tools to multiply your output in ways most SDR teams haven't caught up to yet - and that's a real career advantage you'll carry with you long after this role. Whether you're aiming for AE, leadership, or something else entirely, you'll leave Slang with sharper instincts, better habits, and a network of people who want to see you win.

What Success Looks Like

  • You proactively identify and research restaurant operators that match our Ideal Customer Profile, building a pipeline of well-qualified prospects week over week.
  • You execute with daily discipline - 100+ outbound touchpoints per day, 5+ new prospects added to pipeline - regardless of how the previous day went.
  • You consistently set 40+ qualified appointments per month (3+ locs), resulting in 20+ completed per month, handing off to Account Executives with enough context for them to run a great discovery call.
  • You use active listening and smart questioning in your outreach and early conversations to surface real pain points around staffing, call volume, and guest experience.
  • You collaborate openly with your AEs and the Marketing team, sharing what's resonating in the field and contributing to a unified, high-impact go-to-market message.
  • You leverage AI tools and your own creativity to continuously test and improve your outreach sequences, subject lines, and call openers.
  • You track your own funnel metrics with precision and come to 1:1s with data, hypotheses, and a clear plan to close the gap when you're behind.

What You Will Bring

  • Experience in outbound sales, cold calling, or SDR/BDR work - you've made the calls, sent the sequences, and learned what works.
  • Strong verbal and written communication - you can hook attention fast, conduct high quality prospect discovery and articulate value without jargon.
  • A competitive nature grounded in curiosity - you want to know how you rank, why you rank there, and what you're going to do about it.
  • Process orientation with adaptability - you thrive on structure and routine, and you can pivot your approach when the data tells you to.
  • Active listening as a genuine skill, not a talking point - you take in what prospects say and reflect it back in ways that make them feel understood.
  • AI fluency: you actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work for research, copy iteration, and productivity - not just awareness, but real, habitual use.
  • Humility and a hunger for feedback - you don't just tolerate coaching, you seek it out.
  • Preferred: experience in SaaS, hospitality technology, or selling to restaurant operators. Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

How Work Affects My Life

Your role as a Sales Development Representative will be the launchpad that shapes how you think about sales, persuasion, and value creation for the rest of your career - and you'll do it while contributing to something that genuinely makes life better for restaurants and their teams.

  • Work fully remote with occasional travel to headquarters and company offsites
  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied directly to your performance
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Professional development opportunities - coaching, tools, and a clear path to advancement
  • Contribute to a company mission that's transforming the restaurant and hospitality industry

This role will sharpen the way you see opportunity - you'll get better at reading people, at finding the right door, and at the kind of disciplined optimism that makes great salespeople rare.

Compensation & Location

Compensation for this role is location-based and benchmarked against local market data aligned to the employee’s primary work location. Total compensation includes a mix of cash and equity and may vary by location, role level, and experience. Our range is therefore wide and not meant as a negotiation range.

Base Compensation: $60,000 - $70,000

Variable Compensation: $24,000

On-Target Earnings: $84,000 - $94,000

Equity: Included in offer package

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang AI We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).

We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)

AI Native. We don't just sell AI. We are Al.

Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)

Be A Good Host. We build for hospitality. We should embody it.

This is not a traditional front-end-only role. Our client is a performance-focused digital marketing company specializing in paid social advertising and e-commerce growth.

The team manages significant advertising budgets across multiple consumer brands and takes a highly analytical approach to account structure, testing, attribution, audience strategy, and incremental growth.

The company works closely with founders and business owners, using performance data to make informed decisions about acquisition strategy, budget allocation, and channel expansion.

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Paid Social Manager to own paid social strategy and hands-on campaign execution across Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest.

You'll manage e-commerce advertising accounts ranging from approximately $50K to $700K+ in monthly spend, taking ownership of account structure, testing strategy, audience architecture, attribution, performance analysis, and optimization.

This is a highly hands-on role. You won't simply review dashboards or manage external execution. You'll work directly inside advertising platforms, determine what should be tested, analyze the results, and translate performance data into clear recommendations.

This role is exclusively focused on paid social. Paid search and creative production are managed separately.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Manage substantial e-commerce advertising budgets of up to $700K+ per month.
  • Own both paid social strategy and hands-on campaign execution.
  • Work across Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest.
  • Go beyond platform ROAS to analyze real business outcomes and incremental performance.
  • Work directly with senior decision-makers and client founders.

Paid Social Strategy & Account Management

  • Audit new accounts and present findings across account structure, attribution, audiences, placements, and demographics.

  • Own hands-on campaign management and optimization across paid social platforms.
  • Manage sophisticated e-commerce accounts with significant monthly advertising spend.
  • Expand budgets into TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest when performance data supports additional investment.

Testing & Audience Strategy

  • Design structured creative and audience tests with defined minimum spend requirements so results are statistically useful and actionable.

  • Evaluate campaign structure and determine appropriate use of CBO vs. ABO, cost caps, bid caps, and Advantage+ Sales Campaigns.
  • Build and maintain catalog and dynamic product advertising across collections.
  • Translate testing results into clear recommendations for budget allocation and future experimentation.

Attribution & Measurement

  • Standardize attribution settings across campaigns.
  • Explain how different attribution windows affect reported performance.
  • Understand and evaluate view-through attribution, reported ROAS, and incremental ROAS.
  • Plan and interpret conversion lift studies and geo holdout tests.
  • Translate incremental performance findings into budget and target recommendations.
  • Work with Conversions API, event match quality, and deduplication concepts.

Performance Analysis & Client Communication

  • Report on actual business outcomes, including Shopify revenue, MER, new customer acquisition, and contribution, rather than relying exclusively on platform ROAS.
  • Pull raw performance breakdowns and conduct independent analysis using spreadsheets.
  • Identify meaningful trends, problems, and opportunities within campaign data.
  • Write creative briefs based on performance insights and provide actionable feedback to client creative teams.
  • Present findings and recommendations directly to founders and business owners.
  • Communicate difficult performance findings clearly and professionally when necessary.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on paid social experience, including e-commerce accounts.
  • Proven experience managing accounts spending $250K+ per month.
  • Expert-level Meta Ads Manager experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Advantage+ Sales Campaigns, CBO vs. ABO, cost caps, bid caps, and catalog advertising.
  • Hands-on campaign management experience with at least two of the following: TikTok, AppLovin, or Pinterest.
  • Working knowledge of Conversions API, event match quality, and deduplication.
  • Strong understanding of attribution windows and view-through credit.
  • Ability to explain the difference between reported ROAS and incremental ROAS.
  • Experience planning or interpreting conversion lift studies or geo holdout tests.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, including the ability to pull raw data and build independent analyses.
  • Experience translating campaign data into actionable strategic recommendations.
  • Strong professional English speaking skills.
  • Confidence presenting directly to founders, owners, and senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous agency experience managing multiple brands simultaneously.
  • Experience with Shopify analytics.
  • Experience with product feed management tools such as DataFeedWatch.
  • Paid social experience in jewelry, apparel, supplements, or similar e-commerce categories.

How Success Is Measured

  • Paid social accounts are structured to maximize usable signal and support scalable growth.
  • Testing programs generate clear, actionable results rather than fragmented or inconclusive data.
  • Advertising budgets are allocated based on performance and incremental business impact.
  • Attribution settings and measurement methodologies are consistent and well understood.
  • Campaign performance is evaluated using business metrics such as revenue, MER, customer acquisition, and contribution, not just platform ROAS.
  • New paid social channels are expanded when supported by performance evidence.
  • Creative teams receive useful, data-backed briefs and recommendations.
  • Clients and founders receive clear, confident, and actionable performance insights.

Why Join Us?

  • $2,000–$5,000 USD/month compensation.
  • Fully remote opportunity from Colombia.
  • Manage high-spend e-commerce advertising accounts.
  • Work across multiple major paid social platforms.
  • Own strategy, execution, experimentation, and performance analysis.
  • Develop sophisticated expertise in attribution and incremental measurement.
  • Work directly with founders and senior decision-makers.
  • Join a performance-focused environment where recommendations are driven by data and business outcomes.

Important Notes

This is a paid social specialization role. Paid search and creative production are handled separately.

Candidates must have hands-on experience managing e-commerce paid social accounts with $250K+ in monthly advertising spend.

Expert-level Meta Ads Manager experience is essential, along with hands-on campaign management experience in at least two of TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest.

This position requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and direct platform execution. Candidates should be able to independently audit accounts, build campaigns, design tests, analyze raw performance data, and confidently present recommendations to senior stakeholders.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

WeVote is a nonpartisan get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup and a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. Submit your resume and include a brief note/cover letter to why you are interested in WeVote and our mission

This role leads Watershed's business development, contracts, and risk functions, works closely with our finance team to ensure business sustainability, elevate data and strategic recommendations to executive leaders. The Senior Director manages our Business & Contracts Managers, partners closely with vertical leaders and delivery teams on business development and contracting decisions and strategies, pulls strategic reports and conducts targeted FP&A to inform decisions, and partners closely with our CFO and supporting finance team. This position is best suited for someone with a strong understanding of contracting, compliance and risk, pricing strategy, and client service / consulting business strategy who is comfortable with data, leading contract-negotiations, building systems that keep the business running smoothly, holding deep relationships with delivery teams including building capacity and knowledge on business development & contracting best practices and processes, building the skills and capabilities of Business & Contract Managers, and contributing to a positive, inclusive, and engaged team culture across Strategy & Operations. In close partnership with the COO, this role will lead both day-to-day operations and key strategic projects to support business growth, sustainability, and organizational maturity.

The Senior Director of Business Operations' daily work varies, but primary responsibilities include:

Business development, contracts & risk

  • Lead the business development pipeline — build and maintain reporting on the BD pipeline, bids/RFPs, and contract status, with an eye toward how that reporting should inform Watershed's growth and business strategy.
  • Set contract negotiation parameters and standards, and provide hands-on negotiation support to Managing Directors and Senior Directors on terms and pricing when needed.
  • Oversee contract administration, delivery, compliance, and risk in line with state and local government, federal, non-profit, and philanthropy requirements, across a range of contract models (T&M, fixed fee, deliverables/milestone-based, grants).
  • Protect Watershed's cash flow — ensure contract terms and invoicing processes are structured to secure timely, accurate payment from clients.

Pricing, finance & FP&A

  • Lead resource allocation monitoring and analysis — track capacity and utilization across engagements against plan, and translate findings into recommendations and their implications for Watershed's financial model.
  • Oversee targeted FP&A and elevate strategic reporting on contract economics, revenue recognition, and profitability across engagements and clients to inform executive decisions.
  • Partner with the CFO, finance team, and leadership on key financial systems and processes, including setting a schedule and routine for regular financial updates.
  • Support proposal pricing strategy — analyze past pricing, utilization, and profitability, and share recommendations for future pricing and rate structures based on market signals. Support project teams with pricing and resourcing strategies for specific proposals that best support the resources required to do the work.

Systems & process

  • Guide the continuous improvement and development of business systems (CRM, finance, resource management, and contracts platforms) that underpin business development, finance, and reporting — improving reliability and reducing manual work and ensure proper functionality. This may require leadership of special projects as assigned and depending on capacity.
  • Improve processes and workflows across business development, contracts, and finance to increase consistency and reduce friction — building the SOPs, routines, and controls that keep the business running smoothly.

Team & capacity building

  • Manage and develop the Business & Contracts Managers — build their skills and capabilities across the full lifecycle of a deal (pipeline through delivery, invoicing, and compliance), ensuring both high quality, consistent transactional execution and proactive, insight-driven ownership.
  • Build organizational capacity across delivery teams — help Managing Directors and vertical leaders understand and manage their budgets and forecasts, and build shared knowledge of business development and contracting best practices and processes.
  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and engaged team culture across Strategy & Operations.

Build & grow

  • Roll up your sleeves and build from the ground up. This is a lean, growing team; you'll design and stand up functions that don't fully exist yet, do the hands-on work yourself while building the systems and team to scale it, and take on new operations functions and areas as the organization matures.
  • Partner with the COO on key strategic projects that support business growth, sustainability, and organizational maturity.

SKILLS AND CHARACTERISTICS

We are looking for people who are interested in education and its role in society, and who are eager to learn about approaches to improving the United States' system of public education, from birth to postsecondary to the workforce. At Watershed, we work with a wide variety of clients and are seeking team members with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We encourage people of color, people with disabilities, immigrants, and others with diverse experiences to apply for this role.

  • Strong analytical and modeling skills, the ability to build and audit models, structure messy inputs, and communicate assumptions.
  • Management experience, with a demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a growing team.
  • A builder's mindset and willingness to get your hands dirty — excitement about building functions, systems, and teams from the ground up, doing the hands-on work yourself, and growing into new operations areas as the organization matures.
  • Clear, concise communication, the ability to translate data into leadership-ready narratives, visuals, and recommendations.

  • Systems thinking and process orientation, the motivation to streamline finance, contracts, and reporting workflows, and improve repeatability.
  • Ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment, the capability of juggling recurring deliverables with ad hoc requests.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including time management systems, project planning skills, and an ability to meet goals and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • A growth orientation, including curiosity about new ideas and approaches to work, openness to feedback, and a willingness to learn new skills.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset that leads to flexibility and creativity in pursuit of goals and resilience in the face of setbacks.

jobs.excerpt: We are hiring a Business Development Associate to bring growth-stage founders into Pairs, from the first call to the start of the engagement.
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Business Development Associate to bring growth-stage founders into Pairs, from the first call to the start of the engagement.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

Founders come to Pairs when they are raising. You run the first call: you read the business quickly, find out what is holding the raise back, and judge whether we can move it forward.

When the fit is real, you present our process and fees clearly and book the next step on the call. When it is not, you close the conversation cleanly and keep the door open.

Some founders are better served by our platform tier. For them, you run the demo and close it yourself.

The numbers matter on both sides. You weigh a company's revenue, burn and round structure in the first minutes, and you keep your own pipeline as precise as a financial model.

We sell access to investors, not promises. The expectations you set are the ones we deliver against, so you only commit to what we do.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our closing team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen companies, what we decline and why.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • First calls. A sharp read of each company and a clear answer on whether we can help.

  • Qualification. Who is raising, who decides, and what the raise actually needs.

  • The handoff. A next step booked on the call, and a written read for the person who runs it.

  • Your pipeline. Every founder you speak to, logged accurately and followed up until there is a clear outcome.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have sold a financial, advisory or capital-markets service to founders or executives, and can walk us through a deal you won.

  • Read a company's numbers quickly and know which questions follow: revenue, burn, runway, round structure and committed capital.

  • Keep a disciplined pipeline. You can tell us your conversion rates from memory.

  • Set expectations you can stand behind. You never promise an outcome, and you would rather lose a deal than oversell one.

  • Handle objections on price and fit directly, once, without pressure.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote role, with working hours that overlap US Eastern time, where most of our founders are

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our closing team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • A sales process that already works, and recorded calls to learn it from

  • Insight into how we screen companies and match them with investors

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation Range: $110K - $160K
